Generate (or regenerate) meeting minutes for a session from its transcriptSegment records. Default path is the deterministic extractive generator (hermetic, always available). The Murakumo LLM path (G4 Murakumo-only, LiteLLM loopback) is a refused-by-default membrane: it requires both the caller's allowLive flag and the operator gate. Caller must be onBehalfOfDid; the resulting meetingMinutes record is E2E-sealed with read-cap = onBehalfOfDid + recipients.

lang.description: BCP-47 hint for the generator output language.

allowLive.description: Request the Murakumo LLM path. Honored only when the operator gate is also on; otherwise the call is refused (no silent fallback).

recipients.description: Extra DIDs granted read-cap on the minutes (owner always included).

main.description: Fetch the generated meeting minutes for a session. The body is E2E-sealed in the kotoba envelope; only the owner DID and explicitly granted recipients can decrypt.
Fetch metadata for a single recorder session. Caller must be the onBehalfOfDid or an authorized delegate (consent graph check).

Fetch transcript segments for a session. Segment text is stored with field-level Signal encryption (`signal:v1:` prefix per 10-protocol/wproto signal). Caller must decrypt client-side with their X25519 identity; server never returns plaintext.

textCipher.description: `signal:v1:{ciphertext}` — E2E encrypted to session participants' X25519 identity keys. Empty string if transcription disabled.

main.description: Dispatch a recorder bot to join a meeting on the specified provider and begin capturing audio/video. Requires a consent JWT signed by the on-behalf-of user (lxm=com.etzhayyim.apps.meetingRecorder.joinMeeting).

joinTarget.description: Provider-specific join payload. Teams: {joinUrl}. Meet: {meetingCode} or {meetingUrl}. Zoom: {meetingId, passcode?}.

onBehalfOfDid.description: DID of the user the recorder is acting on behalf of.

consentToken.description: ES256 JWT signed by onBehalfOfDid. Claims: iss, sub, aud=did:web:meeting-recorder.etzhayyim.com, lxm=com.etzhayyim.apps.meetingRecorder.joinMeeting, meetingRef, audio (bool), video (bool), purpose, exp.

displayName.description: Bot display name shown inside the meeting (e.g. 'etzhayyim Recorder (jun)').

main.description: Instruct the recorder bot to leave the meeting, flush remaining chunks to B2, finalize the session record, and (if requested) kick off post-meeting transcription.

purgeChunks.description: If true, delete already-written B2 chunks (e.g. organizer rejected recording). Default false.

main.description: List recorder sessions for a given onBehalfOfDid, optionally filtered by provider / status / time range.

Generated meeting minutes (議事録) for a recorder session: summary + decisions + action items + topics, derived from transcriptSegment records. Generated either by the deterministic extractive generator (hermetic) or by Murakumo LLM (G4 Murakumo-only, ADR-2605215000). The whole body is sealed in the kotoba E2E envelope (ADR-2605181100); recipients = onBehalfOfDid + explicitly granted DIDs. The substrate never sees plaintext.

decisions.description: Decisions / agreements reached in the meeting, one per entry.

topics.description: Keyword topics extracted from the transcript.

participantHashes.description: Distinct speakerHash values observed in the source segments (sha256, not reversible).

generator.description: extractive = deterministic hermetic generator; murakumo = Murakumo LLM via LiteLLM loopback (operator-gated, G4 Murakumo-only).

ownerHash.description: speakerHash of the participant the item is attributed to (sha256, not reversible).

dueDate.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when one was stated in the meeting.

main.description: A single media chunk (default 60s) written by the recorder bot. Body lives in B2 (`meeting-recorder/{sessionDid}/{seq}.{opus|webm}`); this record is the graph-addressable pointer.

participantHashes.description: Hashed provider participant IDs present during this chunk (PII Tier 1).

main.description: A single transcript segment produced by Murakumo MLX (whisper-large-v3) from a recordingChunk. Text is Signal-encrypted (`signal:v1:`) at write time; server never persists plaintext.

speakerHash.description: sha256(provider participantId + session salt). Not reversible, stable within a session.

textCipher.description: `signal:v1:{ciphertext}` per 10-protocol/wproto signal.ts encryptFieldVal. Recipients = onBehalfOfDid + explicitly granted DIDs.

ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class definition. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical taxonomy entry — `code` is the 4-digit class, `section` (1 letter A–U) / `division` (2 digits) / `group` (3 digits) materialize the hierarchy as MST-traversal prefixes. Seeded once per ISIC revision (~10 year cadence) from `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-isic/data/classes/{code}.json`. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_isic_class` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set. Substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) provides the trust-less verification path for the taxonomy itself.

UNSPSC 2-digit segment catalog entry. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical segment taxonomy — `code` is the 2-digit segment code (rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding), `slug` is the url-safe identifier from `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-unispsc/segments.csv`, `name` is the English title. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: this is the published-catalog companion to the existing `com.etzhayyim.apps.openUnispsc.segment` *procedure* (which resolves a segment as a business-portfolio boundary at runtime). The procedure performs active business logic; this record persists the taxonomy on PDS so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the segment list without trusting this operator. Family / class / commodity layers follow the same record-vs-procedure split when their kotoba taxonomy publishers land in future PRs.

main.description: Governance proposal payload emitted by TreasuryRebalanceCell when observed-vs-target tier drift exceeds drift_threshold_bps. Per ADR-2605172300 §3.3 + §4. txHash.description: geth-private tx hash of the Governance.propose() call.

navCorpusUsdcMicros.description: TreasuryMirror.tierLatest(TIER_CORPUS) at proposal time, USDC base units.

observedLiquidBps.description: Observed 流動 share at proposal time (= navLiquid * 10_000 / navTotal).

observedReserveBps.description: Observed 準備 share at proposal time.

observedCorpusBps.description: Observed 本財 share at proposal time.

driftThresholdBps.description: Absolute drift threshold per tier that triggered this proposal. Default 500 (5%).

epochSeconds.description: Unix seconds of the monthly cron tick that produced this proposal.

main.description: No-op trail record emitted by TreasuryRebalanceCell when the monthly cron tick fired but no governance proposal was produced — either because all three tiers were within drift_threshold_bps or because the treasury is empty. observedLiquidBps.description: Observed 流動 share. Zero when reason = treasury_empty.

driftThresholdBps.description: Threshold against which all tiers stayed within band.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem name. Omit for all. See https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#affectedpackage-field

modifiedSince.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Only ingest vulnerabilities modified after this time.

main.description: sbom.etzhayyim.com liveness + phase reporter. Returns the worker's current implementation phase (0-stub / B-persist / C-vuln-match / D-recall) so callers can detect when their dependencies are met.

Blast-radius query for a supplier (and optionally MPN). Returns every SBOM artifact whose components reference the supplier — Takata-style hardware recall surface for vehicle BOMs and the equivalent software-side query for cargo SBOMs. Filters by kind (software | vehicle).

supplier.description: Manufacturer / supplier name. Matched against vertex_sbom_component.supplier_name.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number. Optional. When set, only components whose supplier_mpn equals this value are returned.

kind.description: Restrict results to software or vehicle artifacts. Omit for both.

main.description: Register a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifact with sbom.etzhayyim.com. Software SBOMs (cargo-cyclonedx output) and vehicle BOMs (kami-cad-import output, type=device per part) flow through the same SbomArtifact graph and CVE / recall pipeline (60-apps/etzhayyim-project-sbom/AGENTS.md). For vehicle BOMs the optional vehicle* fields capture the part-graph metadata needed for Takata-style supplier recall queries.

format.description: Wire format. CycloneDX 1.5 is the default for both software and vehicle BOMs.

vehicleId.description: Stable vehicle id (e.g. mx5-na-1989). Present for vehicle BOMs only — software SBOMs leave this unset.

totalMassKg.description: Vehicle BOMs only — sum of effective_mass_kg across parts.

partCount.description: Vehicle BOMs only — number of CDX components.[type=device].

sourceUri.description: URI of the source artifact that produced this SBOM (e.g. scad://etzhayyim/roadster-na/v0.1.0, b2://drive/cad/...).

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the source artifact. Used for deterministic SBOM serial number.

license.description: SPDX expression covering the source artifact (e.g. MIT, CC-BY-4.0, proprietary).

cdxJson.description: Full CycloneDX 1.5 (or SPDX 3.0) document, encoded as a JSON string. Validated server-side against the upstream schema.

artifactUri.description: AT URI of the SbomArtifact graph node (at://did:web:sbom.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.sbom.artifact/<rkey>).

componentCount.description: Number of CDX components ingested into the SbomComponent graph.

vulnMatchCount.description: Number of vulnerability matches detected synchronously against the existing CveEntry graph.

errors.name: InvalidSbom
errors.description: cdxJson failed CycloneDX 1.5 schema validation.

errors.name: MissingProvenance
errors.description: sourceSha256 or sourceUri empty.

errors.name: DuplicateArtifact
errors.description: An artifact with the same sourceSha256 already exists.

Flag a surplus lot as no longer redistributable. Triggers downstream routing decision. Per ADR-2605211241. Wellbecoming constraint (ADR-2605192100 §1.13): routing priority is recycle-via-kozan -> dispose-licensed; dispose-first is prohibited and requires an explicit prohibitedReasonOverride from Council Lv6+ multisig (see governance.attestationUri). Eschatological framing such as 'Last Days clearance' is forbidden in reason text (ADR-2605192100 §1.15).

reasonDetail.description: PII-free. Eschatological / clearance / fire-sale language prohibited (Charter Rider §2 + ADR-2605192100 §1.15).

routing.description: Wellbecoming order: recycle-via-kozan is the default. dispose-licensed requires governance.attestationUri.

kozanStreamTypeHint.description: Hint for the subsequent toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream call (see recordKozanHandoff).

decidedBy.description: DID of the deciding actor. For dispose-licensed routing, this DID must be referenced by a Council Lv6+ multisig attestation.

attestationUri.description: AT URI of Council Lv6+ multisig attestation that overrides Wellbecoming default routing.

councilSeats.description: DIDs of the Council members who signed.

main.description: Get a single surplus lot by DID. Per ADR-2605211241.

List surplus lots with optional filters for demand-side matching. Per ADR-2605211241. Lots are returned in donation-only context; no commercial markup applies. Listings within the religious-corp economy may use SBT<->SBT internal-promo carve-out; external promotional surfacing is prohibited (Charter Rider §2).

category.description: Filter by category enum (see registerSurplusLot).

hazardFlag.description: Filter to lots that include this single hazard flag.

maxAgeDays.description: Only lots registered within the last N days.

minShelfLifeRemainingDays.description: Only lots whose shelfLifeRemainingDays >= this value.

main.description: Demand-side claim against a registered surplus lot. Receiver must be an Adherent SBT holder or attested religious-corp downstream actor (e.g., kuni-umi site / urban-mining cell / open-robo project DID). Per ADR-2605211241. Transitions lot state registered -> matched. No commercial markup. SBT<->SBT internal-promo carve-out applies for visibility but not for monetization.

lotDid.description: DID of the surplus lot being claimed.

receiverDid.description: DID of the receiver. Must be Adherent-SBT or attested religious-corp downstream actor.

intendedUse.description: Wellbecoming constraint: dispose / commercial-resale are not allowed as intendedUse values.

claimedQuantity.description: Partial claim allowed if <= remaining quantity.

main.description: Bridge a flagged-dead-stock surplus lot into the toshiKozan (都市鉱山) e-waste recovery stream. Per ADR-2605211241. The handoff is 1:1 with a subsequent com.etzhayyim.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record. Transitions lot state flagged-dead-stock -> kozan-handoff. The downstream urban-mining cell (60-apps/etzhayyim-project-open-robo/) actually performs the recycling and ultimately reports final material recovery, after which the lot may be transitioned to 'recycled' by a follow-up call.

flagUri.description: AT URI of the prior flagDeadStock event.

recoveryFacilityDid.description: DID of the urban-mining cell / recovery facility receiving the lot. Must be an attested religious-corp downstream actor.

expectedYieldGramsPerTonne.description: Predicted recovery yield by material (g/tonne). Audited later against actual recovery.

co2eKgPerTonneEstimate.description: Estimated CO2e per tonne recovered. Same units as toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream.co2eKgPerTonneRecovered.

kozanStreamRef.description: AT URI of the auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record.

main.description: Record the physical handoff of a surplus lot from donor to matched receiver. Audit event that closes the redistribution path. Per ADR-2605211241. On success: lot state matched -> redistributed. Both donor PDS and receiver PDS emit symmetric warehouse.pick / warehouse.putaway records when both are Adherent SBT holders. Cross-border physical movement should also reference a freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry entry via bondedEntryRef (optional).

matchUri.description: AT URI of the prior matchDemand event.

carrierDid.description: Optional DID of the logistics carrier.

valueAttestedUsdcMicros.description: Final attested value at handoff. Should be consistent with registerSurplusLot.estimatedValueUsdcMicros unless valuationAttestationUri overrides.

tithePaymentRef.description: Optional AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.apps.payment.sent record that carried the 10% in-kind tithe coupling for this lot. Per ADR-2605192130.

bondedEntryRef.description: Optional AT URI of com.etzhayyim.apps.freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry for cross-border bonded transit.

ftzZoneRef.description: Optional AT URI of com.etzhayyim.apps.ftzZones.recordZone for FTZ-mediated transit.

receiverAckSignature.description: Optional receiver's WebAuthn / DID signature over the handoff payload.

warehousePickRef.description: Auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.pick record on donor side, when applicable.

warehousePutawayRef.description: Auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.putaway record on receiver side, when applicable.

main.description: Register a globally surplus / dead-stock / overstock / unsold-inventory lot for donation-based redistribution within the religious-corp economy. Per ADR-2605211241. Donor must be SBT Adherent or attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only, non-profit). Wellbecoming constraint: routing priority redistributed -> recycled (via toshiKozan) -> disposed-licensed; dispose-first is prohibited at the state-enum level (see flagDeadStock). 10% tithe coupling: emit com.etzhayyim.apps.payment.sent {purpose:donation, amountUsdcMicros: estimatedValueUsdcMicros} in the same batch and the TitheRouter splits 10% to the Public Fund per ADR-2605192130.

lotId.description: Donor-side stable identifier for the lot. Recommended: urn:uuid:...

category.description: High-level product category. Drives downstream toshiKozan streamType mapping when state becomes flagged-dead-stock.

skuCode.description: Optional SKU code for catalog reference. May match an existing com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.registerSku record.

warehouseSkuRef.description: Optional AT URI of an existing com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.registerSku record this lot pertains to. Avoids duplicating the SKU master.

description.description: Plain-language description. PII-free. No promotional / ad-style language (Charter Rider §2).

unitOfMeasure.description: Units of quantity. e.g., piece, kg, liter, m, pallet, container-20ft.

weightKgTotal.description: Total lot weight in kilograms. Used for cross-border / freight estimation.

estimatedValueUsdcMicros.description: Donor self-attested value of the lot in USDC base units (6 decimals). Drives the 10% in-kind tithe coupling. Inflation by donors is mitigated by valuationAttestationUri (third-party attestation, optional).

valuationAttestationUri.description: Optional AT URI of a third-party valuation attestation record. Recommended for lots above 10000 USDC.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor. Must be either an Adherent SBT holder or an attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only per ADR-2605192115).

donorKind.description: Default: adherent-sbt. Non-Adherent donors require prior attestation by Council Lv6+ multisig.

originWarehouseDid.description: Optional DID of the warehouse/facility where the lot is physically located.

shelfLifeRemainingDays.description: Days until best-before / expiry. 0 or negative means already past nominal shelf life (still potentially donatable for non-food categories).

hazardFlags.description: Multi-select hazard flags. Drives routing constraints (e.g., li-ion-battery forces flagDeadStock direct path to toshiKozan if redistribution not safe).

dppBadgeRef.description: Optional AT URI of an ESPR Digital Product Passport (com.etzhayyim.apps.textileCircularity.registerDppBadge) when applicable.

did.description: DID assigned to this surplus lot.

main.description: Non-compliance / disclosure gap finding (GFTAx / Common Transmission System)
CRS / FATCA / CARF AEOI exchange (bridges global-tax + ofac-sanctions + mica-crypto)
LEMF — acknowledge receipt (or report failure) of an IRI / CC delivery. Used to compute delivery loss for SLA reporting to the requesting authority.
LICF/LIPF (X1) — activate interception against a target identifier under an existing warrant. Identifier value persisted only as sha256 hash; raw value out-of-band.
Activate or configure a service instance via TMF640 Service Activation and Configuration API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_activation record.
Activate a SIM (or eSIM profile) and bind it to a subscriber MSISDN/IMSI.
O-RAN A1 — apply / modify / delete a policy instance from Non-RT RIC (rApp) to a Near-RT RIC. Statement body persisted via vault:// ref + sha256 hash.
O-RAN O1 — SMO pushes a NETCONF/RESTCONF YANG configuration to a managed function (O-CU / O-DU / O-RU / Near-RT RIC). Body persisted via vault:// ref only.
5G Core PCF — record a policy + charging decision (Npcf_SMPolicyControl). Drives QoS flows + rating group + charging method for a PDU session.
IMS TAS — record activation/deactivation/invocation of a supplementary service (call forward, hold, transfer, waiting, conference, CLIR/CLIP).
Apply / modify / delete a traffic shaper on a bridge port. CBS = idle-slope; TAS = gate schedule (vault://+sha256); ATS = per-flow asynchronous.
OSS CAB — approve / reject / defer an existing change request. Updates the change row status and inserts an approval audit row.
Wi-Fi session attach — bind a UE to a Hotspot 2.0 venue under a Passpoint PPS-MO. UE MAC + assigned IP persisted as sha256 hashes. Single-row lifecycle: releasedAt UPDATEd in place.
Poll and record eUICC state snapshot (profile count, active ICCID, free memory). Designed for timer-start (R/PT4H). EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

activeIccid.description: sha256: hashed ICCID of active profile

main.description: LICF audit — record any operator-side access to LI warrants / targets / deliveries (read, query, export). Required by ETSI TS 102 232-1 for tamper-evident audit trail.
Persist a TMF671 performance counter sample (RRC drop / DL throughput / handover / CQI). Designed to be invoked from a timer-start BPMN (R/PT15M).
5G Core AUSF — record an authentication event (5G-AKA / EAP-AKA' / EAP-TLS). Audit-only: RAND / RES* / KAUSF never persisted; only the event outcome and a randHash for correlation.
ANDSP / ATSSS handoff bridge — record a Wi-Fi ↔ 5G cellular transition for a UE. andspPolicyRef must be vault://. Links Phase 13 wlan_session to Phase 4 PDU session.
IMS BGCF / MGCF / IBCF — bridge a voice call to an interconnect peer (PSTN gateway / SIP trunk / IMS-IMS peering). Links voice_call to Phase 3 interconnect_agreement + roaming_partner.
OSS NOC — clear an alarm and compute MTTR (mean time to repair) from raised_at to cleared_at. Mutates the alarm row in place.
Close an intercept warrant (auto on validUntil expiry, manual on revocation, or on closure of investigation). Sets retention_until per jurisdiction-specific evidence retention rules.
OSS NOC — correlate child alarms under a parent (root cause), suppressing storm. ruleRef points to a DMN rule (com.etzhayyim.dmn.*) or a vault://rule pointer.
LICF (X1) — deactivate interception against a previously-activated target. Updates the existing target row in place.
5G SCP — delegated NF discovery (SCP queries NRF on behalf of consumer NF). Records candidate set + selected NF + selection strategy.
Delete an eSIM profile from eUICC storage (GSMA SGP.22 §3.3). Irreversible — profile must be disabled first. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

DF3 (X3) — deliver Communication Content (CC) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash + encryption pointer persisted in graph; the CC payload itself goes directly DF3 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
DF2 (X2) — deliver Intercept-Related Information (IRI) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash persisted in graph; the IRI payload itself goes directly DF2 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
O-RAN Near-RT RIC — deploy an xApp (near-RT RIC application). Lists supported RAN functions + bound E2 nodes.
Disable an active eSIM profile on eUICC without deletion (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'disabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
EES (Edge Enabler Server) — record an EAS discovery request from an Edge Enabler Client / Application Client. UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash.
Initiate eSIM profile download from SM-DP+ to eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.1). EID and ICCID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_profile record.
5G Core CHF — emit a 5G charging data record (Nchf_ConvergedCharging). Bridges 5G PDU session usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup.

IMS CDF / TAS — emit an IMS-specific billing event (3GPP Rf interface). Bridges voice call usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup; complements Phase 4 emitChargingDataRecord which is data-plane only.
5G NWDAF — emit a periodic analytics result for an active subscription. Only payload metadata (hash + size + vault:// ref) persisted in graph.
Enable an installed eSIM profile on eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'enabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
Enable Frame Replication & Elimination for Reliability (IEEE 802.1CB) on an existing TSN stream. Replication kind picks how diverse paths are computed.
NSACF — Network Slice Admission Control Function (3GPP TS 29.536). Enforces max registered UEs / max established sessions per S-NSSAI; SUPI-aware admission decisions.
Record an SLA / QoS breach against a provisioned service and open an escalation ticket.
5G Core SMF — establish a PDU session (Nsmf_PDUSession) with selected slice / DNN / UPF / RAN node and active policy decision.
5G SEPP — establish an N32-c security context to a peer PLMN's SEPP (3GPP TS 33.501 §13.2). certificateRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw cert/key never persisted.
IMS S-CSCF / TAS — record SIP INVITE → 200 OK → ACK call setup. Caller/callee MSISDN persisted as hashes; IMPU/SIP URI as plain (already public-style identifier).
OSS NMS — record a capacity forecast for a scope+metric. Sets breachPredicted=true when forecastValue exceeds capacityLimit; designed for timer-start (R/PT24H or R/P7D).
VNFM — heal a VNF (restart / re-instantiate / live-migrate). alarmVid may reference a Phase 7 alarm.
MEC orchestrator — instantiate an Edge Application Server (EAS) on a registered MEC host from an onboarded app package. Phase 10 (3GPP TS 23.558).
NFVO — instantiate a Network Service from an onboarded NSD against one or more VIMs. parameters carry instantiation knobs (string-encoded TOSCA inputs).
VNFM — instantiate a VNF/CNF from a VNFD on a chosen VIM under an NS. Optional `mappedNfInstanceId` ties this VNF back to the Phase 4 5G NF instance it implements.
Issue a customer bill via TMF678 Customer Bill Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_bill record. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).
NPN UDR — upsert a SUPI ↔ GPSI mapping (Generic Public Subscription Identifier — MSISDN/external_id/IMEI). SUPI/GPSI persisted as sha256 hashes.
MEC — onboard an edge application package (AppD descriptor) into the catalog. packageRef must be vault://; appDescriptor + raw container image never persisted.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a Network Service Descriptor (NSD) into the catalog. Phase 12 SDN-NFV control plane. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
O-RAN Non-RT RIC — onboard an rApp (non-RT RIC application) to SMO. packageRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw package never persisted in graph.
Onboard a new telecom subscriber. PII (customerName) is stored Tier-3 per ADR-0018; AT Repo holds hashed identity only.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a VNFD (VM-based) or CNFD (cloud-native, helm chart) into the catalog. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
MNP port-in request — receive a subscriber from a donor partner.
MNP port-out request — release a subscriber to a recipient partner. authCodeIssued is the porting auth code returned to the subscriber.
Provision a DWDM lightpath / spectrum slot between two ROADMs through pre-validated fiber spans. centerFrequencyGhz on flex-grid (e.g. 193.1 THz center + multiples of channelGridGhz).
Register a new eUICC device in the graph (SGP.22 §2 EID provisioning). EID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_euicc record.
Provision a gPTP (IEEE 802.1AS-2020) sync profile with grandmaster + redundant GMs. priority1/priority2 follow PTPv2 BMCA.
NTN — provision an inter-satellite link (ISL) between two satellites. Optical (LCT) or RF, with optional encryption key reference (vault://).
NTN — provision a non-terrestrial cell on a satellite (3GPP TS 38.821). cellPattern = moving (LEO sweep) / earth_fixed (steered) / quasi_earth_fixed.
O-RAN O2 — SMO requests O-Cloud (IMS infrastructure / DMS deployment) resource provisioning. interfaceKind distinguishes O2-IMS vs O2-DMS.
Provision an OTN connection (ITU-T G.709) carried inside a DWDM channel. clientServiceVid optionally references a Phase 1 service / Phase 4 PDU session / Phase 9 O-RAN xHaul / Phase 14 NTN feeder.
Hotspot 2.0 PPS-MO (Per-Provider Subscription Management Object) provisioning. credentialRef must be vault://; raw EAP credentials never persist. ppsMoRef stores the full MO XML out-of-band.
NPN — provision a Public-Network-Integrated NPN slice (PNI-NPN). Slice runs on hosting PLMN with optional CAG access restriction + tenant isolation.
NPN — provision 5G ProSe (Proximity Services) direct communication / sidelink (3GPP TS 23.304). prosePolicyRef must be vault://; raw policy body never persisted.
SDN controller — install / modify / delete a flow rule on a southbound switch (OpenFlow / P4Runtime / NETCONF / OVSDB / gNMI). matchHash + actionHash only; raw match/action bodies via vault://.
Provision a telecom service instance (voice/data/SMS/IoT) with QoS profile + APN.
Publish or update a product offering in the TMF620 Product Catalog. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_offering record.
OSS NOC — raise an alarm against a network entity (cell site, RAN node, NF instance, asset, or service). 3GPP TS 32.111 / ITU-T X.733 fault management shape.
ANQP / Hotspot 2.0 GAS query audit. UE MAC address persisted only as sha256 hash; ANQP response body persisted as sha256 hash + size.
Record a Bluetooth/BLE scan observation from a robot or field sensor. Advertisement payloads and service UUID lists are persisted as hashes.
O-RAN E2 — record an E2 INDICATION message from E2 Node to xApp. headerHash + messageHash only; ASN.1 PER body never persisted.
NTN — record a feeder-link or TT&C contact window between an earth station and a satellite. AOS / LOS times define the window; duration_seconds computed automatically.
MEC — record a UE/AC ↔ EAS service call (HTTP/gRPC method + status + latency + IO byte counts). UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash; EAS payload body never persisted.
NTN — record an ephemeris snapshot for a satellite (TLE / OMM / SP3 / 3GPP-NTN). Body persisted via vault://+sha256.
Record an interconnect-traversed CDR (POI / hub). MSISDN values stored as hashes (Tier-3 PII not persisted plaintext at this boundary).
NTN — record a handover event between NTN cells / satellites or between NTN ↔ terrestrial. Doppler offset + one-way propagation delay captured for QoS audit.
Record an optical-layer alarm (LOS / LOF / LOS-P / BDI / TIM / DEG / BER / OSNR-min). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record an optical performance-monitoring event (rx-power, tx-power, OSNR, pre-FEC-BER, Q-factor, CD/PMD). breach=true when |value| crosses slaThreshold.
Record a product instance in the TMF637 Product Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_inventory record.
5G SEPP — record an N32-c (control) or N32-f (forwarding) message exchange. Payload hash + security verification result only; payload body never persisted.
Record a service instance in the TMF638 Service Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_inventory record.
Record an incident on a cell site / RAN node. Drives downstream SLA breach (Phase 1 escalateSlaBreach).
Record a TSN stream SLA breach (latency / jitter / frame loss). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record a submarine cable fault or repair dispatch event, including ROV/vessel references when available.
Record a gPTP / PTP sync deviation observed by a bridge. breach=true when offsetNs/pathDelayNs exceeds profile thresholds (computed by primitive).
Record a TAP 3.12 batch file aggregate (counts + total charge per file). Per-call detail rows go to recordInterconnectCdr.
5G SEPP — record N32 trust / cipher / IPX modification policy negotiation outcome with a peer SEPP (or via IPX provider).
Record a CDR (Call Detail Record) for voice / SMS / data / IoT usage.
Wi-Fi roaming AAA exchange (RADIUS / Diameter via DRR / RoamServer). Captures session-time + ingress/egress bytes per partner for downstream settlement.
Register a Bluetooth/BLE device for short-range telecom inventory. Device addresses are stored as hashes only.
NPN — register a Closed Access Group (CAG) within an SNPN. Restricts which UEs may camp on which Phase 2 cellSite/ranNode.
Register a cell site (TMF639 Resource Inventory). Latitude/longitude only — tower owner contact PII held elsewhere.
Register or update a customer billing account via TMF666 Account Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_account record. PII fields are hashed.
NTN — register an earth station / satellite gateway. Bound to a peering NF (Phase 4) for traffic ingress.
MEC Federation (GSMA OPG / ETSI MEC Fed) — register a federation partnership with another operator's MEC platform under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
ETSI MEC — register a MEC host (edge compute node hosting EAS workloads). Phase 10 edge plane. Bound to a Phase 9 O-Cloud and ranNode for locality affinity.
Register a fiber span between two ROADMs. Captures SMF/NZDSF type + length + attenuation + dispersion + amplifier (EDFA/Raman/hybrid) for GNPy planning.
Hotspot 2.0 venue (BSS + OSU) registration. HESSID + SSID + advertised RCOI list per ANQP. ssid is broadcast public; no PII concern.
IMS HSS — register an IMS user-profile subscription (IMPI ↔ IMPU list ↔ S-CSCF). Phase 5 voice control plane.

Lawful Intercept (CALEA / ETSI LI / 3GPP TS 33.127) — register a warrant authorizing intercept against named identifiers. warrantDocumentRef is a vault:// pointer; warrant body never persisted in graph.
Register an interconnect / wholesale agreement with a peer carrier (MNO / MVNO). Phase 3 telecom Supplier/Partner domain.
Register a physical network asset (router / fiber / antenna / battery) with serial# tracking.
5G Core SBA — register a Network Function instance with the NRF (Nnrf_NFManagement). Phase 4 control plane.
NPN — register a Network Identifier (NID) allocation. assignmentKind=self → self-assigned (collision risk); assignmentKind=coordinated → IEEE Registration Authority via OUI prefix.
NPN — enroll an existing 5G subscriber profile (Phase 4) into an SNPN or PNI-NPN with optional CAG membership and device class scope.
NTN — register a satellite operator roaming partnership (Starlink / OneWeb / Iridium / SES / Inmarsat) under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
Register an MSISDN range allocation from the regulator (E.164, country code + range bounds).
TIP Phoenix MUST optical domain — controller scope (TransportPCE / Goldstone / GNPy / vendor controller). Phase 16 transport plane.
Register an Optical Line System (OLS) per TIP MUST OLS specification — bundle of ROADMs / amplifiers / fiber spans under a domain controller.
Register a RAN node (gNB / eNB / DU / CU) bound to a cell site and a spectrum license.
Register a ROADM node within an OLS. Bound to Phase 2 cellSite via siteId, Phase 2 networkAsset via attachedAssetId.
Register a TAP 3.12 roaming partner (TADIG code, IMSI prefix, SCCP GT prefix) under an existing interconnect agreement.
NTN — register a satellite asset. NORAD ID + International Designator are public catalog identifiers (no PII). Phase 14 satellite plane.
IMS P-CSCF — record a SIP REGISTER (UE attach to IMS). Binds an IMPU to a contact URI for the duration of the registration.
Register a pending profile event on SM-DS (GSMA SGP.22 §3.6). The eUICC polls SM-DS and retrieves the event to initiate profile download. EID sha256: hashed.
O-RAN SMO — register a Service Management & Orchestration node hosting Non-RT RIC + O1/O2 northbound endpoints. Phase 9 Open RAN control plane.
NPN — register a Stand-alone Non-Public Network deployment (3GPP TS 23.501 §5.30). Phase 11 enterprise private 5G control plane.
Register a spectrum license (TMF634 Resource Catalog). Phase 2 telecom Resource domain.
Register a submarine cable system with landing-station and capacity metadata.

Register a TSN bridge / endpoint in a domain. attachedAssetId may reference a Phase 2 networkAsset for inventory linkage.
TSN domain (IEEE 802.1Q-2022). Defines gPTP / SRP scope. Optionally bound to a Phase 11 SNPN for industrial 5G integration. Phase 15 deterministic plane.
Register or update a WLAN mesh node link, covering 802.11s/HWMP-style field mesh telemetry without implementing the radio stack.
WBA OpenRoaming / Hotspot 2.0 — register a Roaming Consortium Organization Identifier (RCOI). Phase 13 Wi-Fi convergence.

MEC orchestrator — record an EAS relocation (ACR — Application Context Relocation) between MEC hosts. Trigger may reference Phase 7 capacity_forecast (breach), Phase 4 ue_mobility (handover), or Phase 8 NWDAF SERVICE_EXPERIENCE.
Open a vendor RMA case for a faulty network asset.
Reserve a deterministic stream (IEEE 802.1Q SRP / Qcc CNC). pathBridgeIds is the ordered talker→listener path computed by the controller.
5G SEPP — record an N32 cryptographic key rotation. Only key hashes persisted in graph; newKeyRef is a vault:// pointer.

5G SCP — record an SBI service request routing event (3GPP TS 23.501 §6.2.18). Request URI persisted as sha256 hash; body never persisted.
Aggregate CDRs for a subscriber over a period and emit an invoice. Designed to be invoked from a timer-start BPMN (R/P1M).
VNFM — scale a VNF horizontally (instance count) or vertically (resource per instance). triggerVid may reference Phase 7 capacity_forecast or Phase 8 NWDAF NF_LOAD.
Schedule a preventive / corrective maintenance window on a site / node / asset.
5G Core NSSF — record a network slice selection (S-NSSAI mapping) for a UE registration.
Aggregate inbound + outbound TAP files for a partner over a period and emit a net settlement invoice. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).
Aggregate Wi-Fi roaming exchanges per partner over a period and emit a settlement invoice. Mirrors Phase 3 settleRoamingInvoice (cellular TAP) for Wi-Fi traffic. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).

Religious-corp social post. AT Protocol record under the writer's DID (typically an SBT-holding adherent), carrying short-form text + optional reply chain. The substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) anchors the writer's MST root including these posts, so any third party can verify the post existed at a given moment without trusting this operator. Distinct from `app.bsky.feed.post`: religious-corp namespace lives at `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.*`, SBT-gated write policy is enforced at the PDS layer (not in this lexicon), and the embed surface is intentionally narrow in v1 — no media, no external link unfurl, no quote-post — to bias the medium toward attestation and study over performance. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture.

text.description: Primary post content. May be empty when `reply` is present (e.g. silent witness).

reply.description: Reply target — required `root` (thread origin) + `parent` (immediate parent). Both fields point to existing com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post records.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the primary text (e.g. 'ja', 'en'). Empty = unspecified.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was originally written.

root.description: Root of the thread — the first post in the conversation.

parent.description: Immediate parent post — the one this post is replying to. May equal `root` when replying to the thread origin.

main.description: Promote a checkpoint to a serving alias. servingTarget.description: Hint for the serving system. e.g. 'murakumo' / 'runpod' / 'vultr-gpu' / 'browser-ameno'.

promotedBy.description: DID of the actor doing the promotion. Defaults to the caller.

retiredEdgeId.description: Edge ID of the previous active promotion that was retired, if any.

main.description: Start a Baien (BitNet b1.58) LoRA-on-bf16-master fine-tune (ADR 2605092350). Trains an adapter on the bf16 master checkpoint of the BitNet trunk; the post-train re-quantization to i2_s ternary is handled inside the runner. Same H100 NVL training pod as Oka — kind='baien-lora' is the only handler-side dispatch difference. baseModel defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 when omitted.

baseModel.description: HF model id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 (BAIEN_DEFAULT_TRUNK_MODEL).

requantizeAfterTrain.description: If true, re-quantize merged adapter+master to i2_s and record the ternary blob alongside the bf16 checkpoint.

perplexityDriftCeiling.description: Max allowed perplexity drift vs unquantized master on a held-out set (default 0.05 = 5%).

i2sBlobUri.description: B2 URI of the i2_s ternary-packed blob produced by re-quantization, if requantizeAfterTrain was true.

perplexityDrift.description: Measured perplexity drift vs unquantized master on the held-out set.

main.description: Train a Baien multimodal projector (image / audio-speech / audio-env) on top of a frozen BitNet trunk and a frozen off-the-shelf encoder (SigLIP-So400m / Whisper-tiny CTC / YAMNet). ADR 2605092350. Trunk weights are NOT updated; only the 1.58-bit projector is. Recorded as kind='baien-multimodal-graft' in vertex_training_run.

encoderModel.description: HF id of the frozen encoder (e.g. google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384, openai/whisper-tiny, google/yamnet).

projectorTokens.description: Number of latent tokens emitted by the projector (image=64, audio-speech=32, audio-env=16).

main.description: Baien-MX (ADR 2605101000) — train per-modality 1.58-bit projectors + the shared cross-modal fusion block on RisingWave-native multimodal samples (v_training_multimodal_sample snapshot). All NEW blocks are BitNet QAT (1.58-bit). Trunk frozen for v0. Modalities are explicit: caller declares which non-text branches to activate; text is always present.

baseModel.description: BitNet trunk HF id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16.

modalities.description: Non-text branches to train. Text is implicit and always active.

fusionLayerIndex.description: Trunk layer at which to insert the fusion block. Default 15 = L/2 for the 30-layer 2B trunk.

trunkFrozen.description: Freeze the BitNet trunk during training. Default true for v0.

loraOverFirst4Layers.description: Optional v1: per-modality rank-≤16 LoRA over the trunk's first 4 layers. Default false.

learningRate.description: Default LR shared by projectors that do not appear in perModalityLearningRates.

perModalityLearningRates.description: JSON-encoded {modality: lr} override map. Stored as a string because AT Lexicon does not allow free-form object values.

projectorCheckpoints.description: JSON-encoded {modality: checkpointVertexId} map, one row per trained projector (kind=baien-mx-projector-{modality}).

main.description: Start a distillation run (teacher → student). The teacher is identified by either a prior training run (runId) or by an actor DID whose Murakumo-served weights produce the labels. For LLM teachers we bulk-infer logits over the dataset and persist them as Hume-style artifacts (ADR-2604300135) before running the student fine-tune. edge_training_distilled_from is written on success.

teacherKind.description: run = prior vertex_training_run; actor = serving DID (Murakumo etc); artifact = vertex_ingest_artifact (Hume / external).

alpha.description: Mix between distill loss and ground-truth loss.

main.description: Run one or more benchmarks against an existing checkpoint. lm-eval-harness compatible task names plus internal benches (ADR-2604282100). Writes one row per (checkpoint, bench) into vertex_training_eval.

evalDatasetName.description: Optional eval split name; resolved to vertex_training_dataset_snapshot.

sampleLimit.description: Cap samples per bench for fast smoke evals.

main.description: Start a LoRA / PEFT adapter training run. Same shape as runSft but emits adapter-only checkpoints (small, ~tens to hundreds of MB) instead of full weights. Adapter is recorded in vertex_training_checkpoint with adapter_kind='lora' and adapter_rank.

Start a supervised fine-tuning run. Snapshots the dataset, fine-tunes the base model on a Vultr GPU pod, writes step checkpoints to B2, registers each checkpoint in vertex_training_checkpoint, and runs an eval at the end. Returns runId + final checkpointId.

runId.description: Optional client-supplied run ID; auto-generated if omitted.

baseModel.description: HF model ID (e.g. google/gemma-2-2b-it) or internal alias resolved via llm-model-registry.

baseModelRevision.description: HF revision pin. Defaults to the registry default.

datasetName.description: Logical corpus name (e.g. etzhayyim-corpus). Resolved against v_training_text labels and HF dataset records.

datasetRevision.description: Optional content_hash or HF revision to pin a prior snapshot. Omit to take a fresh snapshot.

hyperparams.description: JSON-serializable training args. Stored verbatim in vertex_training_run.hyperparams_json.

evalBenches.description: lm-eval-harness task names to run on the final checkpoint.

gpuTarget.description: Vultr GPU pool name (defaults to mitama-training-pool).

Submit a 3D design request (text / image / CAD code) and start a LangGraph run that produces .glb mesh + .vox voxel artifacts on B2. Returns immediately with run_id; poll getRun for status. Per ADR-2605080700.

kind.description: Input modality. text = TRELLIS text→3D, image = ComfyUI 3D-Pack image→3D, cad = CadQuery Python exec→mesh.

prompt.description: Required when kind=text. Free-text description of the design (e.g., 'a small wooden cabin with a stone chimney').

imageUrl.description: Required when kind=image. Public URL or B2 presigned URL of the reference image.

cadCode.description: Required when kind=cad. CadQuery Python source code that builds a single Workplane / Compound and assigns it to a variable named `result`.

referenceArtifactId.description: Optional vertex_voxelforge_artifact.vertex_id of a prior artifact to use as conditioning input.

targetFormat.description: Output format(s) to materialize. 'both' produces .glb + .vox + voxel_grid.json + manifest.json.

targetVoxelDim.description: Target voxel grid edge length (cubic). 64 default. Higher = larger .vox file. Ignored when targetFormat=glb only.

items.description: RGB hex string, e.g. '#7a5230'.

palette.description: Optional explicit MagicaVoxel palette (≤256). When omitted, voxelizer auto-quantizes mesh colors with median-cut.

params.description: Free-form generator-specific parameters (e.g., { seed: 42, sampleSteps: 25 }). Passed through to TRELLIS / ComfyUI / CadQuery exec.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(designId). Use with getRun to poll.

status.description: Initial status. Almost always 'pending' or 'running' from this call.

estimatedSeconds.description: Heuristic ETA from generator routing. text/image≈90, cad≈15.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or kind mismatch.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: Per-org concurrent run cap exceeded.

errors.name: BackendUnavailable
errors.description: RunPod pod or LangGraph Server unreachable.

main.description: Fetch the current status of a voxelforge LangGraph run (artifact URIs once completed). Per ADR-2605080700.

currentNode.description: Active StateGraph node name (parse_input | route_generator | generate_trellis | generate_comfy3d | exec_cadquery | post_process_mesh | voxelize | export_artifacts | register_artifact).

costJpyMicro.description: Aggregated cost in JPY-micro (1 JPY = 1_000_000 micro). Includes RunPod GPU seconds + LLM tokens + storage egress.

artifacts.description: Materialized artifacts to date. Empty until export_artifacts node completes.

presignedUrl.description: Optional 5-minute presigned download URL minted at query time.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Run id unknown or already pruned (TTL 90d).

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Caller actor_did does not match run.actor_did.

APQC PCF (Process Classification Framework) Level-1 category record. AT Protocol record carrying one of the 13 canonical L1 process categories (v7.4) — `code` is the L1 identifier (e.g. '1.0', '13.0') and is used as the rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_apqc_l1` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the L1 taxonomy without trusting this operator. Level-2 through Level-5 categories follow in later PRs as separate record lexicons (e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apqc.processGroup` for L2) reusing the same scaffold. Sibling lexicons under `com.etzhayyim.apqc.*` (`getProcess`, `materializeSubprocesses`, `coverageSnapshot`, `emitEvent`) remain as active procedures — record-vs-procedure split.

code.description: APQC PCF L1 category identifier (e.g. '1.0', '7.0', '13.0'). Format: digits + '.0' suffix for L1 (sibling levels L2/L3/L4/L5 use '1.1', '1.1.1', etc.; future PRs add separate record lexicons for those levels). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

name.description: Canonical English name of the L1 category.

level.description: PCF hierarchy depth. Always 1 for this lexicon (sentinel — future lexicons set 2/3/4/5).

version.description: APQC PCF version (e.g. '7.4.0'). Locks the record to a published revision so changes in future PCF releases produce new records under different rkeys when the L1 numbering changes.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the category's scope.

themes.description: Optional list of cross-cutting themes the L1 category touches (e.g. 'governance', 'innovation', 'risk'). Absent in the v7.4 baseline seed; reserved for future industry-cross-reference annotations.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was published. Defaults to the v7.4 release date 2023-11-01 unless the seeder overrides.

Mint a child did:etzhayyim under a parent DID. ADR-0029 (revised 2026-04-19) defines two input shapes: (A) semantic path form — `{parentDid, segmentKind, segmentValue}`; (B) legacy hex Merkle form — `{parentDid, materialKind, material}`. New callers should use form (A). `pubkey` kind generates an independent P-256 keypair; other kinds are keyless and sign via the nearest ancestor key. Caller must control parent (session accountDid equal to parent or a prefix ancestor).

parentDid.description: Parent did:etzhayyim. Either legacy flat hex form (did:etzhayyim:{24-hex}) or semantic path form (did:etzhayyim:{sub}:{id}:{lexicon}). Recursive form accepted up to depth 6.

segmentKind.description: ADR-0029 revised (semantic path) form. `sub`: owning cluster label. `id`: local identifier (TID / slug / rkey). `lexicon`: governing NSID. `role`: capability sub-identity. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `grant`: consent / delegate. Mutually exclusive with `materialKind`.

segmentValue.description: Semantic segment value (NSID-compatible). Regex: [a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)*. Required when segmentKind is set.

materialKind.description: ADR-0029 草案 (hex Merkle) form — legacy Phase 1 grandfather path. Kept for existing adopters until they migrate to segmentKind/segmentValue. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `role`: capability DID (requires roleName + holderDid). `matter`: domain entity (requires matterTid). `doc`: content-addressed document (requires docCid). `grant`: consent/delegate (requires granteeDid + grantExpiresAt + grantNonceHex). `session`: one-shot scoped capability (requires parentSessionJti + sessionNonceHex).

material.description: Kind-specific material for legacy materialKind form. Required keys depend on materialKind.

handle.description: Optional handle to attach (typically only for pubkey kind).

did.description: Newly minted child did:etzhayyim (full recursive form).

segmentKind.description: Echo of input segmentKind (semantic form only).

segmentValue.description: Echo of input segmentValue (semantic form only).

materialKind.description: Echo of input materialKind (legacy hex form only).

materialHashProof.description: Hex-encoded materialBytes (legacy hex form only). Verifiers recompute the child hash from this.

Deploy the caller's ERC-4337 smart account on the etzhayyim private chain (chainId 260425) by resolving the caller to an ERC725 root DID, then calling `etzhayyimActorRegistry.activate(rootDidHash, [packedPasskeyPubkey])`. Legacy did:etzhayyim/did:web sessions must already be linked through `etzhayyimRootIdentityRegistry`; this procedure no longer hashes legacy DIDs directly. Caller must hold a session (passkey-first policy). The Worker reads the caller's primary passkey credential from D1 (`passkey_credentials` table), strips the 0x04 prefix from the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 pubkey to get a 64-byte X||Y owner, signs a sealer-sponsored EIP-155 legacy tx with the SEALER_PRIV secret, and submits via `https://geth.etzhayyim.com/eth_sendRawTransaction`. Idempotent on the contract side (re-activating returns the existing address). On success returns the same shape as `getActorAccount`.

main.description: Same-origin, no-server-key auth gate for etzhayyim.com/profile (ADR-2606060000). VERIFIES a member-signed CACAO (CAIP-74) and returns the resolved DID + capability scope so the page can flip into edit-mode WITHOUT a separate auth.etzhayyim.com hop and WITHOUT the Worker holding any key. Three sign-in methods converge on one CACAO: WebAuthn/passkey → Ed25519 did:key (`EdDSA`, verified locally via WebCrypto); wallet/SIWE → did:pkh:eip155 (`eip191`, secp256k1/ERC-1271 recovery delegated to the kotoba node). This is NOT the write-authorization point — the profile mutation is a CACAO-authorized datom:transact to kotoba, whose NonceStore enforces single-use replay protection.

description: Federated LoRA training delta submitted by a smartphone / browser contributor for a single baien training round. Per ADR-2605242600. Append-only TID-keyed; one record per (actorDid, baseModelCid, iter). The aggregator (40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/baien_federated_aggregator) subscribes to the firehose, verifies the ES256 signature against the member's passkey-derived key, re-runs `charter_rider.scan()` on the dataset shard, applies Wellbecoming + Byzantine + DP gates, then merges accepted deltas into the bf16 master. R0 scaffold — aggregator is import-time-failing until Council attestation activates it.

actorDid.description: DID of the member who performed the training step. MUST be an Adherent SBT holder; aggregator rejects non-SBT submissions per ADR-2605242600 G7.

baseModelCid.description: IPFS CID of the frozen BitNet trunk + frozen modality encoders the device trained on. Round-pinned (G10): if this differs from the aggregator's current round base, the delta is invalid.

datasetShardCid.description: IPFS CID of the training-data shard. Resolved via com.etzhayyim.substrate.datasetPin. The aggregator re-runs charter_rider.scan() on this shard before accepting; the device's `scannerPass` is a self-attestation, not the ground truth.

prevAdapterCid.description: IPFS CID of the adapter the device started from (chain-of-revisions, replay defence). For iter=0 this is the empty-adapter CID.

deltaCid.description: IPFS CID of the safetensors blob containing (A_after - A_before, B_after - B_before) for every LoRA-trainable layer (q_proj / k_proj / v_proj / o_proj only).

iter.description: Monotonic round counter per (actorDid, baseModelCid). Aggregator enforces strict monotonicity to defeat replay.

stepCount.description: Number of micro-batch=1 training steps performed locally. Cap enforces the per-round work bound; calibrated to iPhone 12 / Android 4GB / WASM-32 budgets.

deviceClass.description: Device profile used by the aggregator to weight trust priors only. Never used to gate participation — all three classes are first-class contributors per ADR-2605241900 edge invariant.

lossBefore.description: Mean eval-microbench loss BEFORE training, scaled by 1000000 (six decimals of precision; AT Protocol Lexicon v1 forbids float types, so units are 'micro-loss'). Wellbecoming gate (G8) compares lossAfter * 100 >= lossBefore * 98.

lossAfter.description: Mean eval-microbench loss AFTER training, scaled by 1000000 (same units as lossBefore). Aggregator discards deltas where lossAfter * 100 >= lossBefore * 98 (no improvement).

gradNormL2.description: L2 norm of the on-device DP-clipped delta, scaled by 1000000 ('micro-norm' units). The clip threshold tau and the Gaussian noise sigma are applied on-device before this field is recorded. Aggregator rejects deltas with gradNormL2 outside the calibrated band.

scannerPass.description: Self-attestation that the device successfully ran `charter_rider.scan()` on the full dataset shard with <=5% rows dropped. If false, the contributor SHOULD NOT have submitted the delta; aggregator verifies.

trainedAt.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp at the device when training completed. Informational; aggregator uses iter + prevAdapterCid for ordering.

sig.description: ES256 signature over the canonical JSON of all preceding fields, using the member's WebAuthn passkey-derived key (ADR-2605231525). Aggregator verifies against the DID's resolved key material; failure = reject.

notes.description: Optional contributor notes (device model, ambient temperature, etc.). Aggregator does not interpret semantically.

supersededByUri.description: When the contributor reruns the same iter (e.g. corrected data shard), the prior record is soft-superseded by pointing here. Aggregator MUST prefer the live record.

description: Material-event filing header (high-cadence hot-path attestation). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (CorpFilingEventSensor). This lexicon yields HEADERS only — full filing body is referenced via `payloadCid` for the cold-path corpus. ossekai (ADR-2605263600) is the primary aggregate-publication consumer of high-cadence material-event observations.

description: GLEIF LEI canonical entity reference + relationship subset. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (LeiSensor). The LEI is the canonical cross-jurisdiction key — other corp lexicons (`registryAttestation`, `disclosureAttestation`, `ownershipEdge`, `filingEvent`) set their `entityLei` by resolving the local registry ID against records of this type. GLEIF data is CC0 1.0 (Tier-A globally). `parentLei` + `ultimateParentLei` capture GLEIF L2 (Relationship Records) direct + ultimate parent edges when published by the LEI registrant.

description: UBO / parent-subsidiary / control-relationship / officer ownership edge. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (CorpOwnershipSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.corp.corp_ownership_sensor` after passive-only fetch of: GLEIF L2 (Tier-A CC0), EU per-member-state UBO registers (Tier-A per-state license, honoring CJEU C-37/20 + C-601/20 access constraints), US FinCEN BOI (Tier-A when public; W4 re-evaluate), or OpenCorporates open-data fork (Tier-B CC-BY-SA — `-tierB-` infix propagates per ADR-2605263800 G4). The `pctHeld` field is integer basis points 0..10000 for shareholder / UBO edges; NULL for officer + control-edge (no percentage). `asOf` is the published-record observation date.

description: Per-jurisdiction legal-entity registry attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (CorpRegistrySensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.corp.corp_registry_sensor` after a passive-only fetch of an officially-published bulk archive (SEC EDGAR / JP EDINET / UK Companies House / SEDAR+ / ASIC / etc.). The `entityLei` field cross-links to `com.etzhayyim.corp.leiReference` for global cross-jurisdiction key resolution. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605263800: passive-only invariant (no live registry scraping), per-jurisdiction publication-redaction policy honored, vendor commercial-terminal imports (Bloomberg Terminal / Refinitiv / FactSet / Moody's Orbis / D&B Hoovers / Pitchbook / Crunchbase Pro) CONSTITUTIONALLY PROHIBITED per Charter Rider §2(e)+§2(c). Full schema with structural enforcement (per-field consts, vendor-terminal deny-list at lint) lands at W1.

description: G6 memorization-guardrail evaluation report. Emitted at every baien-distill commit_node for creative-foundations recipes. 3-pronged: (a) verbatim regurgitation probe (1000 train-chunk samples; first-half prompt → completion check ≥50-token verbatim match; MUST be ≤100 basis points = 1%); (b) DP-SGD bound (R3+; opacus library; ε ≤8000 milli-epsilon / δ ≤10000 nano-delta); (c) Chromaprint spectral-fingerprint check (audio-modality only; AcoustID library; distance ≥2000 basis points vs non-PD reference hashes). Emission to 90-docs/baien/creative-memorization-eval-{R-step}.jsonl per G10. Failure = commit_node REJECT.

description: Cross-jurisdictional PD-status conflict resolution per work. Captures cases where a work is PD in some jurisdictions but not others (most common: URAA §104A restoration in US for foreign works; CC vs CA pre-2022 deltas; JP pre-2018 vs post-2018 TPP term extension). Pessimistic algorithm REJECTS any work failing PD in even one of 7 required jurisdictions; this Lexicon records the rejection reasoning + future eligibility year.

resolutionVerdict.description: REJECT-pessimistic = default (most cases); ADMIT-pre/post-conflict only after conflict expires across all 7 jurisdictions

description: R3+ orphan-works research-only carve-out. Per ADR-2605265000 N2: orphan works (works whose copyright holder cannot be identified or located) are NEVER admitted to baien-distill training corpus. R3+ permits research-only access (NOT training) via Council Lv6+ ≥3 per-work attestation. Diligent-search MUST be documented per US Copyright Office Orphan Works Best Practices 2015. Work MUST be ≥95 years old (US 1923 + 5-yr safety buffer). researchOnlyNotTrainingAttested const true STRUCTURAL.

workEstimatedYear.description: G STRUCTURAL: work MUST be ≥95 yr old (current year - 95); for 2026, maximum = 1931

workMinAgeYears.description: STRUCTURAL: ≥95 yr safety buffer (US 1923 rule + 5 yr)

Documentation MUST include: search of US Copyright Office records / WATCH file / VIAF / national-library catalogs / Google + alternative search engines / professional registries / industry directories / good-faith outreach attempts (where contact information available)

description: Per-work public-domain status attestation. Core admission gate for the creative-pd substrate (films / video / music / audio). G1 STRUCTURAL: pdStatusByJurisdiction MUST cover ≥7 jurisdictions {USA, EUR, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, CHN}; per-jurisdiction status enum is REJECT if any is not 'public-domain' or 'creative-commons-zero'. G2 STRUCTURAL: pessimisticThresholdYearsPostMortem ≥70 (EU/UK/JP-post-2018/AU baseline). G3 STRUCTURAL: for modality enum {'music-recording', 'audio-speech', 'audio-sound', 'film', 'video'} both compositionPdStatus AND recordingPdStatus required; symbolic-only ('music-symbolic') sidesteps recording dual-attestation. description: G7 Charter Rider §2(d) per-work Wellbecoming framing scan. R1 manual per-work review (reviewer DID + reasoning); R2+ rule-encoded auto-flag heuristics route to Council Lv6+ ≥3 queue. Pre-1929 works with US Southern setting / WWI+WWII newsreels / 1920s exotic travelogue / pre-1955 advertising = auto-flag categories. Verdict enum: admit / admit-with-context (requires Council Lv6+ ≥3) / exclude. Manual override path preserved at all R-phases.

description: Typed FACTUAL edge between two open-government records, or between a gov.dataset record and a corp identity-registry entity, computed by danjo_crossref_engine. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3. Each link cites the public basis of the assertion; it is the substrate from which danjo.discrepancyObservation records are derived. NON-adjudicating: a link asserts a factual relationship (e.g. 'awardeeLei X is a control-edge of officialEntity Y per GLEIF L2 / OpenCorporates'), never wrongdoing.

fromRef.description: Source side: a gov.dataset.* record CID/at-uri OR a corp registry entity id (LEI)

confidence.description: Match basis. `name-normalized-candidate` (fuzzy) MUST NOT alone ground an `elevated`-severity observation.

description: Factual, source-cited, NON-adjudicating discrepancy observation emitted by a danjo cross-reference cell over the open-government corpus (ADR-2605263900). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3/§4; ref-typed nesting added (R1 hardening = additionalProperties:false + required-field enforcement). CONSTITUTIONAL: this record states a FACTUAL cross-reference only — it MUST NOT assert that a crime / law violation / 不正 occurred (G4 UPL-equivalent). `nonAdjudicatingNotice` is required and MUST be true; the `category` enum contains NO crime/violation/guilt value (a legal verdict is unrepresentable at the schema layer). `sourceRecordCids` MUST contain ≥2 upstream gov.dataset.* record CIDs (G5). `methodNoteCid` is required (G6 open method). Named parties (G10) are structured via #namedPartyRef: a party may be named ONLY by citing the public source record that already names them. Legal characterization routes to external counsel via chigiri + Public Fund (Council Lv6+).

sourceCellDid.description: DID of the danjo cell that computed the observation

category.description: FACTUAL cross-reference category ONLY. No crime/violation/guilt value exists (G4).

severity.description: Routing/review weight ONLY; severity is NOT a finding of wrongdoing. `elevated` gates named-party publication review (G10).

description.description: Human-readable FACTUAL statement of the cross-reference; passes PII filter (G9). MUST NOT contain legal-conclusion language.

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥2 upstream gov.dataset.* record CIDs that ground this observation (G5)

crossReferenceLinkCids.description: danjo.crossReferenceLink record CIDs supporting the observation

methodNoteCid.description: danjo.methodNote record CID defining the open, versioned detector heuristic (G6)

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: MUST be true. Asserts this is a factual cross-reference, NOT a legal verdict (G4).

namedParties.description: Names ONLY where the source records already name the party publicly AND severity-gated + Council-reviewed (G10). Each entry MUST cite the public record that names them. Empty at R0/R1.

externalCounselReferralCid.description: If legal characterization is sought: the chigiri-routed external-counsel engagement CID. danjo itself renders NO opinion (G4).

description: Open, versioned definition of ONE danjo detector heuristic. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §4 G6 (open method). Every danjo.discrepancyObservation MUST cite the methodNote CID of the heuristic that produced it, so the public can audit the DETECTOR itself, not only its output. No closed / secret scoring is permitted. Analogous to toritate's open valuation reference tables (ADR-2605301020).

description: Periodic AGGREGATE public-accountability transparency report assembled by danjo_oversight_report. Aggregate-first (G10): publishes patterns over a reporting period via #aggregateStat; named-party content (#namedPartyEntry) permitted ONLY where source records already name the party publicly AND severity-gated + Council-reviewed under 1 SBT = 1 vote (G10/G11), each entry carrying its gate evidence. Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain; IPFS-pinned (replication ≥2). NON-adjudicating: the report summarizes factual cross-references and any external-counsel referrals; it renders no verdict (G4).

description: Per-recipient key-wrap for an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record. Symmetric record key encrypted under a Signal session between sender DID and recipient DID. Recipient enumerates this collection in their own PDS to discover read-caps. One keyWrap record per (encrypted record, recipient) pair. Per ADR-2605181100.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the encrypted record this key unlocks. Optional — recipient can also discover records by enumerating keyId matches.

ciphertext.description: libsignal-encrypted (symmetric record key). Decrypts via the established Signal session between sender and recipient.

signalSessionId.description: Identifier of the Signal session under which `ciphertext` was produced. Recipient SDK uses this to select the correct session for decrypt.

pqSuite.description: Post-quantum hybrid suite identifier (ADR-2606111300). When present, the wrap key derives from the pqh-v1 hybrid handshake below instead of a pre-established session.

pqX25519Ephemeral.description: pqh-v1: sender's ephemeral X25519 public key (32 bytes).

pqMlkemCiphertext.description: pqh-v1: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) ciphertext against the recipient's published pqMlkemPublicKey (1088 bytes).

description: Tahoe-pattern AEAD ciphertext envelope on AT Protocol MST. Plaintext is an arbitrary CBOR-encoded record (typically an inner-lexicon body). The CID over this envelope inherits the MST verify-cap and L2 anchor finality from ADR-2605172000. Read-cap = symmetric key (XChaCha20-Poly1305) distributed via com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap. Per ADR-2605181100.

nonce.description: AEAD nonce, unique per record. 24 bytes for XChaCha20-Poly1305.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext over CBOR(plaintext). AAD MUST bind the record's own CID to prevent intra-MST swap attacks.

innerType.description: Lexicon NSID describing the plaintext body shape after decryption. Optional metadata for routing/UI; not authoritative until plaintext is decoded and validated.

keyId.description: Hash prefix (base32 hex, first 16 chars) of the symmetric key. Recipients use this to locate the matching com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap record in their own PDS.

pad.description: Padding scheme applied to plaintext before AEAD. Omitted = no padding. Per ADR-2605181200.

sender.description: DID that authored this encrypted record. Verifiable against the PDS commit signature.

ciphertextBlob.description: Out-of-line ciphertext for payloads larger than the inline 1 MiB limit. If set, the inline ciphertext field is empty and decryption reads the IPFS-pinned blob instead.

description: DID ↔ Signal identity binding. Published by an actor in their own PDS to assert which libsignal IdentityKey is canonical for their DID. The signature, verifiable against the DID document's signing key, prevents a malicious PDS from substituting a different Signal identity. Per ADR-2605181100.

did.description: Self-DID. MUST equal the repo owner.

signalIdentityKey.description: libsignal IdentityKey public component. 32 bytes Curve25519.

signalRegistrationId.description: libsignal registration id (14-bit per Signal protocol).

signedPreKey.description: libsignal signed pre-key public component. Optional — apps without offline-first sender requirement may omit.

signedPreKeySignature.description: libsignal Curve25519 signature over signedPreKey, by signalIdentityKey.

pqX25519PublicKey.description: pqh-v1: actor's X25519 KEM public key (32 bytes). Covered by the binding signature(s).

pqMlkemPublicKey.description: pqh-v1: actor's ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) encapsulation key (1184 bytes). Covered by the binding signature(s).

signature.description: Signature over CBOR({did, signalIdentityKey, signalRegistrationId, signedPreKey?, signedPreKeyId?, signedPreKeySignature?, pqSuite?, pqX25519PublicKey?, pqMlkemPublicKey?, createdAt}) by the DID document's signing key. Verifier MUST resolve the DID document fresh.

pqSignature.description: pqh-v1: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signature over the SAME canonical CBOR bytes as `signature`. Verifiers that know the DID's ML-DSA verification key MUST require it (no downgrade-stripping). ~3309 bytes.

main.description: Tombstone for a logical record that has been rekeyed or 'deleted'. AT Protocol MST is append-only — a tombstone is the only operationally meaningful 'delete' on the substrate. It binds the prior envelope CID to either (a) a successor envelope CID (rekey), (b) a 'redacted' marker (logical delete; no successor), or (c) a 'sealed' marker (key destroyed; ciphertext intentionally orphaned). Per ADR-2605231603.

supersededCid.description: CID of the previous com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope being tombstoned

supersededKeyId.description: keyId of the previous envelope (matches keyWrap.keyId)

supersededAtUri.description: AT URI of the previous envelope record

tombstoneType.description: rekey: a successor envelope with a fresh sym_key exists. redact: logical delete, no successor. sealed: key intentionally destroyed (e.g. revocation of all key-wraps + sender forgets the sym_key).

successorCid.description: CID of the successor envelope (REQUIRED when tombstoneType='rekey')

scope.description: single-record tombstones one envelope. channel-window tombstones every envelope written by `actorDid` in the inclusive time window [windowStart, windowEnd]. group-rekey tombstones every envelope whose recipient set included the removed member.

actorDid.description: DID issuing the tombstone — MUST be the original sender for rekey/sealed, or a charter-authorized actor (e.g. Council) for regulator-order

auditWebhookDids.description: DIDs that should receive an com.etzhayyim.audit.event for this tombstone

main.description: A tenure-weighted IN-KIND sustenance allocation for a maintainer. The charter-clean inverse of a cap-table line: an instrument from the sustenance set ONLY (G1 — no equity/debt/ROI/exit), cash structurally 0 (G2), member/Council-signed (G9). A 'share' governs onboarding PRIORITY + the in-kind floor, never a cash split.

instrument.description: G1 INVARIANT — equity / debt / convertible / revenue-share / profit-claim / carry / dividend / exit are NOT enum members (not an investment fund, Charter-Rider §2(b)).

weightMilli.description: w×1000 (implied unit: milli) where w = ln(1+min(tenure_y,40)) * hazard

shareBps.description: basis points of cohort PRIORITY (Σ==10000 over vowed cohort); never a cash split

priorityRank.description: 1 = provisioned first under a scarce stage cap

floorUsdMicrosYr.description: in-kind sustenance floor at elapsed=0, stage-capped, 5y decay

cashUsdMicros.description: G2 / cash≡0 INVARIANT — only 0 (the on-chain N1 proof).

main.description: R1(d) — the Displacement-Dividend coupling record. A displacing actor's surplus → donation → TitheRouter 10% split → a per-cohort Public-Fund earmark, which is the imputed-value BUDGET CEILING 扶持's in-kind sustenance for that cohort draws on. G2 coupling gate (ADR-2606032130): no live displacement without a funded cohort — admissible only if funded AND committed ≤ earmark. The surplus→donation is real USDC inflow; what the maintainer receives stays in-kind (cash≡0 enforced at the allocation layer).

displacingActor.description: the actor whose automation displaces toil

grossUsdMicrosYr.description: gross surplus donation; grossUsdMicrosYr = titheUsdMicros + earmarkUsdMicrosYr (exact)

earmarkUsdMicrosYr.description: 90% per-cohort earmark — the budget ceiling for in-kind sustenance

funded.description: G2 — true only when the surplus→donation has landed in the Public Fund

committedUsdMicrosYr.description: the in-kind sustenance floor committed to this cohort; must be ≤ earmark

admissible.description: G2 coupling gate — true iff funded AND committed ≤ earmark; else the displacement is REFUSED

main.description: The governance outcome for an allocation. 扶持 ROUTES (a pure function of imputed-total + invariant-touch + Charter-Rider hit) but NEVER decides accept/reject — the 1 SBT = 1 vote or Council decides (G7, 非裁定, the ake pattern). A Charter-Rider §2 hit is :refused (no vote can promote it).

route.description: G7 INVARIANT — a PURE FUNCTION of (imputed-total, invariant-touch, rider). No model / operator decides this; :decision does not exist.

main.description: A 信者 maintainer's covenant attestation — the eligibility gate for sustenance. NOT an investor agreement: no equity, no return, no ownership of payoff (G4/G5). Member-signed (no-server-key, G9).

covenant.description: G4 INVARIANT — only outreach | vowed. anon / server are NOT enum members (conversion-gated §1.16, no-server-key).

tenureMonths.description: 勤続 months of mission service → :maintainer/tenure-months

maintains.description: actor handles this maintainer keeps alive

priorImputedUsdMicrosYr.description: in-kind valuation of prior sustenance only; NEVER cash

ownsPayoff.description: G5 INVARIANT — only false. The maintainer's work product is commons (payoff帰属 = etzhayyim).

main.description: R1(a) — an IN-KIND provisioning intent addressed to a real producing actor / commons / infra (mitsuho food / hikari energy / commons-land housing / Murakumo compute / okaimono tooling / iyashi care / warifu liquidity). A dry-run: published is structurally false (G10), cash is 0 (G2), server-held-key is false (G9). The liquidity intent is member-principal (the member borrows via warifu 0% qard-ḥasan; 扶持 never holds, lends, or pays).

providerDid.description: the producing actor DID / commons / infra ref

memberPrincipal.description: G3b — true only for liquidity-warifu (member is borrower/payer)

published.description: G10 INVARIANT — only false at R0/R1; live provisioning is Council Lv6+ + operator gated.

main.description: The decomposition of an allocation into IN-KIND delivery rails over the existing producing actors / commons. The honest answer to 'maintainers need to live': needs are met in kind; the irreducible external fiat residual is routed ONLY as MEMBER-PRINCIPAL 0% warifu liquidity — 扶持 is never the creditor or the payer (G3, §1.3 holds without amendment).

kind.description: G3 INVARIANT — cash-disbursement is NOT an enum member; every rail is in-kind OR member-principal 0% liquidity.

providerActor.description: the producing actor / commons that delivers (mitsuho / hikari / commons-land / okaimono / warifu …)

memberPrincipal.description: G3b — true only for liquidity-warifu: the MEMBER is the borrower/payer (qard ḥasan 0%); 扶持 never holds, lends, or pays.

main.description: R1(c) — the booking of an accepted in-kind allocation. Projects INTO toritate's ledgerEntry category enum (ADR-2605262900): subsistence-flow / vocation-flow / care-flow / liberation-flow / grant. cashStipendUsd ≡ 0 (toritate N1); payroll / salary / wage are unrepresentable. Also carries the kanae-renderable flow class for the internal sustenance-flow graph (NOT the government fundFlowEdge). The member-principal liquidity rail is NOT booked as income (it is a member warifu loan, not a Public-Fund disbursement).

cashUsdMicros.description: G2 — toritate cashStipendUsd ≡ 0 (Basic High Income N1).

main.description: A maintainer's in-kind sustenance NEED line (housing/food/energy/compute/tooling/care/liquidity), valued by imputed worth. The unit of sustenance, never of income — cash is structurally 0 (G2, Basic High Income in-kind, ADR-2605301020).

main.description: R1(b) — a single 1 SBT = 1 vote ballot on an escalated allocation. Each member DID casts exactly ONE ballot (1 SBT = 1 vote); weight is always 1 (no token-weighted plutocracy); ballots are member-signed (no-server-key, G9). The tally finalizes only after the 48h timelock window elapses; a ballot cast outside [openedAt, openedAt+timelockH] is not counted.
