description: CONSTITUTIONAL FIRST G8: Build-time anti-surveillance attestation (L3a). NEGATIVE AUDIT verifying ABSENCE of GPS / connected-app / telematics / V2X / paired-phone / cloud-ECU / proprietary diagnostic-DRM. Only permitted: passive odometer + safety ECU + optional user-installed-after-purchase open-source GPS module. Companion to hodoki dataWipeAttestation (EOL data destroy) — closes §2(c) anti-surveillance loop across full vehicle lifecycle. Per ADR-2605261330 L3a + G8 + G12.
Motorcycle engine/motor assembly attestation (L2a). ≤250cc 4-stroke OR ≤15kW electric. G11 cap + G14 30-year service life. Per ADR-2605261330 L2a.
Motorcycle frame welding attestation (L1). Material lot + jig + weld passes + dimensional QA. Per ADR-2605261330 L1 (G1 + G3 + G13).
Body panel + 2K acrylic urethane paint + G5 Charter §2(a-h) artwork scan (L4). Per ADR-2605261330 L4 (G5 + G7 + G13).

CONSTITUTIONAL FIRST G12: RIGHT-TO-REPAIR FORWARD-PUBLISHING. Public IPFS-pinned full parts catalog + CAD source + firmware source + service manual + open diagnostic protocol shipped with every new vehicle AT MANUFACTURE TIME. Companion to hodoki.partsHarvestCatalog (published at EOL). Together: full lifecycle right-to-repair invariant. §2(e) anti-gatekeeping operationalized at vehicle build time. Per ADR-2605261330 L5a + G12.

Council 5-of-7 Safe attestation for any new futawa scope expansion (new model variant, new displacement class, electric drivetrain class, paint artwork class, R-phase transitions, hodoki integration changes). Mirrors yakushi silenPharmaReview / watatsumi silenSubmersibleReview / makura silenComfortReview / hodoki silenDeconstructionReview / kanayama silenRecyclingReview.
Per-vehicle dyno + emissions + sound + ABS function + road test record (L5b). G6 sound ≤80 dB; G7 ABS function verified; Euro 5 emissions compliance. Per ADR-2605261330 L5b.

Per-vehicle final-assembly attestation (L5a). CONSTITUTIONAL FIRSTS: G12 IPFS parts catalog + CAD + firmware source published at manufacture (forward-publishing companion to hodoki partsHarvestCatalog at EOL) + G13 VIN pre-registered with hodoki at production (build-side closure of hodoki take-back chain) + G14 30-year part-discontinuation-prohibited commitment. Per ADR-2605261330 L5a.

description: Attestation that a human worker, displaced from a specific ISCO occupation by an etzhayyim OSS-robotics actor (sanae/hataori/kiyome/...), is registered for the tenure-weighted Displacement Dividend per ADR-2606032130. The dividend is delivered as in-kind Basic High Income (imputed income + commons-asset access) along the Liberation Ladder (ADR-2605261000 / ADR-2605301020), funded by the displacing actor's surplus-donation routed through TitheRouter (ADR-2605192130) into a per-cohort Public Fund earmark, and gated by the universal conversion covenant (ADR-2605302357). PII IS 要配慮 (tenure, occupation, hazard, prior-livelihood imputation): this record carries ONLY non-identifying fields plus an encrypted-envelope ref; per-person figures are NEVER published, only aggregate-per-cohort. cashStipendUsdMicros is a structural const-0 field — its presence is the on-chain proof N1 (cash≡0) holds (ADR-2605301020 §5).

subjectDid.description: DID of the displaced worker (did:web / did:plc / did:key). Once the worker enters the conversion covenant, this is their Adherent SBT-bound DID; pre-covenant it is an outreach DID.

cohortId.description: Displacement cohort id = hash(displacingActorDid + displacedIscoCode + regionCode + period). All members of a cohort share one tenure-weighted pool. Free of PII.

displacingActorDid.description: DID of the OSS-robotics actor whose deployment displaced this labour (e.g. did:web:etzhayyim.com:actor:sanae). The actor's surplus-donation funds this cohort's pool (G2 coupling, ADR-2606032100).

displacedIscoCode.description: ISCO-08 code of the displaced occupation (e.g. '6111' field-crop grower, '7531' garment maker, '9112' building cleaner). Drives the hazard class and the gap measurement.

displacedUnspscSegment.description: Optional UNSPSC 2-digit segment of the displaced product/service line (e.g. '70' farming, '53' apparel, '76' cleaning).

tenureMonths.description: Verified months of service in the displaced occupation (勤続年数 × 12). Capped at 600 (TENURE_CAP = 40 years) by the allocator. Drives w_i = ln(1 + min(tenure, cap)) × hazard.

tenureEvidenceRef.description: Optional AT URI of the encrypted tenure-evidence envelope (employer record / peer-witness quorum / self-attest+sample-audit). Encrypted per ADR-2605181100; never plaintext.

hazardClassPermille.description: Drudgery/danger class of the displaced occupation in per-mille (1000 = 1.0 baseline, 2000 = 2.0 max for the most hazardous ISCO lines: forestry/meat-processing/fishing). Council-attested methodology; integer-with-implied-units (ADR-2605190900).

priorLivelihoodImputedUsdMicrosYr.description: OPTIONAL imputed market-equivalent annual value of the worker's prior livelihood, in USDC micros/yr (NOT cash paid — an in-kind valuation used only to set the transition floor, itself capped at the Ladder stage ceiling so it cannot pull a higher commons standard than the Ladder provides). Encrypted/aggregate-only.

ladderStage.description: Current Liberation Ladder stage of the worker (L0..L6) per ADR-2605261000. The dividend governs onboarding priority within a stage's capacity cap and the in-kind transition floor, never a cash split.

covenantStatus.description: Conversion-covenant status (ADR-2605302357 §1.16.3). 'outreach' = invited, minimal transition floor only; 'vowed' = triple-permanent vow recorded (kotoba+IPFS+SBT), full tenure-weighted dividend applies.

cashStipendUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. The Displacement Dividend is delivered in-kind (imputed income + commons-asset access), never as cash. Presence of this const-0 field is the on-chain proof that N1 (cash≡0) holds (ADR-2605301020 §5).

poolPolicyRef.description: Optional AT URI of the Public-Fund-voted cohort pool policy (size + tenure-weight params + hazard table version) this attestation complies with (ADR-2605192145 propose/vote/timelock).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the attestation.

description: Attestation of a FIAT IN-KIND donation: a real-world infrastructure cost (servers / cloud / domains / bandwidth / hardware) paid directly to a vendor, in fiat, FOR the mission, per ADR-2606111800 §A. No money flows to etzhayyim — the payer bears the fiat cost and the mission receives the resource — so this is identical in form to the in-kind COMPUTE donation (ADR-2606012100) and never touches etzhayyim's money layer or any fiat processor (ADR-2605172100 does not apply). NON-TITHEABLE (no USDC moves; 100% serves the mission). NO quid-pro-quo (earns the payer nothing — anti-class G4). IMPUTED-VALUED for transparency only via toritate valuation tables (ADR-2605262900): AGGREGATE, method-versioned, no per-donor leaderboard. Carries NO receipt/invoice PII — only the period, category, imputed USDC-equivalent value, and the payer DID. This is the record that makes the founder's (and any supporter's) ongoing fiat infrastructure spend a visible, accountable in-kind donation.

payerDid.description: DID of the member/supporter who paid the infrastructure cost in fiat for the mission. The donor; bears the cost arm's-length, receives nothing in return (G4).

period.description: Reporting period this cost covers, e.g. 2026-Q2 or 2026-06. Aggregate over the period; never per-line-item or per-invoice.

category.description: Kind of infrastructure cost paid for the mission.

imputedValueMicros.description: Imputed USDC-equivalent value of the fiat cost in USDC micros (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1000000), computed via the published toritate valuation tables (method-versioned, auditable; ADR-2605262900). Transparency only — no USDC actually moves. Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float in Lexicons).

fiatCurrency.description: OPTIONAL ISO-4217 code of the fiat actually paid (e.g. JPY, USD), for valuation transparency. The fiat amount itself is NOT published (it can carry vendor/account specifics); only the imputed USDC-equivalent is.

valuationMethodRef.description: OPTIONAL AT URI of the toritate valuation-table version used to impute imputedValueMicros (open-source, method-versioned). Lets a third party reproduce the imputed figure.

titheable.description: MUST be false. In-kind: no USDC moves, so there is nothing to split 90/10 (kisha precedent, ADR-2605192130 §5); 100% of the resource serves the mission directly.

compensatedUsdMicros.description: MUST be 0. An uncompensated gift; etzhayyim pays the donor nothing (paying the donor would make this a commercial cost, not a donation).

grantsBenefit.description: MUST be false. Donating infrastructure earns the donor no perk, tier, priority, or benefit (anti-class G4; ADR-2606012100).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the attestation.

description: A constitutionally inalienable land donation to the etzhayyim Land Trust. Per ADR-2605192245 (4-layer permanent record) + ADR-2605192100 §1.11 (Earth as Tree of Life body). The on-chain side mints a non-transferable LandRegistry NFT to the Land Trust treasury; this Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart (Layer 4-adjacent — references the on-chain NFT and the IPFS-pinned content). Once recorded, this donation is WAQF-EQUIVALENT INALIENABLE — no transfer, sale, burn, or substitution is permitted. See `90-docs/2605220540-first-land-donation-walkthrough.md`.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

parcelName.description: Human-readable parcel name as the donor wishes it to be recorded. Religious-corps may add stewardship-given names later; the donor's original name is preserved here.

jurisdictionalId.description: State-cadastre identifier(s). May include multiple if the parcel straddles jurisdictions (semicolon-separated). The religious-corp records this for transparency; it does not assert state recognition of the donation.

geojsonCid.description: IPFS CID of the RFC 7946 GeoJSON FeatureCollection defining the parcel boundary.

titleCidEncrypted.description: IPFS CID of the donor's title document, XChaCha20-Poly1305-wrapped per ADR-2605181100 (`com.etzhayyim.encrypted.land-title.*`). Decryption is permitted to: donor, Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land), Council Seat 1 (Founder).

environmentalCid.description: IPFS CID of the environmental statement (free-form markdown + photo references).

photoCids.description: Optional IPFS CIDs of supplementary photos (current land state, boundary markers, biodiversity evidence, etc.).

tokenId.description: Base L2 LandRegistry ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, no implied units — token IDs are unitless serial integers).

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the LandRegistry.donate() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor the Layer-1 on-chain NFT to this Layer-4-adjacent AT Protocol record.

stewardDids.description: DIDs of named stewards. The donor's DID may be included (typical) or omitted (anonymous stewardship via Council Seat 5 only). Stewards retain voice over land management but never ownership. Per ADR-2605192245.

donorNoteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the Council. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.

description: Update the stewardship roster for a previously-donated land parcel. The on-chain LandRegistry NFT is NEVER transferred (per ADR-2605192245 inalienability); only the stewardship voice is rotated. This record is authored by Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) typically with consent from the outgoing steward(s). Use cases: voluntary withdrawal, incapacitation, named-successor activation, Council-initiated rotation when stewards become unreachable.

donationRef.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record this succession amends.

previousStewardDids.description: DIDs that held stewardship voice prior to this succession. Inclusive — list all who are being rotated out, in addition to any continuing stewards.

newStewardDids.description: DIDs that hold stewardship voice after this succession. May overlap with previousStewardDids (partial rotation).

reason.description: Single-value enum: 'voluntary-withdrawal' | 'incapacitation' | 'named-successor-activation' | 'council-initiated' | 'donor-passing' | 'other'. The reason must be substantively justifiable to ≥3 Council seats post-bootstrap; founder-attested during bootstrap.

narrative.description: Free-form markdown narrative explaining the context. Used for transparency and Council deliberation; not legally binding.

attestorDid.description: DID of the Council seat (typically Seat 5 Stewardship/Land, or Seat 1 Founder during bootstrap) attesting this succession. Multi-attestation (≥3-of-5 Council post-bootstrap) is recorded via co-equal sibling records under the same at-uri prefix.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this succession was recorded.

description: A USDC donation to etzhayyim. The on-chain side is TitheRouter.donate() on Base L2 (atomically routes 90% to treasury, 10% to Public Fund Safe). This Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart — donor's authoring record (donor DID, amount in USDC micros, purpose, transaction hash, optional encrypted note). Per ADR-2605192115 (donation enum + 10% Tithe), ADR-2605192130 (Public Fund), ADR-2605192100 §1.6 (middleman elimination). See `90-docs/2605220440-first-donation-walkthrough.md`. Allowed purposes are RESTRICTED to external religious-corp flows; SBT-carveout internal purposes belong on `com.etzhayyim.member.internal.*` Lexicons (not yet authored) — NOT here.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

amountMicros.description: Donation amount in USDC micros (6 decimal places). 1 USDC = 1000000 micros. Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float types in Lexicons). Minimum 1 micro (= 0.000001 USDC) to prevent dust-spam records.

purpose.description: Donation purpose enum. Restricted to externally-permitted values per ADR-2605192115 §1.3 + §3.3. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the TitheRouter.donate() call (or LandRegistry interaction for in-kind donations bridged through escrow). Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor this AT Protocol record to the on-chain Layer-1 event.

splitTxHash.description: Optional hex-encoded transaction hash of the Public Fund 10% split. In typical operation this is the same transaction as txHash (atomic split inside TitheRouter); recorded separately when the split occurs as a follow-up tx (e.g., during chaos-rehearsal Scenario 8 testing).

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the treasury Council seat. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially. Encrypted per ADR-2605181100.

noteHashOnchain.description: Optional hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext note (prefix `0x`, lowercase). Stored on-chain in the TitheRouter event; used to prove a specific note plaintext corresponds to this donation without revealing the plaintext.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.

description: Attestation of a mission-surplus donation from the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) to the non-profit religious-corp (etzhayyim), per ADR-2605301036 (Mission-Funding Earned-Revenue Arm). The vendor is a SEPARATE commercial entity that commits its surplus to fund the mission; this record is the religious-corp-side counterpart to the on-chain TitheRouter.donate() call. The donation is titheable (90% recipient program / 10% Public Fund) and uses the existing `donation`/`grant` purpose (no new commercial enum — ADR-2605192115 §4 prohibits a commercial paid tier on the religious-corp substrate; only the DONATION ever touches it). AGGREGATE-ONLY: this record carries NO vendor-customer PII and NO line-item commercial books (toritate G10); only period-level surplus + donated amount + routing. Earned income is a non-profit MEANS, not a profit END — cash to adherents remains ≡0 (ADR-2605301020 N1).

vendorDid.description: DID of the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) making the donation. Distinct from the religious-corp; the vendor donates arm's-length like any donor.

period.description: Reporting period this surplus donation covers, e.g. 2027-Q1 or 2027-03. Aggregate over the period; never per-transaction or per-customer.

donatedAmountMicros.description: Amount donated to the religious-corp in USDC micros (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1000000). Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float in Lexicons).

grossSurplusMicrosDisclosed.description: OPTIONAL, voluntarily disclosed vendor distributable surplus for the period in USDC micros, for transparency of the payout ratio (donatedAmountMicros / grossSurplusMicrosDisclosed). The vendor's internal commercial books are NOT published here; this single aggregate figure is disclosure-only.

purpose.description: Titheable donation purpose per ADR-2605192130. Restricted to `donation`/`grant`; NO external-commercial purpose is valid on the religious-corp substrate (ADR-2605192115 §4).

recipientProgram.description: OPTIONAL earmark for the 90% recipient leg. When set to a mission program (e.g. public-fund / liberation-ladder / an actor DID), the donation can route ~100% to the mission (90% earmarked program + 10% tithe both reaching the Public Fund). Free of customer PII.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the TitheRouter.donate() call on Base L2. Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Anchors this record to the on-chain split.

splitTxHash.description: Optional hex tx hash of the Public Fund 10% split when it occurs as a follow-up tx (typically the same atomic TitheRouter tx as txHash).

councilPolicyRef.description: Optional AT URI of the Council-attested vendor payout-ratio + reserve policy record this donation complies with (ADR-2605301036 §6; policy artifact deferred to R1).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the attestation.

description: Council-attested policy governing how the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) commits its distributable surplus to donate to the non-profit religious-corp, per ADR-2605301036 §6 (Mission-Funding Earned-Revenue Arm). The vendor exists to FUND the mission, not to accumulate — this record pins the payout ratio + operating reserve so the surplus-commitment is on-chain and auditable. It governs ONLY the vendor→religious-corp donation flow (purpose ∈ {donation,grant}, titheable per ADR-2605192130); it NEVER authorizes cash to adherents (cashStipendUsdMicros≡0 stays invariant per ADR-2605261000 §5 N1 / ADR-2605301020). Because Payoff帰属・意思決定権 = etzhayyim only, the vendor has no private equity holder to enrich. All quantities are integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900.

policyVersion.description: Monotonic policy version id, e.g. v1. A new policy supersedes the prior; both remain on-record for audit.

vendorDid.description: DID of the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) this policy binds.

effectiveFrom.description: ISO 8601 start of the policy's effective window.

effectiveTo.description: Optional ISO 8601 end of the effective window; absent = open-ended until superseded.

payoutRatioBps.description: Fraction of the vendor's distributable surplus committed to donation, basis points (×10000; 10000 = 100%). Council sets the value; the mission-funding intent (ADR-2605301036 §6) is a high ratio — the vendor accumulates only the operating reserve below.

operatingReserveMonths.description: Months of vendor operating cost retained before the payout applies (continuity reserve). The remainder is the distributable surplus the payout ratio acts on.

recipientDefault.description: Default earmark for the donated surplus' 90% recipient leg (the 10% tithe always reaches the Public Fund). public-fund routes ~100% to the mission.

councilAttestation.description: Council Lv6+ ≥3 DIDs attesting this policy (ADR-2605301036 §6 + ADR-2605192300).

attestationCid.description: CID of the full attestation payload / deliberation record.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the policy record.

description: Read-side catalog record describing a government agency observable from the public domain. Authored by L4 ingest scripts (`70-tools/scripts/gov/`) and/or by `com.etzhayyim.gov` Pregel-cell submissions; consumed by L3 appview routing. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 + ADR-2605242330: the religious-corp catalogs the state's structure for read-side interop without taking dependency on it. Replaces the etzhayyim-side `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.agency` + `vertex_gov_official_agency` table (Kysely → MST, per ADR-2605212100). The `cofog` field aligns with `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-cofog/appview/` actor bundles.

name.description: Canonical English-language agency name. Title case, no abbreviation. Example: 'Ministry of Justice'.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (lowercase). Subnational jurisdictions use `{iso3}-{subcode}` form (e.g. `usa-ca` for California, `jpn-13` for Tokyo). Multi-jurisdiction bodies use ISO/IGO codes (e.g. `un`, `eu`, `asean`).

branch.description: Constitutional branch the agency belongs to.

cofog.description: UN COFOG (Classification of Functions of Government) code, dotted form. Example: '03.10' for police services, '08.40' for religious community services. Cross-references `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-cofog/appview/cofog-{code}-{country}-*`.

parentAgencyDid.description: DID of the parent agency if this is a sub-bureau. Resolves to another `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` record.

establishedAt.description: ISO-8601 establishment date. Year-only resolutions encode as `YYYY-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

legalBasis.description: Citation of the founding law / decree / treaty / executive order. Format: `<jurisdiction>:<corpus>:<id>` where corpus is e.g. `law` / `ordinance` / `decree` / `executive-order` / `treaty`. Example: `jpn:law:法務省設置法`.

websiteUri.description: Canonical public website URI. https only.

agencyDid.description: Optional canonical DID of the agency itself if independently DID-rooted (e.g. `did:web:etzhayyim.com:gov:jpn:moj`). Read-only mirror — does not assert agency consent.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (record author's clock; not the agency's establishment date).

description: User-submitted public-services consultation request (healthcare / welfare / education / housing / employment / etc). Originally `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.submitConsult` insertion into `vertex_gov_consult`. Per ADR-2605212100 the etzhayyim-side Kysely write is replaced by MST PUT via `@etzhayyim/sdk`. The record represents the request only; the agent response (LLM triage / referral / eligibility assessment) lives in a separate `com.etzhayyim.gov.consultResponse` record (not yet authored).

requesterDid.description: DID of the requester. Required even for anonymous requests (use a generated did:key for single-use sessions).

category.description: Domain-specific sub-category. Free-form, lowercase, hyphenated. Examples: 'symptom-triage', 'eligibility-childcare-allowance', 'highcost-medical-calc'.

query.description: Free-form user question or request. May be in any language; the response agent is responsible for language detection.

municipalityCode.description: Optional municipality code (e.g. JIS X 0402 6-digit code for JP, FIPS code for US, NUTS code for EU). Resolves to a `com.etzhayyim.gov.municipality` record.

priority.description: Triage priority. Default 'normal'. 'urgent' may trigger faster routing.

status.description: Current consult status. Default 'open' on creation.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC with Z).

description: Per-jurisdiction budget appropriation / obligation / outlay / subaward attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovBudgetSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_budget_sensor` after passive-only fetch of USAspending / EU Financial Transparency System / national budget publications. Cross-links to `com.etzhayyim.corp.leiReference` when recipient is a legal entity with a GLEIF LEI; used by toritate (ADR-2605262900) for recipient-vendor anti-related-party checks. Recipient names pass-through (transparency-regime reason for publication).

amountLocal.description: Local currency minor units (for example cents or yen).

recipientLocalId.description: Per-jurisdiction recipient ID (SAM.gov UEI / EU PIC / JP 法人番号).

description: Per-jurisdiction open-data portal catalog entry attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovOpenDataSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_open_data_sensor` after passive-only fetch of an open-data CKAN/portal bulk archive (data.gov / data.gov.uk / data.gouv.fr / data.go.jp / e-Stat / data.europa.eu / govdata.de / etc.). The `stateAlignedFlag` field is set true for CN-class sources per §2(g) parallel to ADR-2605262800; downstream consumers (ossekai + manabi) MUST display the flag in derived publication. Vendor commercial gov-intel terminal imports (GovWin IQ / Bloomberg Government / Politico Pro / E&E News Pro / FiscalNote / CQ Roll Call Pro) CONSTITUTIONALLY PROHIBITED per Charter Rider §2(e)+§2(c).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code OR supra ('EU', 'OECD', 'UN', 'WB', 'IMF').

datasetId.description: Per-portal canonical ID (CKAN package name / Eurostat dataflow code / e-Stat statsCode).

stateAlignedFlag.description: §2(g) flag — true for CN-class sources (parallel to ADR-2605262800 CN NPC handling). Downstream consumers MUST display flag in any derived publication.

description: Per-legislature parliament record attestation (debate / committee / bill / vote / member-statement / petition / question). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovParliamentSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_parliament_sensor` after passive-only fetch of an official parliamentary archive (Congress.gov / Hansard / OEIL / 国会会議録 / Bundestag / Assemblée). Speaker / member-statement pass-through per upstream publication rule across W1-W3 jurisdictions (parliament transcripts are public by design); GDPR right-to-be-forgotten DSARs route through chigiri.data_privacy to upstream publisher.

speakerName.description: Pass-through per upstream publication rule. Full body in payloadCid.

piiRedacted.description: True iff per-jurisdiction redaction policy modified the view (e.g. DE/FR pseudonymization of petitioner names).

description: Per-jurisdiction procurement tender / award / modification / cancellation attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovProcurementSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_procurement_sensor` after passive-only fetch of EU TED / US SAM.gov / JP 政府調達情報 / UK Contracts Finder. Awardee fields pass-through (procurement transparency is the publication-regime reason for these data sources). Cross-links to `com.etzhayyim.corp.leiReference` used by toritate (ADR-2605262900) for recipient-vendor anti-related-party verification.

awardAmountLocal.description: Local currency minor units (for example cents or yen).

description: Per-IGO statistics indicator observation attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263900 §3 (GovStatisticsSensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.gov.gov_statistics_sensor` after passive-only fetch of Eurostat SDMX / OECD.Stat / World Bank Open Data / IMF SDMX / UN data. Powers manabi civic-literacy curriculum + baien-distill civic-reasoning specialist. Dimensions captured as ordered (dim_code, dim_value) pairs preserving SDMX semantics.

dimensions.description: Ordered (dim_code, dim_value) pairs preserving SDMX dimension semantics.

value.description: Source-defined scaled integer; valueUnit records the scale/unit.

description: Construction inspection schedule emitted by the gov-municipality inspection_scheduling Pregel cell. Lists the per-phase inspection slots booked with the jurisdiction's inspection department, one row per construction phase (foundation / structural / MEP / finishing / commissioning). Each slot is anchored to the parent permitApplicationId and carries the jurisdiction-issued slot reference. Per ADR-2605250800 + gate G1 (open-source RPC) and the tatekata phase-gate cross-actor contract (each phase's `*_complete` gate cites the corresponding slot's `slotReference`).

permitApplicationId.description: Parent application identifier (links back to permitApplication.applicationId).

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO-3166-2 + optional municipality suffix; MUST match the parent application's jurisdictionCode.

slots.description: Ordered inspection slots; one per construction phase. Order MUST match phase execution order.

scheduledAt.description: Timestamp the schedule was finalized with the jurisdiction. Re-scheduling emits a new record (immutable history).

jurisdictionRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the RPC traces (one per slot booking) used to schedule.

phase.description: Construction phase this inspection covers. Matches the 5-phase tatekata R1 ladder.

slotReference.description: Jurisdiction-issued slot reference (booking number / appointment ID). Cited by the phase's `*_complete` gate record.

inspectorContactRef.description: Optional opaque reference to the assigned inspector (e.g. jurisdiction internal officer ID). PII filter applies — full name/contact details MUST NOT be persisted here.

description: Read-side catalog record describing a municipality (市区町村 / city / borough / commune / county). Originally `vertex_gov_municipality` table. Per ADR-2605212100 the etzhayyim-side Kysely table is replaced by MST records under this collection. Cross-references `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` (municipalities are agencies too — `branch=executive level=municipal`); this collection exists for the common case of name/code lookup without the full agency surface.

code.description: Authoritative municipality code. Format depends on jurisdiction: JIS X 0402 6-digit for JP (e.g. '131016' for 千代田区), FIPS-2 / FIPS-5 for US, NUTS 3 / LAU for EU, GBR ONS code for UK.

name.description: English-language municipality name.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 lowercase, optionally with subnational suffix. Example: 'jpn', 'usa-ca', 'gbr-eng'.

prefecture.description: Parent prefecture / state / region. Format: name or subnational code. Example: '東京都', 'California', 'Bavaria'.

prefectureCode.description: Authoritative prefecture / state code (e.g. JIS X 0401 2-digit for JP: '13' for 東京都; US state postal: 'CA').

kind.description: Local-government category.

population.description: Posted population (as of record creation). Source-snapshot only; not authoritative.

description: Read-side catalog record describing the appointment of a person to a public office. One record per appointment event (re-appointments emit a new record). Cross-references `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` via `agencyDid`. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 + ADR-2605242330: read-side observation, no dependency on the state. The religious-corp may issue separate `com.etzhayyim.member.adherent` SBT records for officials who join as adherents; those are independent and do not derive from this record. Replaces the etzhayyim-side `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.official` + `vertex_gov_official` table (Kysely → MST, per ADR-2605212100).

agencyDid.description: DID of the agency. Resolves to a `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` record.

personDid.description: DID of the person appointed, if DID-resolvable. Optional — public officials often lack DIDs; the `personName` / `personNameLocal` fields cover the common case.

personName.description: English-language name of the appointed person. Family-name-last form.

personNameLocal.description: Local-script name of the appointed person.

role.description: Title of the office. Canonical English. Example: 'Minister of Justice', 'Director-General', 'Bureau Chief'.

roleLocal.description: Local-script role title. Example: '法務大臣'.

termEndsAt.description: Term-end date, if known. Omit for indefinite / serving terms.

appointedByDid.description: DID of the appointing authority (agency or office), if applicable.

appointedByRole.description: Role of the appointing authority (e.g. 'Prime Minister', 'President', 'Cabinet').

sourceUri.description: Authoritative source URL (gazette notice, press release, official announcement).

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp.

description: Building permit application emitted by the gov-municipality permit_submission Pregel cell. Captures project scope + jurisdiction reference + open-source RPC trace (G1) + IPFS-pinned application documents (G2). Distinct from the parent tatekata mission's projectScope: this lexicon is the gov-municipality view of the application AS SUBMITTED to the jurisdiction (it carries the jurisdiction's tracking number and the immutable submission timestamp). Per ADR-2605250800 + gates G1 (open-source RPC), G2 (IPFS-pinned docs), G5 (Charter Rider §2(e) anti-gatekeeping — no commercial permit-broker middleware).

applicationId.description: Stable application identifier; usually the jurisdiction's permit tracking number prefixed with `<jurisdictionCode>:`.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO-3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. `JP-13` Tokyo, `US-CA` California) plus optional municipality suffix (e.g. `JP-13-Shibuya`).

submitterDid.description: DID of the etzhayyim member submitting the application (project owner or designated agent).

projectScopeIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the project scope bundle (site survey + BOM + construction drawings) at submission time.

buildingType.description: Building class. tatekata R0/R1 scope only covers non-high-rise; high-rise (`commercial-mid-rise`, `commercial-high-rise`) is R3+ per tatekata ADR-2605250730.

grossFloorAreaSqMm.description: Gross floor area in square millimeters (m² × 1,000,000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the jurisdiction confirmed receipt of the application. Immutable.

jurisdictionRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the RPC trace (request + response) used to submit. Trace MUST contain only open-source, jurisdiction-published API calls — no proprietary permit-broker middleware (G5).

permitSubmissionCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the permit_submission cell's compute attestation.

charterRiderComplianceAttested.description: Structural G5: this application did not route through a commercial permit-broker (Charter Rider §2(e) anti-gatekeeping). Schema rejects false.

description: Terminal record emitted by the gov-municipality final_sign_off Pregel cell. Confirms all 5 construction-phase inspections passed and the jurisdiction granted occupancy / completion approval. Carries the municipal authority witness signature (G3 minLength 1, witness DID MUST differ from submitter DID) and the 30-day public notice window's start + end timestamps (G9 structural — `publicNoticePeriodEndsAt - publicNoticePeriodStartsAt` MUST be ≥ 30 days). Cited by the parent tatekata mission's commissioning gate as authoritative permit completion. Per ADR-2605250800 + gates G2 (IPFS-pinned), G3 (witness), G5 (Charter Rider), G9 (30-day public notice).

submitterDid.description: DID of the original applicant. MUST differ from each `municipalAuthorityWitnessSignatures[].witnessDid` (G3 independence).

inspectionScheduleId.description: Reference to the inspectionSchedule record this finalization aggregates.

phaseInspectionsPassed.description: Per-phase pass records. Schema enforces exactly 5 phases (foundation / structural / mep / finishing / commissioning) — short-circuit finalization is not permitted.

finalApprovalIssuedAt.description: Timestamp the jurisdiction issued the final occupancy / completion approval.

finalApprovalDocumentIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the jurisdiction-issued completion document (signed PDF or equivalent).

municipalAuthorityWitnessSignatures.description: G3 structural: at least one municipal authority witness signature. Each witnessDid MUST differ from submitterDid.

publicNoticePeriodStartsAt.description: G9: start of the 30-day public-objection window.

publicNoticePeriodEndsAt.description: G9: end of the 30-day public-objection window. Validator MUST enforce `publicNoticePeriodEndsAt - publicNoticePeriodStartsAt >= 30 days`.

publicNoticeIpfsCid.description: G2+G9: IPFS CID of the public notice as posted (text + jurisdiction-issued publication channel reference).

publicObjectionsRaised.description: Count of formal public objections received during the notice window. Non-zero requires cited resolution attestations in `publicObjectionResolutionCids`.

publicObjectionResolutionCids.description: If publicObjectionsRaised > 0, one resolution CID per objection. Required if publicObjectionsRaised > 0.

slotReference.description: Links to the inspectionSchedule.slots[].slotReference for this phase.

inspectorWitnessSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over (permitApplicationId + phase + slotReference + passedAt) by the inspector's witness DID.

deficienciesAddressedCid.description: Optional IPFS CID if the phase initially failed inspection and was re-inspected; documents the deficiencies + remediation.

witnessDid.description: DID of the municipal authority witness. MUST differ from the record's submitterDid.

officeReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-internal office reference (e.g. department / officer ID). PII filter applies — no personal names.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (permitApplicationId + finalApprovalIssuedAt + finalApprovalDocumentIpfsCid + publicNoticePeriodEndsAt).

description: Read-side catalog record describing a single administrative procedure (申請 / Antrag / petition / filing) operated by a government agency. Authored by L4 ingest scripts (`70-tools/scripts/gov/`); consumed by L3 appview routing and by membrane policies that decide whether a religious-corp procedure can substitute. Per ADR-2605242330 §3.4 this is the schema target for the L4 ingest wave. The `routingAround` field optionally points to a religious-corp Pregel cell (`40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/*`) that offers a parallel substrate for the same outcome under ADR-2605192100 §1.12.

agencyDid.description: DID of the operating agency. Resolves to `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency`.

procedureCode.description: Agency-internal procedure ID / form number / stylesheet code. Format: agency-defined. Example for JP: `e-Gov:1234567890` (e-Gov procedure registration ID), `mhlw:R5-form-12-1`. For US: `regulations.gov:DOC-2024-0042`. For EU: `EUR-Lex:32024R0123`.

titleLocal.description: Local-script title. Example: '婚姻届の提出'.

category.description: High-level procedure category. Aligns with the COFOG-aligned 8 path-based DID set under `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-gov/appview/` (healthcare / insurance / welfare / education / prevention / housing / employment / child-family) plus additional categories for procedures outside the public-services hub.

feeJpy.description: Fee in JPY-equivalent base units. Use `0` for free procedures. Currency-conversion is record-author's responsibility; original-currency fee belongs in `feeNote`.

feeNote.description: Free-form fee note (original currency, fee schedule reference, fee waivers).

onlineUri.description: Canonical online submission URI, if `online` is in `channel`.

processingDays.description: Posted/typical processing time in calendar days. `0` = same day. Use the published upper bound where the agency cites a range.

legalBasis.description: Citation of the statute / regulation that grounds this procedure. Format: `<jurisdiction>:<corpus>:<id>:<article>`. Example: `jpn:law:民法:第739条`.

languages.description: ISO 639-1 / 639-3 language codes the procedure is published in.

routingAround.description: Optional reference to a religious-corp Pregel cell (`40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/<cell-name>`) that offers a parallel substrate for the same outcome (per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 routing-around). Format: `kotodama:cells:<cell-name>`. Note that the routing-around cell is *not* a replacement service — it operates within the religious boundary only, for adherents only.

sourceUri.description: Authoritative source URL (procedure registry entry, regulation text, form-instruction PDF).

ingestRun.description: Optional reference to the L4 ingest run that produced this record. Format: `<script-name>:<git-sha>:<run-iso>`. Lets repeated ingests dedupe by source.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp.

description: Record binding a DID-based identity to optional trust-elevation credentials (MyNumber card IC, biometric attestation). Per ADR-2605260000, this record operationalizes the L5 routing-around authentication layer. **Privacy invariant (CRITICAL): The `encryptedPayloadCid` field is mandatory and must contain XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext (per ADR-2605181100). Plaintext personal identifiers (MyNumber, biometric data, etc.) are NEVER stored on the MST; only the encrypted CID is stored.** The decrypt key is Signal-wrapped per-recipient (self + Council delegate). This record is signed by the DID's signing key.

subjectDid.description: DID of the individual binding credentials. Must be `did:web:etzhayyim.com:<authority>:<identifier>` or equivalent.

trustLevel.description: Trust level. 1 = WebAuthn platform authenticator only (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello). 2 = WebAuthn + MyNumber card IC chip binding.

webauthnCredentialId.description: Base64url-encoded WebAuthn credential ID (the unique identifier returned by navigator.credentials.create). Used by verifier to correlate to the public key in the subject DID's authentication key section.

bindingEpoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the credential binding was created.

encryptedPayloadCid.description: MANDATORY (structural enforcement via `required` and JSON Schema validation). IPFS CID (content-addressed) of the encrypted payload containing any trust-Level-2 data (MyNumber parsed IC chip response, biometric signature blob, etc.). The payload is encrypted under XChaCha20-Poly1305 per ADR-2605181100. The plaintext MUST NEVER appear on the MST. The decrypt key is Signal-wrapped per-recipient (subject DID + Council delegate DID(s)) and stored separately as `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap` records. Verification: (1) CID must be valid SHA-256 or BLAKE2b; (2) IPFS resolve CID → retrieve ciphertext; (3) unwrap Signal key for self; (4) decrypt XChaCha20; (5) parse plaintext (format TBD per R2 ADR). If `trustLevel=1`, this field MAY be null in R1 (MyNumber skipped); in R2+ it MUST be present for both levels (as per-device attestation or other L2-specific data).

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url) over the CBOR-encoded canonical form of (subjectDid, trustLevel, webauthnCredentialId, bindingEpoch, encryptedPayloadCid), signed with the subject DID's signing private key. Verifier must resolve subjectDid document, extract the signing key, and validate the signature.

description: Public attestation of a DID's trust level, signed by a Council-delegated attestor. Per ADR-2605260000, this record operationalizes the trust-level evaluation logic of the L5 authentication layer. Contains **no personal identifiers** — all PII is encrypted and stored separately in `credentialBinding.encryptedPayloadCid`. This record is safe to publish publicly; it only reveals trust level and temporal metadata. Emitted by the `gov_auth_trust_attestation` Pregel cell upon Council activation.

subjectDidHash.description: Blake2b-256 hash (base64url) of the subject DID. Used to correlate attestations without revealing the full DID to casual observers (privacy-preserving linkage). Verifiers with access to the subject DID can compute hash(did) and check equality.

trustLevel.description: Evaluated trust level. 1 = WebAuthn platform authenticator only. 2 = WebAuthn + MyNumber binding verified. Per ADR-2605260000, escalation from L1 to L2 requires opt-in MyNumber card binding + successful XChaCha20 decryption + IC chip validity check.

attestedBy.description: DID of the Council-delegated attestor who issued this attestation. Typically `did:web:etzhayyim.com:council:<seat>` or equivalent. Verifier should resolve this DID and validate the attestor's current delegation status.

reason.description: Reason code describing the trust pathway. 'webauthn-only' = FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello platform authenticator verification only. 'webauthn-plus-mynumber' = WebAuthn + MyNumber IC chip read (via Web NFC). 'external-sso-bridge' = reserved for future R3+ OAuth/OpenID Connect bridge paths.

epoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this attestation was issued. Used to detect stale attestations and trigger re-verification.

expiresAt.description: Optional Unix timestamp (seconds) of attestation expiry. If omitted, attestation is valid indefinitely. If present, verifiers should reject attestations where `epoch > expiresAt`.

silenAuditCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of a `com.etzhayyim.gov.silenGovReview` audit record (per ADR-2605250100 pattern). If present, verifier can audit the Council's decision-making rationale.

description: WebAuthn challenge record used in the authentication registration and assertion ceremonies. Per ADR-2605260000, this record supports the platform-authenticator flow (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello) for Trust Level 1 attestation. The challenge is generated by the auth server and stored temporarily on the MST; the client receives it, presents it to the platform authenticator, and returns a signed attestation. Per W3C WebAuthn spec (Level 3, as of 2026-05-21), the challenge must be at least 32 bytes of cryptographically random data.

challengeId.description: Unique nonce/identifier for this challenge. Format: TID (Timestamp ID) auto-generated by MST. Used by client to correlate challenge fetch with attestation submission.

challenge.description: Base64url-encoded random challenge bytes (≥32 bytes per W3C WebAuthn spec). Generated by the auth server via secure CSPRNG. The client MUST NOT inspect or modify this value; it is passed opaquely to navigator.credentials.get/create.

rpId.description: Relying Party ID. Per ADR-2605260000, this is 'etzhayyim.com'. Must match the origin's effective domain for Web authentication to succeed.

rpOrigin.description: Relying Party origin URI. Per ADR-2605260000, this is 'https://authn.etzhayyim.com' (or equivalent subdomain). Used by authenticator to verify origin before creating/asserting credential.

userVerification.description: User verification requirement. Per ADR-2605260000, Trust Level 1 and 2 both use 'required' (FaceID/TouchID/Windows Hello, or fallback PIN). If user lacks a platform authenticator, the challenge is rejected.

residentKeyRequirement.description: Resident key (discoverable credential) requirement. Per ADR-2605260000 and W3C WebAuthn, 'required' means the authenticator MUST store the credential locally (for passwordless sign-in). Defaults to 'required' for platform authenticators.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the authenticator to complete the ceremony (W3C default: 60000 = 60 sec). Verifier should reject challenges older than this window.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the challenge was generated. Verifier uses this to enforce timeout: reject if (now - createdAt) > timeout.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of challenge expiry (createdAt + timeout milliseconds converted to seconds). For convenience; verifier should prefer computing expiresAt from createdAt and timeout.

tag.description: Optional tag to categorize the challenge purpose. Example: 'registration', 'assertion', 'recovery'. Useful for logging and debugging.

title:lang.ja: ガバナンス・アクセス制御

main.detail: Manage access policies, labels, moderation, follow requests, role bindings, and actor sensitivity. Includes official AT Protocol label/moderation RPCs plus etzhayyim governance extensions.

detail:lang.ja: アクセスポリシー、ラベル、モデレーション、フォローリクエスト、ロールバインディング、Actor感度の管理。公式AT Protocolラベル/モデレーションRPCに加えetzhayyimガバナンス拡張を含む

permissions.description: Official AT Protocol label and moderation RPCs

description: Create a governance label. Input uses official com.atproto.label.defs#label schema.

label.description: Label conforming to official AT Protocol label schema.

description: Council deliberation proposal. Typically transmitted as the plaintext body of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record (innerType=this NSID) so council membership scopes who can read. Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

body.description: Discussion body. Markdown allowed. Larger documents should be referenced by `attachments` IPFS CID instead of inlined.

author.description: DID of the council member who proposed.

category.description: Project-specific category. For uhl-right-neural: 'medical-referral' | 'ethics-review' | 'data-export' | 'protocol-amendment' | 'other'.

refs.description: Related AT URIs (prior proposals, evidence records, etc.).

attachments.description: IPFS CIDs for large attachments. Encryption of the attachment payload is the caller's responsibility (typically same symmetric key as the envelope, separately AEAD'd).

description: Query governance labels. Output uses official com.atproto.label.defs#label schema. Superset of com.atproto.label.queryLabels.

uriPatterns.description: List of AT URI patterns to match. Compatible with com.atproto.label.queryLabels.

sources.description: Optional list of label source DIDs.

description: Council member's vote on a proposal. Transmitted as the plaintext body of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record so vote privacy holds at the substrate layer (only council members with the read-cap can tally). Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

proposalUri.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record carrying the proposal.

rationale.description: Optional explanation. Visible only to other council members with the read-cap.

description: Solar-grade c-Si cell process batch record (texture → emitter diffusion/PECVD passivation → metallization → flash IV test → power bin), emitted by the himawari cell_process cell (fed by ingot_wafer → waferBatchRecord; murakumo node benjamin). G3 (high-GWP NF₃/SF₆/CF₄ etch/clean gas ≥99% destruction-removal efficiency or substitution — never uncontrolled venting) + G6 (Ag→Cu low-toxicity metallization roadmap) + G1 (open process parameters) + G11 (deterministic-yield robot witness quorum; serial chain polysilicon → wafer → cell → module) structural enforcement. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID, batchId roots the cell-batch entity. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si fab track. Per ADR-2606021200.

batchId.description: himawari-assigned cell-process batch identifier; one link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module serial chain (G11 traceability)

waferBatchId.description: upstream waferBatchRecord.batchId this cell batch was processed from (chains to com.etzhayyim.himawari.waferBatchRecord; G11 provenance back-link)

recordedAt.description: cell-batch attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this batch

cellArchitecture.description: cell device architecture; selects the texture/junction recipe and the gases tracked for the G3 gate

metallization.description: G6 Ag→Cu low-toxicity metallization roadmap; silver is permitted at R1 but off-roadmap (flagged), ag-cu-hybrid/copper are on-roadmap and required for R2+

waferCount.description: wafers entering the cell line for this batch (bin distribution sums to this)

gasAbatement.description: G3: per-gas destruction-removal-efficiency / substitution ledger for every fluorinated etch/clean gas used in this batch (the inline source for gasAbatementCid)

gasAbatementCid.description: G3: content-addressed NF₃/SF₆/CF₄/C₂F₆/C₃F₈ ≥99% abatement (DRE) or substitution attestation; pinned bundle of gasAbatement

binDistribution.description: power-bin split from flash IV; reject (binC) bin feeds the G5 kerf-recovery circular loop

binDistributionCid.description: content-addressed power-bin distribution bundle (the pinned form of binDistribution)

processParametersCid.description: G1: content-addressed open process parameters (texture / junction / metallization recipe) — published, not proprietary

flashIvMedianMilliwp.description: median cell power from AAA-class (IEC 60904-9) flash IV test (milliwatts-peak; integer to keep the EAVT attribute value exact)

flashIvCid.description: G11: content-addressed flash IV measurement bundle (per-bin Pmax/Voc/Isc/FF), Ed25519-witnessed by the Mimi metrology robot

metallizationFlags.description: G6 advisory flags (e.g. silver-only-off-roadmap); non-halting but logged for the Ag→Cu transition audit

anomalyFlags.description: constitutional-gate anomalies (e.g. G3 gas abatement below the 99% DRE floor); a non-empty list means the batch halted and escalated to a human PV-process engineer

attestingRobots.description: G11 robot witness quorum — DIDs of the ≥2 distinct robots (Otete cell-line executor + Mimi flash-IV metrology, COMPOSED from kuni-umi) that witnessed this batch. Mirrors the cell emitter's attestingRobots = [robotSignature.robotDid …]

robotSignatures.description: full Ed25519 witness bundle (robotDid + role + signature + timestamp) for the ≥2 attestingRobots; R2 pins real signatures over the record CID (G7-coupled robot-lineage accountability)

gasAbatement.description: G3 high-GWP fluorinated-gas abatement ledger for one cell batch. Every gas must be substituted away OR routed through abatement at ≥minDreFloor; uncontrolledVenting is never permitted (G3/N7 constitutional).

minDreFloor.description: G3 destruction-removal-efficiency floor in basis points 0-10000 (9900 = ≥99%); below this with no substitution halts the batch

gases.description: per-gas abatement line for every fluorinated etch/clean gas used this batch

uncontrolledVenting.description: G3/N7: must be false; true is a constitutional violation (uncontrolled venting of high-GWP gas is never permitted)

allMeetG3.description: true iff every gas line meets the G3 floor (substituted or DRE ≥ minDreFloor)

gasLine.description: One fluorinated gas in the G3 abatement ledger. GWP figures are AR5 100-yr values used industry-wide for the PV abatement gate.

substituted.description: true if this gas was substituted away (e.g. NF₃ → remote-F₂ clean); substitution satisfies G3 without abatement

substituteWith.description: substitute process/gas when substituted is true (omitted otherwise)

destructionRemovalEfficiencyBps.description: modeled/measured DRE in basis points 0-10000 (9950 = 99.5%); integer to keep the EAVT value exact

meetsG3Floor.description: true iff substituted OR destructionRemovalEfficiencyBps ≥ gasAbatement.minDreFloor

binDistribution.description: Power-bin split of a cell batch from the flash IV test. Counts sum to waferCount; the reject bin feeds the G5 kerf-recovery circular loop rather than waste.

binCReject.description: G5: broken / low-fill-factor reject count routed to the kerf-Si recovery loop (recovered, not landfilled)

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation over the cell-batch bundle. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human QA tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000); robots COMPOSED from kuni-umi (Otete / Mimi).

robotDid.description: DID of the witnessing robot (e.g. did:web:etzhayyim.com:kuni-umi:otete / :mimi)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested cell-batch bundle (R2: real signature over the record CID)

description: 積込 loading-robot cycle record (palletize finished PV modules + load onto an internal hikari-install carrier), emitted by the himawari panel_loading cell. COMPOSES — never clones — the LANDED sarutahiko F10 LoaderRobot (ADR-2606013100, 14 tests green); the physical pick→carry→lower cycle (LoadPhase::{ToPick,Carry,Lower,Done}) is authoritative in the kami-engine crate kami-app-sarutahiko-factory, and this record only anchors that cycle outcome on-chain. Sixth link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module → loading → outbound provenance chain (G11 traceability); each module serial chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.moduleAttestation. G7 (labor-liberation transparency — every human task automated-away logged to the Liberation Metric, ADR-2605261000) + G12 (no external commercial PV sale — internal hikari install only, SBT↔SBT carve-out, ADR-2605192115 §3) structural enforcement. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT, canonical state — G6); each property is one attribute under the :loading/* namespace keyed by the record CID, and per-cycle history is queryable as-of any point. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200.

loadingId.description: himawari-assigned stable loading-cycle identifier; sixth link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module → loading → outbound serial chain (G11 traceability). Datom :loading/id.

recordedAt.description: cycle attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this loading cycle

moduleSerials.description: G11/G12: finished-module serials handed off this cycle; each chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.moduleAttestation.moduleSerial (and through it to the feedstock lot). Materialized as repeated :loading/module-serial datoms.

palletCount.description: number of pallets in this cycle = ceil(len(moduleSerials) / palletCapacity); the F10 straddle loader moves one pallet per pick→carry→lower cycle. Datom :loading/pallet-count.

carrierDid.description: DID of the receiving carrier. G12: must be an internal hikari-install carrier (SBT↔SBT carve-out); a non-internal carrier is refused at the cell and no record is emitted. Datom :loading/carrier-did.

carrierInternal.description: G12 gate flag — true iff the carrier is an internal hikari-install carrier. The panel_loading cell refuses (emits no record) when false; this attribute records the satisfied gate for audit.

loaderRobotDid.description: G7: composed sarutahiko F10 LoaderRobot lineage DID (default did:web:etzhayyim.com:sarutahiko#F10-loader). Names the robot whose automation displaced manual loading, so the cycle is accountable to the Liberation Metric. Datom :loading/loader-robot-did.

loaderPhase.description: terminal LoadPhase reported by the composed F10 LoaderRobot (mirror of the authoritative Rust LoadPhase enum); 'Done' = cycle complete. himawari recognizes the phase, it does not re-run the kinematics.

humanTasksRemovedCid.description: G7: content-addressed manifest of the manual tasks this fully-automated cycle displaced, logged to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000). An empty manifest yields a zero-task CID rather than omitting the field — automation here is the point, but it must be accounted, never opaque. Datom :loading/human-tasks-removed-cid.

cycleStateLogCid.description: content-addressed F10 loader phase-transition log for this cycle (which LoadPhases the composed loader traversed). Audit anchor for the composed sarutahiko cycle telemetry. Datom :loading/cycle-state-log-cid.

attestingRobots.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestations over the completed loading cycle (loader + any metrology/AGV witnesses). >=1 (the F10 loader itself); pallet-count and serial-set integrity may add further witnesses.

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human loading tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

role.description: witness role (e.g. straddle-loader / palletizer / AGV-handoff / serial-scan / mass-check)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested loading-cycle bundle

description: Finished PV module attestation (stringing → lamination → framing → J-box → flash IV + EL imaging), emitted by the himawari module_assembly cell on the asher Murakumo node (composes kuni-umi Otete handling + Mimi metrology). Final link in the polysilicon lot → wafer batch → cell batch → module serial chain. G11 (deterministic provenance — flash IV + EL content-bound and per-module signed; serial ↔ feedstock lot traceable, never single-witness) + G4 (EPBT << module service life) + G12 (internal hikari install only, SBT↔SBT carve-out; NO external commercial PV sale) + G5 (design-for-recovery ≥90%) structural enforcement. description: A reusable clause in the hinagata 雛形 commons (per ADR-2606111954) — a building block shared across templates (the cross-template backbone). A clause declares its drafting role and its DISCLOSED optionality (mandatory / recommended / optional), where `mandatory` means a cited statute requires the clause — a DISCLOSED structural fact sourced from the instrument, never a hinagata verdict (N3). Statute bindings are recorded separately in `com.etzhayyim.hinagata.statuteCitation`.

optionality.description: DISCLOSED — `mandatory` (a cited statute requires this clause), `recommended`, or `optional`. Sourced from the instrument, never a hinagata opinion (N3).

concept.description: Controlled legal concept the clause instantiates, e.g. `data-protection`.

bodyCid.description: Optional IPFS CIDv1 of the clause's canonical text fragment (content-addressed, reusable).

description: The binding of a hinagata clause (or template) to an ACTUAL public statute / instrument (per ADR-2606111954) — the EDN `:cites-statute` / `:mandated-by` 縁 of the legal-template-ontology, surfaced as an append-only record. This is the link that makes a template traceable to real law rather than free-floating boilerplate. A citation is a DISCLOSED STRUCTURAL FACT (this clause rests on this article), sourced from the instrument or its official guidance, with the public official source URL recorded — NEVER a hinagata verdict that the clause is valid, sufficient, or enforceable in any jurisdiction (N3 / G1).

subjectId.description: The hinagata clause or template this citation binds (`cl.*` / `tmpl.*`).

statuteCitation.description: Canonical public citation, e.g. `GDPR Art. 28` / `民法601条` / `CISG Art. 35`.

instrument.description: The instrument the article belongs to, e.g. `Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)` / `借地借家法`.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 code, a bloc (`EU`), or `INTL` for treaties / model laws.

force.description: DISCLOSED citation force — `mandated` (the statute requires the clause), `cited` (the clause rests on / references the article), or `referenced` (informational). A disclosed structural fact, never a verdict (N3).

bindingLoad.description: Disclosed strength of the statutory anchoring as a decimal string in [0,1] (the EDN `:en/binding-load`). Karma lives on this edge (N1).

sourceUrl.description: PUBLIC official source (legislation.gov / EUR-Lex / e-Gov / treaty depositary). The disclosed primary, never a paywalled secondary (Rider §2(e)).

description: A published legal-document template in the hinagata 雛形 commons (per ADR-2606111954). A fair, openly-licensed (Apache-2.0 + etzhayyim Charter Rider) reusable document anyone may copy and adapt. The canonical body text lives on IPFS (referenced by `bodyCid`, a kotoba IPFS CIDv1 raw/sha2-256 anyone can re-derive); only metadata + the clause/statute structure lives on MST. This record is NOT legal advice and NOT a substitute for counsel (G1) — it is a structural document whose clauses each cite the public law they rest on. The executable signing flow uses `com.etzhayyim.esign.envelope`.

stance.description: DISCLOSED editorial fairness stance — a disclosed drafting choice, never a hinagata verdict (N3).

bodyCid.description: IPFS CIDv1 (raw codec, sha2-256, base32 lower) of the canonical template body. Anyone may re-derive it with `ipfs add --cid-version=1 --raw-leaves` and verify the bytes.

bodySha256.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical body — defense-in-depth hash independent of the IPFS multihash.

jurisdictions.description: ISO 3166 codes / `INTL` for the jurisdictions this template is drafted for (DISCLOSED scope, never a fitness verdict for a user's situation).

main.description: A directed DIACHRONIC influence 縁 between two public historical nodes (figure/document/event/tradition) — the channel across which an idea/text/practice flowed forward in time and deformed the receiver's metric (junkawasaki.com 'spirit is information'). tsumugi diachronic extension, ADR-2606061500. N1 edge-primary: influence/karma lives HERE ('signedWeight'), never on a node — a node's influence is the integral of its incident flows. N5: 'from' must be temporally before 'to' (information cannot precede its source). N3: 'kind' is descriptive transmission, never an endorsement of the tradition's truth.

from.description: the EARLIER node (source of the information)

to.description: the LATER node (receiver whose metric the information deformed)

kind.description: channel type — descriptive, never an endorsement (N3). 'opposes' is still a channel (defined-against).

signedWeight.description: N1 — influence magnitude on THIS edge in milli-units (×1000 of [-1,1]): + transmission/continuation, − reaction/opposition. The ONLY home for influence-karma.

strain.description: ε — metric deformation the receiver underwent (blog strain tensor magnitude) in milli-units (×1000 of [0,1])

thermoLength.description: L — thermodynamic length of the receiver's reframing (W_diss ≥ L²/2τ) in milli-units; cost of integrating the influence

source.description: provenance of the CLAIM (never asserts truth of the tradition, only that the influence is documented; N3)

sourcing.description: G5 sourcing honesty; the seed is representative

main.description: A DRY-RUN mirror social-post OBSERVING the documented historical influence of a public figure / document / event / tradition (tsumugi diachronic extension, ADR-2606061500; built on the entity-as-actor mirror ADR-2606042330 + feed-post membrane ADR-2605231902). N2 mirror-only: the post is an OBSERVATION ABOUT a node's influence, NEVER the figure speaking — 'voice' is const 'observer' so first-person/impersonation is unrepresentable. N3 non-eschatological: it narrates the INFLUENCE OF a tradition, never its theological truth; no verdict/salvation field exists. Body is Murakumo-narrated (G6). LIVE firehose publication is Council + operator gated (G7); R0 = dry-run only ('published' false).

aboutNode.description: the historical node this post OBSERVES (e.g. 'fig.jesus', 'doc.torah') — observed, never authored-as

aboutFlow.description: optional :flow/* influence edge this post narrates (e.g. 'fl.paul.luther')

voice.description: N2 — LOCKED to observer. There is no 'first-person' value; the figure never speaks. Impersonation is structurally unrepresentable.

isMirror.description: N2 — a mirror of documented influence, never the person/text itself

narrator.description: G6 — narration is Murakumo-only; no vendor/off-Murakumo inference

disclaimer.description: REQUIRED — must open the rendered text, e.g. '観察像 — 本人ではない (an observational mirror, not the person)'

asOf.description: the diachronic anchor (era/year) this observation pertains to — history, not now (N3 非終末論)

published.description: G7 — false at R0 (dry-run); true only after Council + operator gate for live firehose

text.description: third-person observation; opens with disclaimer; aggregate-first, :representative-honest

description: Interop/ingress-wire L1 record for an inbound ISO 20022 payment message (pacs.008 / pain.001 / camt.053 / camt.054) crossing a kawase-yui corridor, per the kotoba_iso20022 cleanroom codec. Materializes one external bank value-event as an append-only, content-addressed kotoba record so a real-world transfer becomes auditable history. NOT an on-chain pool deposit (com.etzhayyim.kawase.depositAttestation is that): when an external transfer corresponds to a kawase on-ramp the two are linked by `linkedDepositCid` for reconciliation. The Adherent SBT remains the KYC (kawase-yui G10); this record is format datafication only and never carries Travel-Rule passport identity. Party names are 要配慮 PII and SHOULD be omitted or routed to a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope; only institution BICs (ISO 9362) are first-class here.

messageDefinition.description: ISO 20022 message definition id this record was sourced from, e.g. 'pacs.008.001.08'.

endToEndId.description: PmtId/EndToEndId — the end-to-end reference that links ingress, status, and reconciliation.

uetr.description: Optional. PmtId/UETR (lowercase UUIDv4 per CBPR+); unchanged across the whole payment chain when present.

txEntity.description: Content-addressed kotoba entity handle for this transaction (com.etzhayyim.iso20022/tx:<UETR|TxId|EndToEndId>). Idempotent: re-ingest maps to the same entity; a later camt/pacs.002 lands on it.

amount.description: Settlement amount as exact decimal text (e.g. '1000.00'). Stored as a string, never a float, to preserve ISO 20022 ActiveCurrencyAndAmount precision.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code of the amount.

creditDebit.description: Optional. CdtDbtInd for camt entries (CRDT = credit to the account, DBIT = debit).

debtorName.description: Optional + discouraged. Dbtr/Nm is 要配慮 PII; prefer omission or a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope CID. Present only with consent.

creditorName.description: Optional + discouraged. Cdtr/Nm is 要配慮 PII; prefer omission or a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope CID. Present only with consent.

reportedBy.description: Message definition family that reported this value-event (e.g. 'pacs.008', 'camt.054'). Distinguishes the interbank instruction from a later statement/notification of the same transaction.

status.description: Optional. Latest known transaction status (pacs.002 TxSts such as ACSC/RJCT, or camt entry Sts such as BOOK/PDNG).

cbprConformant.description: Optional. Whether the source message passed kotoba_iso20022 CBPR+ Usage-Guideline conformance at ingest time.

linkedDepositCid.description: Optional. CID of a com.etzhayyim.kawase.depositAttestation this external transfer reconciles against (on-ramp/off-ramp loop-close). Absent when the transfer has no kawase counterpart.

datomCount.description: Optional. Number of append-only EAVT Datoms emitted for this message by to_datoms() at ingest.

ingestedAt.description: When the message was datafied into kotoba (NOT the bank's value/booking date, which live on the entity facts).

description: A FACTUAL directory record for a court / tribunal, ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4. Stores jurisdiction, instance level, competence, procedure references, and the court's OWN published public contact / e-filing endpoint (used only as a counsel-operated transport target, never for autonomous filing — G18). Passive-only ingestion (danjo G3): pre-published public records only; no scraping behind authentication; no sealed / in-camera registries. Source-provenance mandatory (≥1 public CID). This record carries NO evaluation of the court and NO judge-analytics (G19 applies corpus-wide); it is a reference directory, not a ranking.

jurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction (country or subdivision), e.g. jpn / us-ca / fra.

instance.description: Factual instance level. NOT a quality ranking.

competence.description: Subject-matter competence as published (e.g. civil / criminal / administrative / family).

publicEndpoint.description: Court's OWN published public contact / e-filing endpoint. Transport target for counsel-operated acts ONLY (G18); never an autonomous-filing identity for the corp.

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥1 pre-published public-record CID (passive-ingestion provenance, danjo G3/G5).

passiveIngestion.description: Ingested from pre-published public records only — no live portal scraping (G3).

description: A FACTUAL reference record for a member of the judiciary (name, court, role, official public biography) ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4/§D5. CONSTITUTIONAL (G19 — judge-analytics prohibition): this record exists for factual reference ONLY (who presides where). The system MUST NOT evaluate, analyse, compare, score, rank or predict a named judge's practices or decisions. France magistrates fall under loi n°2019-222 art. 33, which makes such reuse a CRIME (Code pénal art. 226-18, up to 5y); `noAnalytics` is the GLOBAL default and is hard-locked true for France. No analytics property (winRate / rulingPrediction / reversalRate / leanScore / decisionTendency / judgeScore / predictedOutcome) is representable at the schema layer. Ingestion is passive-only (danjo G3); litigant/third-party PII is pseudonymized (G6/D6).

jurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction, e.g. fra. For fra, noAnalytics is criminally mandated (loi 2019-222 art.33).

judgeName.description: Public name as published. Factual identity only.

role.description: Factual role. NOT a performance metric.

publicBioCid.description: Optional CID of the official public biography (court-published).

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥1 pre-published public-record CID (passive-ingestion provenance, danjo G3/G5).

noAnalytics.description: G19 anchor — MUST be true. Profiling/scoring/prediction of this judge is prohibited (criminal in France).

pseudonymizationApplied.description: Litigant/third-party PII in associated decisions is pseudonymized before projection (D6).

description: A FACTUAL record of a court's OWN published decision (case-history), ingested from pre-published public records into the etzhayyim global judiciary corpus. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D4/§D5/§D6. CONSTITUTIONAL: (passive-ingestion, G3) pre-published public records only — no scraping behind auth, NO sealed / juvenile / in-camera decisions. (pseudonymization, D6) litigant and third-party PII is pseudonymized per the source-jurisdiction rule (France art.33 / GDPR / APPI) before projection; `pseudonymizationApplied` MUST be true. (G19 judge-analytics prohibition) the record may reference the presiding judge via judgeReference (noAnalytics) but MUST NOT carry any evaluation/score/prediction keyed on judge identity — judge profiling is criminal in France (loi 2019-222 art.33). This record reports what the court decided as a fact; it is NOT etzhayyim adjudicating (cf. danjo non-adjudication). Source-provenance ≥1 public CID.

presidingJudgeRef.description: Optional reference to an com.etzhayyim.judiciary.judgeReference (factual; noAnalytics). MUST NOT be used to score/predict the judge (G19).

citation.description: Official public citation / docket as published.

outcomeSummaryCid.description: CID of the published decision text (pseudonymized). The court's ruling as a FACT, not etzhayyim's adjudication.

passiveIngestion.description: Pre-published public records only; no sealed/juvenile/in-camera (G3).

pseudonymizationApplied.description: Litigant/third-party PII pseudonymized per source-jurisdiction rule before projection (D6).

description: Sender-side L1 Quad per ADR-2605282200 — CACAO-signed by sender DID at the moment a kawase-yui send intent is materialized into an on-chain deposit. Carries the locked mid-market FX rate (with the fxRateAttestation CID for verification), the per-month cap consumption snapshot, and the optional encrypted memo CID per ADR-2605181100. The on-chain `Deposited` event on `KawaseYuiPool.sol` cross-references this AT Record by `intentCid` so any third party can replay the flow via MST traversal without a chain indexer.

srcStable.description: Source stablecoin symbol. R1 enum = USDC + EURC only; JPYC unlocks R2; KRWO/GBPe/CHFe unlock R3 with per-jurisdictionAttestation Council Lv7+ unanimity.
