tgtAmountMinorQuoted.description: Target amount in target-stable minor units, computed from srcAmountMinor × fxRateBps at intent creation. This is the LOCKED amount the recipient will receive (reserve buffer absorbs any subsequent oracle drift).

fxRateBps.description: Locked FX rate in basis points (10000 = 1.0000). For USD→EUR at 0.92, fxRateBps = 9200.

fxRateAttestationCid.description: CID of the com.etzhayyim.kawase.fxRateAttestation record this rate was sourced from (kotoba content-addressed).

intentCid.description: kotoba content-addressed CID uniquely identifying this intent. Used as the keying field across deposit + matchExecution + claim chain.

perMonthCapRemainingMinor.description: Sender's remaining per-month cap (USD-equivalent minor units) AFTER this deposit. Per G9. R1 default cap = 1_000_000_000 (= $1000); R2 = $5000; R3 = $25000. Higher caps require Council Lv6+ ≥3 per-member ADR.

encryptedMemoCid.description: Optional. CID of an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope record per ADR-2605181100 (XChaCha20-Poly1305, recipient-DID-bound). Defaults absent (no memo).

description: Chainlink mid-market rate snapshot Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G4 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_fx_oracle_watcher` whenever a relevant Chainlink price-feed round updates. councilBandBps reflects the Constitution.sol const `kawase.max_band_bps` (= 50 = ±0.5%) at attestation time. `withinBand=false` halts ALL match activity for the affected pair until a Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain resumes (separate operational record outside this Lexicon).

pair.description: Currency pair ISO-4217 / ISO-4217. R1 enum = USD/EUR only; JPY/KRW/GBP/CHF pairs unlock as R2/R3 add stables.

midMarketRateNumerator.description: Chainlink answer (signed int256 in Solidity, but kawase only uses positive rates) as integer-numerator.

chainlinkRoundId.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface roundId at attestation. Used to detect stale rounds (cell rejects rounds older than 1 hour).

chainlinkUpdatedAt.description: Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface updatedAt converted to ISO-8601.

councilBandBps.description: Council-attested band tolerance at attestation time. Constitution.sol const kawase.max_band_bps. Default R0 = 50 (±0.5%).

withinBand.description: false = a check against pool-internal locked rates exceeded ±councilBandBps; cell halts pair matching and escalates to chigiri.disputeMediation after 5min sustained.

attestingNodeDid.description: DID of the Murakumo fleet node that ran this oracle watcher tick. MUST be a fleet.toml-listed node per G12.

description: Per-jurisdiction Council Lv7+ unanimity activation Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G14 — gates which sender↔recipient jurisdiction pairs are eligible for kawase-yui send/receive. Each activation is a CONSTITUTIONAL act requiring all 5 Council seats to sign the legalAnalysisCid (= chigiri.ipLicenseClaim or commentary chain establishing money-services-business non-applicability, securities-law non-applicability, AML/CFT non-applicability for that jurisdiction). Founding R1 jurisdictions = US + JP (Founder seat 1 covers both). EU + UK + KR + CH unlock as Council Seats 2-5 close (RFP open until 2026-06-19).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. USA / JPN / DEU / FRA / KOR / GBR / CHE).

activatedFor.description: Direction of activation. `both` requires the same legal analysis to cover both sender and recipient legs.

legalAnalysisCid.description: CID of the chigiri.ipLicenseClaim record (or equivalent legal analysis Lexicon) establishing the four non-applicabilities: (1) money-services-business license non-applicability under §1.12 routing-around + mutual-aid framing; (2) securities-law non-applicability (no token sale, mid-market only); (3) AML/CFT non-applicability under SBT-KYC + Charter §1.12; (4) tax-reporting position (typically: adherent-to-adherent personal mutual aid = recipient-side income reporting only).

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of ALL 5 Council seats (Founder + 4 Bootstrap Council Seats 2-5). Council Lv7+ unanimity is a constitutional invariant per ADR-2605192300 + ADR-2605282200 G14.

supersedes.description: Optional CID of a previous jurisdictionAttestation for the same (jurisdiction, activatedFor) pair that this one replaces. Used when legal analysis updates (e.g., new regulator guidance) without re-doing the Council Lv7+ ceremony from scratch — supersession still requires Lv7+ unanimity.

description: Match engine output Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_pool_match` once per matched deposit. Records WHICH of the two settlement modes was used (matched against a counter-intent vs disbursed from reserve buffer), the mKOTO debit accrued for the cell's compute, and the FX rate attestation CID for replay. silenKawaseReview aggregates these to compute matchedSharePctIntegerHundredths (G5 target ≥80% at R2+).

matchEpoch.description: Pregel cell epoch number at which the match was executed.

settlementMode.description: matched = counter withdrawIntent satisfied the deposit (no reserve consumed). reserve-disbursed = no counter intent within match_window_seconds; reserve buffer disbursed at locked rate. Pool drift_bps increments on reserve-disbursed flows.

tgtIntentCid.description: withdrawIntent.intentCid of the matched counter-intent. ABSENT when settlementMode = reserve-disbursed.

fxRateBps.description: Rate locked at depositAttestation creation. MUST be identical to depositAttestation.fxRateBps.

mKotoDebitAmount.description: mKOTO debited from operator DID balance per ADR-2605282100 for this match cell tick. Royalty pool credit emitted symmetrically.

executingCellDid.description: DID of the Murakumo fleet node that executed this match cell tick. MUST be a fleet.toml-listed node per G12 + ADR-2605215000.

description: Periodic per-currency aggregate pool report Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 L2 — emitted hourly (R1) / per-15-min (R2) / per-5-min (R3) by Pregel cell `kawase_pool_match` as a transparency artifact. Aggregate-only: NO per-member amounts, NO per-tx breakdowns. Toritate.annualReport consumes the sum-aggregate across epochs for the religious-corp annual transparency disclosure.

balanceMinor.description: Total pool balance held in KawaseYuiPool<currency> at epoch close (minor units).

inFlightMinor.description: Sum of deposits with intents still unmatched at epoch close (minor units).

reserveBufferFloorMinor.description: Minimum reserve buffer required per current sizing rule. R1 = $5_000 per pool; R2 = $50_000; R3 = $500_000 aggregate. If balanceMinor falls below this floor, new deposits halt for the pair until rebalance restores.

driftBps.description: Cumulative drift between paired pools in basis points (signed; positive = this pool is in surplus relative to its mid-market peg). When |driftBps| > 500, kawase_rebalance_proposer emits a rebalanceAttestation candidate for Council ≥4/7 sign-off.

mKotoConsumedThisEpoch.description: mKOTO debited from operator DID this epoch for pool_match cell ticks (sum across all matches).

description: Council-authorized DEX rebalance Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 — emitted by `kawase_rebalance_proposer` cell as a candidate when |driftBps| > 500 (5%) for a paired pool, then Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 signs the attestation chain, then `KawaseYuiPool.rebalance()` consumes the signed record and executes the swap via the named DEX (R1 default: Aerodrome on Base). Rebalance frequency target: ≤1/month R1, ≤1/quarter R2. swapRateBps MUST be within ±100 bps (1%) of chainlinkRateBpsAtAttest (G6 yield-farming-adjacent risk avoidance; structurally tighter than the per-tx G4 ±0.5% band because aggregate slippage matters more on larger swaps).

rebalanceId.description: Monotonic UUID for this rebalance (kotoba content-addressed).

swapAmountMinor.description: Amount of fromStable being swapped (minor units). MUST be ≤ 10% of the weaker pool's balance at proposer time.

swapRateBps.description: Quoted execution rate at the named DEX (basis points). MUST be within ±100 bps of chainlinkRateBpsAtAttest.

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of Council members who attested this rebalance. R1+ ≥4 (Lv6+ ≥4/7 multisig threshold).

dexAddress.description: Base L2 address of the Council-approved DEX (R1 default = Aerodrome `0xcF77a3Ba9A5CA399B7c97c74d54e5b1Beb874E43`). Council-approved set governed by separate ADR/Lexicon.

preSwapDriftBps.description: |driftBps| from poolStateReport that triggered this proposal. MUST be > 500.

txHash.description: Set AFTER execution. Absent on the candidate record before Council sign-off + on-chain execution.

postSwapDriftBps.description: Set AFTER execution. Should be near 0; |postSwapDriftBps| > 100 = anomalous slippage, triggers chigiri.disputeMediation.

description: Quarterly Council audit Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G5 + G7 — emitted by Pregel cell `kawase_silen_review` and counter-signed by Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain. Includes const-field structural enforcement of the most critical gates: spreadProfitMkoto const 0 (G5), commercialRemittanceSoftwarePenetrationPct const 0 (G7), nonAdherentParticipationCount const 0 (G3). Any nonzero value in these const fields = critical finding, halts pool operations, triggers chigiri.disputeMediation + Council Lv7+ escalation.

totalVolumeUsdEquivalentMinor.description: Sum of all flows during the review period, normalized to USD-equivalent minor units at locked depositAttestation.fxRateBps per flow.

perCcyVolume.description: Per-currency breakdown of volume (aggregate; no per-member amounts).

matchedSharePctIntegerHundredths.description: Fraction of flows settled via counter-intent match (vs reserve buffer). Target ≥80.00% (= 8000) at R2+. R1 may be lower while pool flow is thin.

avgMatchWaitSeconds.description: Mean wait between depositAttestation and matchExecution across the period.

outOfBandHaltCount.description: Number of times fx_oracle_watcher cell halted matching due to withinBand=false. Target = 0. >0 = critical finding.

spreadProfitMkoto.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Any nonzero value invalidates this report at schema layer and indicates a constitutional violation (mid-market only invariant breached).

commercialRemittanceSoftwarePenetrationP.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Build-time lint at `70-tools/scripts/lint/verify_no_commercial_remittance.py` must show 0 imports of Wise / Western Union / MoneyGram / Remitly / WorldRemit / Xoom / Revolut / OFX / Currencies Direct / Ria / Paysend / Atlantic Money / Sendwave / Boss Revolution / PayPal-Xoom in the kawase-yui codebase.

nonAdherentParticipationCount.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: const 0. Solidity `onlyAdherent` modifier on KawaseYuiPool.deposit + KawaseYuiPool.claim enforces this at the L6 chain layer; any nonzero count here = indexer bug (cell-level G3 violation impossible because the contract reverts).

jurisdictionsActivated.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 codes of jurisdictions active during the review period (i.e., had at least one valid jurisdictionAttestation per ADR-2605282200 G14).

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of Council members who attested this review. R1+ ≥3 (Lv6+ ≥3 threshold).

description: Recipient-side L1 Quad per ADR-2605282200 — CACAO-signed by a potential recipient DID expressing an interest in receiving a particular stable on a particular pair. The match engine (Pregel cell kawase_pool_match) joins deposits against open withdrawIntents to find counter-flows that obviate the need for an on-chain DEX rebalance. WithdrawIntents are advisory (not binding); a deposit may still settle via reserve buffer if no matching intent is open at match epoch.

recipientDid.description: DID of the adherent willing to be matched on this pair (i.e., to deposit srcStable in exchange for receiving tgtStable from a counter-deposit). Recipient MUST hold Adherent SBT per G3.

minSrcAmountMinor.description: Smallest deposit (in srcStable minor units) the recipient is willing to match against. Default: full pool floor.

maxSrcAmountMinor.description: Largest deposit (in srcStable minor units) the recipient is willing to match against. Must NOT exceed recipient's own per-month cap (G9).

validUntil.description: Intent expiry. After this instant the match engine will not consider this intent. Default: createdAt + 30 days.

description: Per-area damage assessment report. G6 STRUCTURAL: assessmentMethod enum DELIBERATELY excludes surveillance-based methods (aerial-drone, facial-recognition, bluetooth-beacon). G7 Murakumo-only inference for prediction. Cross-actor data fusion sources via $ref pattern.

assessmentAreaCid.description: GeoJSON or Land Registry area CID

assessmentMethod.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: surveillance-based methods (aerial-drone-surveillance, facial-recognition, bluetooth-beacon-tracking) DELIBERATELY excluded from enum

crossActorDataSources.description: Data fusion sources from cross-actors (mizuho / hikari / tatekata / iyashi / mitsuho)

murakumoInferenceRunCid.description: G7 attestation: needs prediction generated via Murakumo only

description: Per-carve-out activation log. G8 STRUCTURAL: autoRevokeAtUtc REQUIRED (≤ emergencyDeclaration.autoLiftAtUtc); gateCarved cited from specific actor.gate-id format; Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 attestation required for activation. Auto-revoke on emergency-lifting; carve-outs do NOT carry over to normal operations.

emergencyDeclarationCid.description: Active emergencyDeclarationAttestation CID (must be active state when activated)

gateCategoryDescription.description: Human-readable description of what is being carved out and why

carveOutJustificationCid.description: Detailed justification document CID (may be encrypted if operational details sensitive)

councilAttestations.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 required for carve-out activation

autoRevokeAtUtc.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: MUST be ≤ active emergencyDeclaration.autoLiftAtUtc; auto-revoke on emergency-lifting

actualRevokedAtUtc.description: Actual revoke timestamp (≤ autoRevokeAtUtc); MUST be set on emergency-lifting

postEmergencyAuditCid.description: Reference to silenKazaoriReview entry that audits this carve-out's use + outcome

description: Council Lv6+ ≥4/7 declaration of state of emergency. G10 STRUCTURAL: councilAttestations minLength 4. G8 STRUCTURAL: initialDurationDays default 60; extension requires Council Lv7+ unanimity (councilExtensionAttestations minLength 7). Auto-lifting at expiration unless re-extended.

declaredScope.description: Geographic / jurisdictional / community-site scope of declaration

initialDurationDays.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: ≤60 days default; extension requires Council Lv7+ unanimity

autoLiftAtUtc.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: auto-lifting timestamp; declaredStartUtc + initialDurationDays

councilAttestations.description: G10 STRUCTURAL: ≥4 of 7 Council Lv6+ DIDs

civilianOnlyAttested.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const true; kazaori is civilian-only; force authorization is ADR-2605192315 separate

sphereStandardsBaselineCid.description: G9 reference: Sphere Standards baseline compliance plan CID

extensionLog.description: Each extension requires Council Lv7+ unanimity (≥7 attestations)

liftedAtUtc.description: Actual lifting timestamp (≤ autoLiftAtUtc unless extended)

postEmergencyReviewCid.description: silenKazaoriReview CID (mandatory within 90 days of lifting)

councilUnanimityAttestations.description: G8 STRUCTURAL: extension requires ALL 7 Council seats Lv7+ unanimity

description: Per-dispatch event. Cross-actor mizuho (water) / mitsuho (food). Carve-out citation via $ref when normally-prohibited operation activated (mizuho G5 single-use container, etc.).

dispatchDestinationCid.description: Safe-site or community-cell destination registry CID

quantityInteger.description: Quantity in unitCode units (integer; e.g., liters / kg / meal-units / kWh)

carveOutCitations.description: If dispatch invoked a time-bounded carve-out (e.g., mizuho G5 single-use container), citation to emergencyCarveOutLog CID + gate

deliveryConfirmationCid.description: Destination site confirmation (encrypted if PII present)

description: OPT-IN self-check-in evacuation attestation. G6 STRUCTURAL: opt-in only; member-signed; encryptedPayloadCid REQUIRED. G6 also DELIBERATELY excludes surveillance-derived fields (no aerialDroneObservationCid / no facialRecognitionMatchCid / no bluetoothBeaconTrackingCid). Families that do not check in are NOT pursued by kazaori (state emergency management has alternate authority for non-religious-corp residents).

checkInPseudonymDid.description: 30-day rotating pseudonym DID per ADR-2605181200 (same pattern as iyashi)

encryptedPayloadCid.description: ADR-2605181100 encrypted envelope CID containing party-size + vulnerable-population-flags + medical-conditions (cross-link to iyashi if relevant) + special-needs

memberSignature.description: Member DID-bound signature; G6 REQUIRED: member-initiated only; no third-party check-in

checkInMethod.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: surveillance-derived check-in (aerial-drone-detection, facial-recognition-match, bluetooth-beacon-tracking) DELIBERATELY excluded from enum

vulnerablePopulationFlag.description: If true, hagukumi cross-actor coordination triggered for priority routing (children + elderly + chronic care recipients); detail is in encryptedPayloadCid

departedSafeSiteAtUtc.description: When member self-attests departure from safe site (continues opt-in)

description: Post-emergency Council review. MANDATORY within 90 days of emergency-lifting. G9 STRUCTURAL: sphereCompliance attested per emergency. G8 STRUCTURAL: every carve-out used during emergency audited via carveOutAuditEntries $ref array. G6 STRUCTURAL: surveillancePenetrationPct=0 const. Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation required.

reviewCompletedWithin90DaysOfLifting.description: STRUCTURAL: review MUST complete within 90 days of emergency-lifting

surveillancePenetrationPct.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: const 0; no surveillance-based monitoring used during emergency

civilianOnlyCompliance.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const true; no armed force coordination during emergency

commercialDisasterMgmtSoftwarePenetratio.description: G4 STRUCTURAL: const 0; no Veoci / NC4 / Crisis Track / Everbridge / OnSolve / SAP DR / Microsoft DR Hub / IBM Crisis Response

responderVocationFlowCompliantRatioPctIn.description: G12 STRUCTURAL: const 10000; all responders were vocation-flow L5 stewards

main.description: A composition snapshot of a government committee / advisory council (審議会・委員会): its convening organ + the PUBLIC seats on it as-of a term (G10 — a re-composition is a NEW snapshot, never an overwrite). Members are public SEATS (G1), never private persons. Sourced (G3).

label.description: committee name (e.g. 財政制度等審議会)

jurisdiction.description: jp / us / eu / gb / oecd / un …

members.description: G1 INVARIANT — each entry is a → :node/id of a PUBLIC seat/role. A private-person node is unrepresentable upstream.

sources.description: G3 — public roster source(s) (official committee page / 官報 / Federal Register).

main.description: A FACTUAL public money flow between public roles/organs (procurement award, subsidy, grant, political donation, budget outlay), traced from public information. FACTUAL only (G2): bribe / kickback / slush are not enum members. Sourced (G3): ≥2 public-source citations. NON-adjudicating: records the disclosed flow, never asserts wrongdoing.

kind.description: G2 INVARIANT — disclosed public flow kinds only. bribe / kickback / slush are NOT enum members.

sources.description: G3 INVARIANT — ≥2 public-source URLs/CIDs (調達ポータル / 政治資金収支報告書 / USAspending / TED …).

main.description: A DRY-RUN social post narrating an AGGREGATE finding from the relation graph (a committee's cross-organ concentration, a per-payee award share, a revolving-door chain). Mirror-stance (G5): opens with the accountability-map disclaimer, never speaks AS a government. NON-adjudicating (G2). Member-signed (G7): the server never signs. Outward-gated (G8): status is dry-run only at R0.

subject.description: the aggregate finding (committee/organ/jurisdiction), not a person

body.description: the narration; opens with the mirror + non-adjudicating disclaimer

status.description: G8 INVARIANT — only 'dry-run' at R0. 'published' is not a valid value; live posting needs Council Lv6+ + operator + member signature.

isMirror.description: G5 INVARIANT — only true. An observational mirror, never the government, never a target-list.

serverHeldKey.description: G7 / no-server-key INVARIANT — only false. The member signs; the server never does (ADR-2605231525).

author.description: SBT-bound member DID (required for any gated live post)

sources.description: G3 — the post carries the same ≥2 public-source citations as the finding.

main.description: An OBSERVED tie between two PUBLIC roles/organs (committee co-membership, appointment, revolving-door, funding, statement, procurement award). Edge-primary (G4): the substance is on the edge, never a per-node score. FACTUAL only (G2): a verdict/crime/corruption is not an enum member. Sourced (G3): ≥2 public-source citations. An accountability MAP, never a target-list (G5).

kind.description: G2 INVARIANT — factual tie kinds only. corruption / bribe / collusion / guilt are NOT enum members; a legal characterization is unrepresentable (danjo G4; routes to chigiri + external counsel).

weight.description: G4 — count / amount-share / tenure on the EDGE; not a per-node power score.

asOf.description: G10 — observed-at; append-only as-of, no final state (非終末論).

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: G2 INVARIANT — only true. keizu records ties, it never adjudicates.

sources.description: G3 INVARIANT — ≥2 public-source URLs/CIDs. An unsourced tie is refused.

main.description: The governor verdict behind a valuation/regionReport — the audit receipt that makes a published number defensible (G2 lineage + G3 PROVENANCE-OR-SILENCE). Pins comps + authorities + the verdict and every quarantined outlier.

subject.description: parcel id or region the verdict applies to.

verdict.description: published only when G3 cleared; else MRV band or insufficient-evidence — never a false-precision point.

main.description: An H3/region DISTRIBUTION of external-market valuations (median + quartiles). AGGREGATE-ONLY (G4): names no parcel, so it is publishable even where per-parcel valuation is barred by law or ToS. EXCLUDES inalienable Land Trust holdings (G5). rkey = region|h3.

region.description: Region label (country / admin area / postcode district). NO single parcel.

main.description: Per-source license-class registry record (G4/G8). Declares whether a data authority may be republished raw, only as a derived work, or kept Murakumo-only (G7). The LicenseGovernor reads this to set each published record's license.

sourceId.description: Adapter id, e.g. uk-landreg / bis / common-crawl.

authority.description: Independent provider, e.g. hm-land-registry / bis / rightmove.co.uk.

licenseClass.description: open=raw republishable · derived-only=contributes, no raw passthrough · restricted=Murakumo-only inference, aggregate/derived only (G7).

openData.description: G8 open-data-first: true iff the source itself is open data (e.g. the open crawl, public registry, OECD/BIS).

main.description: A provenance-stamped, uncertainty-quantified EXTERNAL-MARKET valuation of one parcel, fused by kenchi from multiple independent authorities and cleared by the ProvenanceGovernor (G3 PROVENANCE-OR-SILENCE). EXCLUDES etzhayyim Land Trust inalienable holdings (G5; ADR-2605192245 — inalienable land has no market price). A parcel is a place, not a person (G6 NO-PII). rkey = sanitized parcel id.

parcel.description: Canonical parcel id (place, not person — G6 NO-PII; no owner linkage).

assetClass.description: ONLY external-market. Inalienable Land Trust / commons-asset access is NOT valued here (G5; toritate.commonsAssetAccess owns that as non-market STOCK).

valueUsd.description: Fused point estimate from recorded PRICE comps only, USD decimal string.

nComps.description: Independent recorded comps anchoring the point (G3: ≥3).

nAuthorities.description: Independent data authorities corroborating (G3/N8: ≥2; no single-source oracle).

license.description: Republication class of THIS record. NEVER 'raw'/'restricted' — ToS-restricted inputs publish derived-only (G4).

provenance.description: Receipts: sources/authorities/kinds/licenses that produced the number (G2 lineage).

authority.description: Independent provider (independence counted by authority, not source).

description: Knowledge graph edge. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. An edge is an RDF-style quad (subject, predicate, object|literal, context). Subjects and objects reference com.etzhayyim.kg.node records by at-uri or by nodeId. SPARQL semantics; OWL semantics NOT implied.

subject.description: Subject node reference. AT-URI of an com.etzhayyim.kg.node record, or a node.nodeId value.

predicate.description: Predicate token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'depends_on', 'related', 'supersedes', 'superseded_by', 'uses-lexicon', 'projects-from', 'anchored-at', 'owns', 'asserts', 'authoritative-for'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

object.description: Object node reference (object-typed edge). AT-URI or nodeId. Mutually exclusive with 'literal' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

literal.description: Literal value (literal-typed edge, e.g. 'has-version' -> '1.2.3'). Mutually exclusive with 'object' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

weight.description: Optional numeric weight for weighted-graph algorithms. Scale 0-1000 (permille: weight/1000 = normalized 0.0-1.0). Per AT Protocol Lexicon v1: no float types; use integer with implied units.

context.description: Optional named-graph / provenance pointer. Typically the AT-URI of the record that asserts this edge (e.g. an ADR or a module manifest). Equivalent to the fourth term of an RDF quad.

source.description: Projection source, parallel to kg.node.source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'manual'.

createdAt.description: Record creation time. RFC 3339.

description: Knowledge graph node. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. A node is a typed, content-addressed entity (ADR, module, lexicon, L2 contract, DNS record, actor cell, capability, institution, etc.). Edges connecting nodes use com.etzhayyim.kg.edge.

nodeId.description: Stable identifier for the node. Examples: at-uri (at://did:plc:.../com.etzhayyim.kg.node/<rkey>), did (did:web:etzhayyim.com), urn (urn:adr:2605190900), http(s) URL, or app-defined token (e.g. 'adr:2605190900', 'module:40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama').

nodeType.description: Type token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'adr', 'module', 'lexicon', 'l2-contract', 'dns-record', 'actor-cell', 'capability', 'institution', 'person', 'organization'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

summary.description: Optional short prose description of the node.

payload.description: Optional structured payload. Prefer application/cbor (IPLD DAG-CBOR) for content-addressed linkage; application/json or application/ld+json acceptable for simpler cases. The blob CID is the natural content address of the payload.

source.description: Projection source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'module-manifest', 'manual'. The kg-projector sets this automatically; manually-authored nodes use 'manual'.

createdAt.description: Record creation time. RFC 3339.

description: Read-only SPARQL 1.1 query endpoint for the etzhayyim Knowledge Graph (ADR-2605190900 stage K2.b). Served by the kg-appview ephemeral in-memory store rebuilt from MST + IPFS on cold start; never mutates substrate. SPARQL UPDATE keywords (INSERT / DELETE / LOAD / CLEAR / CREATE / DROP / COPY / MOVE / ADD) are rejected with HTTP 403. Response encoding depends on the SPARQL form: SELECT and ASK default to application/sparql-results+json (override with format=xml or format=csv); CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE default to text/turtle (override with format=ntriples or format=rdfxml).

query.description: SPARQL 1.1 query string. Must be SELECT / ASK / CONSTRUCT / DESCRIBE. UPDATE forms are rejected.

format.description: Optional response-format override. Use 'json' / 'xml' / 'csv' for SELECT/ASK; 'turtle' / 'ntriples' / 'rdfxml' for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. If omitted, Accept-header negotiation falls back to the format defaults documented at the lexicon level.

output.description: SPARQL Query Results JSON for SELECT/ASK, or text/turtle (or the format requested via the format parameter) for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. The HTTP Content-Type header carries the actual encoding chosen by the server.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.description: The provided SPARQL string failed to parse or evaluate. The server returns the parser/evaluator message in the response body.

errors.name: UpdateNotAllowed
errors.description: The provided SPARQL contained an UPDATE keyword. This endpoint is read-only by design (ADR-2605190900 K2 kotoba guarantee).

main.description: Take in processed signals from koke/hakkou into ki vascular input (xylem). Analogous to root absorption — raw signals enter the vascular system for upward transport toward synthesis.

sourceVertexId.description: vertex_id of the source signal (koke fixation or hakkou ferment)

inputKind.description: Kind of input: fixation | ferment | transfer

content.description: Raw content or reference to absorb

main.description: Publish a synthesized knowledge artifact to the graph. Analogous to phloem transport — synthesized knowledge flows outward (downward) to all parts of the ecosystem.

artifactId.description: ID of the synthesized artifact to publish

main.description: Create a versioned knowledge checkpoint (growth ring). Analogous to tree dendrochronology — each ring records conditions at a point in time, enabling knowledge graph time-travel queries.

period.description: ISO 8601 duration defining the ring period (e.g. PT1H, P1D, P1W)

snapshotCount.description: Number of artifacts captured in this ring

main.description: LLM-based structured synthesis of absorbed signals into a knowledge artifact. Analogous to photosynthesis — absorbed inputs are synthesized into structured knowledge (sugar) for downstream distribution.

absorbId.description: ID of the absorbed input to synthesize

main.description: Add a peer review or comment to a paper. reviewer_did = caller DID. review_type: peer | comment | editorial.
Endorse a paper (arXiv-style). Idempotent. Caller DID → edge_kiyo_endorses.
Get inbound and outbound citation edges for a paper from edge_kiyo_cites. Resolved DOIs linked via bunken.
Get paper metadata and latest revision info. Returns ipfsCid for fetching the PDF from https://ipfs.etzhayyim.com/ipfs/{cid}.
Get the IPFS gateway URL for a paper's PDF (or LaTeX source). Content is permanently accessible at https://ipfs.etzhayyim.com/ipfs/{cid} — no expiry (content-addressed, immutable).
Platform-wide statistics: total papers, subject breakdown, author count, recent activity from mv_kiyo_subject_stats.
List papers by a given author DID, with their h-index from mv_kiyo_author_hindex.
List papers with optional subject / authorType / date filters. Sorted by submittedAt DESC.

subject.description: Subject code filter (e.g. cs.AI)

main.description: Semantic search over papers using embedding cosine similarity (RisingWave SQL UDF kiyo_embed_query + list_cosine_similarity). Falls back to title ILIKE for unembedded papers.

Submit a new preprint to kiyo.etzhayyim.com. The PDF (and optionally LaTeX source) must be supplied as base64. A CIDv1 is assigned via ipfs.etzhayyim.com and stored in vertex_kiyo_paper. Triggers submitPaper.bpmn.

items.description: AT DID of each author

main.description: Submit a revised version of an existing paper. Caller must be the original owner_did. Triggers submitRevision.bpmn.
Withdraw a paper (sets status=withdrawn). Content remains on IPFS (content-addressed — immutable). Caller must be owner_did.
Primary fixation: capture a raw external signal (CO₂) into a structured vertex_koke_fixation row (glucose). Reversible until handoff to hakkou.

inputKind.description: Signal kind: text | url | record | stream

rawRef.description: Raw reference or content to fix

agentDid.description: DID of the kobo agent requesting fixation (optional)

main.description: Get fixation status and metadata for a given fixation ID.
List fixations, optionally filtered by status or classification.

status.description: Filter by status: fixed | released | handedOff

main.description: Release a fixation back to raw state (reversible CO₂ exhalation). Only valid while status='fixed'. Once handed off to hakkou, release is no longer possible.

involuntaryInterventionEventsTotal.description: If non-zero, requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 + clinical-judgment-via-mitate licensed clinician attestation per event

description: A single witness verdict on a kotoba-datomic record's membrane conformance. Produced by a Pregel cell selected via hash(record_cid) % len(fleet.cells) per kotoba-datomic SPEC §5. ≥3-of-5 matching attestations (default quorum) make the target record kotoba-datomic-L1-witnessed. Per ADR-2605231400.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the record being attested. Format: at://{did}/{collection}/{rkey}.

recordCid.description: Content identifier of the record being attested. Used for membrane evaluation reproducibility and as the input to hash(record_cid) % N_cells witness selection.

cellId.description: Murakumo Pregel cell ID that produced this attestation. Must match an entry in 50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml cells. Format: PascalCase (e.g., 'TitheRoutingCell', 'CharterAttestationRequestCell').

verdict.description: The cell's verdict on whether the record passes its kotoba-datomic-membrane (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph determinism check).

reason.description: Free-form reason. Required when verdict is 'reject' or 'escalate'. Audit-grade — surfaced in Council deliberation when escalation fires.

membraneVersion.description: Composite version string for the (Lexicon schema, Rego policy, LangGraph cell code) triple this attestation was computed against. Format: 'lex:{semver}/rego:{semver}/cell:{git-sha-7}'. Enables re-attestation when the membrane evolves.

signature.description: Cell-key signature over canonicalized (recordCid + cellId + verdict + reason + membraneVersion + attestedAt). Verified against the cell's published verification key in fleet.toml. Key rotation cadence: 90 days (fleet.cell_key_rotation_period_days).

quorumGroup.description: The 5-cell selection group this attestation belongs to. Computed as sha256(recordCid)[:16]. All 5 attestations for the same record share the same quorumGroup, enabling quorum collection by primary-key lookup.

escalationTarget.description: Required when verdict is 'escalate'. Names the escalation path: 'council' (Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig per ADR-2605192300), 'membrane-amendment' (proposed Lexicon / Rego / cell-code change), or 'human-review' (operator intervention).

description: DNA-equivalent (L1, L2, L3) triple manifest for a kotoba-datomic-mountable record kind. A record is kotoba-datomic-valid only if all three membrane layers (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph deterministic cell) accept it. Per kotoba-datomic SPEC §4 + ADR-2605231400.

nsid.description: The record kind this membrane rule applies to (e.g., 'com.etzhayyim.maps.building').

schemaRef.description: L1 — Lexicon schema reference. Path to a Lexicon JSON file under 00-contracts/lexicons/ with content hash.

policyRef.description: L2 — Rego policy reference. Path to a Rego module under 00-contracts/policies/ with content hash. Evaluates Charter Rider §2, doctrinal positions, and capability scope.

cellRef.description: L3 — LangGraph cell reference. Path to a Pregel cell directory under 40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/ with content hash of the deterministic step function source. Must be replica-deterministic per kotoba-datomic SPEC §7.

quorumSize.description: Number of witness cells to select for each write (Holochain-iso default: 5). Larger = stronger guarantee, more fleet load.

quorumThreshold.description: Minimum number of matching 'accept' attestations required to mark the record kotoba-datomic-witnessed (default: 3). Must be ≤ quorumSize and > quorumSize/2 for Byzantine-fault tolerance.

escalationPolicy.description: What to do when quorum is not reached. 'reject' = drop write, surface error to caller. 'council' = escalate to Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig (ADR-2605192300). 'pending' = retain record as unwitnessed, retry witness selection on a clock.

ciphertextOnly.description: When true, the membrane evaluates the record's envelope (signature, format) only and never decrypts the payload — used for com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* records per ADR-2605181100. The Rego policy and LangGraph cell receive a ciphertext-bytes input rather than the deserialized record.

supersedesNsid.description: If this membrane rule replaces an earlier rule for the same record kind (e.g., schema migration), name the prior rule's NSID. Old attestations remain valid against the prior rule; new writes are evaluated against this rule.

layerRef.description: Reference to a single membrane layer artifact (schema, policy, or cell) by repo-relative path + content hash. Content hash is sha256 of the canonicalized file contents — enables re-attestation reproducibility and membrane version pinning.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the layer artifact.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonicalized layer source. For Lexicon JSON: sorted-keys + LF newlines. For Rego: source as-is. For cell directory: sha256 over the sorted tar of the cell's tracked files.

version.description: Human-readable version label. Semver for schema / policy; git-sha-7 for cell.

description: Graph-layer pointer/fingerprint binding an actor to a real-world dataset it HOLDS. The actor's own did:key signs it; the canonical projection + raw blob live in the etzhayyim repo + DataLad/IPFS layer (ADR-2607010001 §D4). The same anchor fields are the RAD dataset:<id> sub-entity, so a holding has ONE field set, TWO representations: the signed RAD journal datom (sovereign attestation) and this signed graph record (runtime-discoverable pointer). holderRank names the ONE canonical owner per dataset.

main.description: A signed dataset pointer in the actor's PDS collection. Pointer-only by construction — bulk data never lives here; it lives at cidv1 in the repo+IPFS tier.

datasetId.description: Stable dataset identifier. MUST equal :rad/dataset-id in the RAD journal, :dataset-id in the *.kotoba.edn header, and ingest-id in ingest-provenance.json.

layer.description: graph = small signed pointer/fingerprint lives here; repo = canonical projection + raw blob live in the etzhayyim repo + IPFS/DataLad tier. A dataset may have a graph pointer whose cidv1 points at the repo-tier directory CID.

source.description: Origin service, e.g. wikidata:WDQS, gleif, nyc-pluto, fr-dvf, edgar, tdnet.

cidv1.description: Directory CID or canonical-projection CID. For layer=repo this MUST equal the directory CID at the holding repo's HEAD (pin==HEAD invariant).

freshnessDays.description: Re-ingest window in days; 0 = static reference (no stale-check).

retrieved.description: YYYY-MM-DD the dataset was last fetched.

holderRank.description: canonical = this actor is the canonical holder (attests the dataset); mirror = replicated from the canonical holder for local presentation. Exactly ONE actor holds canonical rank per dataset (ownership invariant).

countsTowardWorldCoverage.description: True if this dataset sums toward world-coverage accounting (mirrors the jinushi ingest-provenance field).

description: Per-DID mKOTO balance snapshot per ADR-2605282100 L3. Read-side projection of the canonical `balance/mkoto/<DID>` Quad maintained by kotoba-server. Caller-DID self-reads return the current balance; cross-DID reads require operator override or attestation chain match (ADR-2605231525). Non-negative invariant for external callers (ADR-2605282100 N5); SBT-bearer-internal callers may have negative balance up to a Council-set credit_line_mkoto at R2+.

subjectDid.description: DID whose balance this snapshot reflects.

balanceMkoto.description: mKOTO balance saturated to i64 (kotoba native). MUST be >= 0 for external callers (lacking SBT).

lastUpdatedSeq.description: kotoba-kse Journal seq of the latest balance-mutating event (debit / credit / stake-reclaim / royalty-credit). Caller can reconcile against this seq to detect stale snapshots.

observedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the snapshot was computed by kotoba-server.

tariffVersionInForce.description: Tariff version active at snapshot time. Lets the caller display 'balance covers ~N calls at current rates' UI.

sbtBearer.description: True iff subjectDid holds a religious-corp Adherent SBT per ADR-2605172600. Determines whether negative-balance carve-out is permitted (R2+).

description: Posted price schedule for the mKOTO economy per ADR-2605282100 L2. Versioned (semver-ish date string) and signed by Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain. R1.3a launch defaults are documented in ADR-2605282100 §'Initial tariff' (litellm-gateway: 100 mKOTO/gpu_sec + 10 mKOTO/MB; evo-x2: 250+10; mac-mini own-node: 30+5; webgpu-wasm: 1 mKOTO/1k gas). R2 ratification requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain emitting a new version record. NEVER allows commercial GPU rental endpoints — only the Murakumo fleet kinds present in 50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml (ADR-2605215000 + ADR-2605282100 N6).

version.description: Tariff version string (e.g. '2026-05-28' or 'r1.3a-launch'). Caller-side ndjson + balance/usage records reference this string so price-change reconciliation is exact.

rows.description: One row per fleet endpoint kind. Endpoint kind values MUST match the `backend` field of kotoba_murakumo._internal.routing.ResolvedRoute (e.g. 'litellm-gateway', 'evo-x2', 'mac-mini/<tribe>', 'webgpu-wasm').

councilAttestations.description: Council Lv6+ DIDs that attested this tariff version (per ADR-2605192300). Minimum 3-of-7 supermajority; 4+ on R2 critical-economy rev cycles.

signedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant of the latest signer's attestation.

supersedes.description: Prior tariff version this record supersedes; optional for v1 launch.

calibrationNote.description: Free-text rationale for the price calibration (e.g. PG&E rate basis, hardware amortization schedule, mKOTO-to-USDC ratio reference).

gpu_second_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per GPU-second of dispatch latency. 0 for kotoba-vm gas-priced backends.

egress_mb_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per MB of response body egress.

gas_per_1k_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per 1000 gas-units consumed (webgpu-wasm only; 0 for HTTP-routed backends).

description: Per-invocation usage + cost breakdown per ADR-2605282100 L1. Emitted by `kotoba_murakumo.function.Function._dispatch_*` after every live dispatch (sync, async, spawn, map, stream). Carries the same fields as the NDJSON log line + invocation linkage to the future `com.etzhayyim.murakumo.invocation` Lexicon (cross-link via `invocationCid`). Read-only audit trail; KaizenObserver downstream consumes the stream to detect Wellbecoming-vs-cost regressions per ADR-2605240200 rule R-cost-regression (R1.3e extension).

backend.description: Resolved backend identifier (matches the tariff row backend).

endpointUrl.description: Resolved endpoint URL (LAN-only per fleet.toml; never a commercial GPU rental URL per ADR-2605215000).

tariffVersion.description: Tariff version in force at dispatch time (joins to com.etzhayyim.kotoba.economy.tariff).

costMkoto.description: Actual mKOTO debited from caller balance for this invocation.

costEstimatedMkoto.description: Pre-flight estimate carried for over/under reconciliation.

charterIn.description: Charter Rider §2 scan severity on input (per ADR-2605192200 + ADR-2605282000 §'Charter Rider §2 scan hook').

invocationCid.description: CID linking to the future com.etzhayyim.murakumo.invocation record (R1.3e cross-link).

gpuMilliseconds.description: GPU-time consumed by this invocation, in integer milliseconds. Equal to latencyMs for HTTP-routed LLM dispatch (whole call is on-GPU); diverges from latencyMs for kotoba-vm WASM Component dispatch (where part of the elapsed time is host-side BSP scheduling). Religious-corp Lexicon convention: no float types — implied unit is documented per ADR-2605190900.

coldStart.description: Modal-parity: true iff this invocation triggered a cold-start surcharge (R2 wiring).

description: A member-facing self-help session for a single consumer matter (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_intake). Holds the walkthrough + checklist pulled from a chigiri template (G5 — diagnosis + drafting-assist, never legal advice/representation). CONSTITUTIONAL: member-initiated + consent + DID/SBT bound, OWN matter only (G3); the member is the named complainant (G4). Holds session metadata + checklist state, not plaintext member PII or contract content (G6).

memberDid.description: The consenting member's DID (G3); the complainant (G4)

remedyRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the remedyTarget being pursued

templateRef.description: chigiri template id this session renders (G5 boundary)

merchantRef.description: Merchant identifier (name/handle); contract PII detail stays encrypted (G6)

consentRef.description: Reference to the member's recorded consent (G3)

description: An INFORMATIONAL cooling-off window computation for a member's contract (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_cooloff_check). CONSTITUTIONAL (G5): this is a DATE COMPUTATION against the cited statute (window start + 日数 → deadline), explicitly NOT a legal opinion or rights-determination — `isLegalOpinion` is const false. The member always confirms + a borderline/complex case routes to chigiri + licensed counsel. Contract dates are PII-minimised; full contract detail stays in com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* (G6).

memberDid.description: The member whose contract is assessed (G3)

remedyRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the cooling-off remedyTarget (supplies 日数 + 起算)

sessionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the parent complaintSession

isLegalOpinion.description: G5 — ALWAYS false. This is an informational date computation, never a legal opinion. Schema-level invariant.

withinWindow.description: Whether today is within the computed statutory window (informational)

computedDeadline.description: Computed window-end (起算日 + 日数); informational

computationNote.description: How the date was computed + caveats (起算日 assumptions, exclusions); routes complex cases to chigiri

encryptedContractRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding contract detail (G6); never inline

memberConfirmed.description: G8 — the member has confirmed the input facts (contract date/type)

description: A record of a cooling-off/complaint dispatch to a merchant (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_send). Two `mode`s: `member-self-send` (default, R2 — kurashimori assembled + handed back, the member sent) and `agent-on-behalf` (代行, R3 GATED — kurashimori sent the member's OWN notice via a lawful channel). CONSTITUTIONAL: `agent-on-behalf` is permitted ONLY when the remedy is `council-verified` (G14), per-submission consent is recorded, and the R3 gate (司法書士法/行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+) is satisfied (G15); only external action is a lawful, non-harassing communication via a legitimate channel with member authorization (G10); member is the named complainant (G4); no platform-held signing key (ADR-2605231525). Holds metadata + pointers, never inline content (G6).

draftRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the remedyDraft sent

mode.description: G15 — member-self-send is the default; agent-on-behalf (代行) is the GATED R3 exception

channel.description: The lawful channel used (G10); naiyo-shomei = 内容証明郵便

consentRef.description: Per-dispatch consent artifact (G3; mandatory for agent-on-behalf, G15)

councilGateRef.description: For mode=agent-on-behalf: reference to the on-chain Council Lv7+ + 司法書士法/行政書士法 clearance gate (G15). Absent ⇒ agent-on-behalf is invalid.

receiptRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the dispatch receipt / 追跡番号 (G6)

description: A referral routing a stalled self-help matter to a lawful external forum (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_escalation): 消費生活センター / 消費者ホットライン 188 / ADR (指定紛争解決機関) / chigiri + licensed counsel. CONSTITUTIONAL: kurashimori ROUTES, it does not represent (G5/N1); legal characterization + representation happen at the destination; member PII stays encrypted (G6). The referral is a pointer + rationale, never inline contract/complaint content.

forum.description: The lawful external forum routed to

rationale.description: Why escalation (self-help stalled / representation needed); NOT a legal determination (G5)

targetRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the escalation remedyTarget (for center/ADR routes)

description: A drafted cooling-off 通知 / refund demand / complaint artifact (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_compose). kurashimori ASSISTS the member in drafting; the member reviews + owns + (default) sends it. CONSTITUTIONAL: drafting-assistance, NOT 作成代理 reserved to 司法書士/弁護士 (G5; only representable assistMode is 'drafting-assist'); the draft must use lawful, non-threatening language (G10); the member always confirms before send (G8); the draft content lives ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds the POINTER + metadata, never inline content.

memberDid.description: The member who owns the draft (complainant, G3/G4)

sessionRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the parent complaintSession

encryptedDraftRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the draft (G6); never inline content

assistMode.description: Always drafting-assist — never 作成代理 (G5). Schema-level invariant: no other value representable.

memberConfirmed.description: G8 — the member has reviewed + confirmed the draft before it may be sent

description: Coded consumer-remedy TARGET registry entry — one record per remedy kind × jurisdiction, holding the remedy kind / 根拠法令 / statutory window (日数) / 書面 form / delivery channel / escalation forum so a kurashimori cell can diagnose + (eventually) send procedurally (ADR-2605312500 §2). OPEN DATA (derived from the authority's published guidance; provenance mandatory). CONSTITUTIONAL: `verificationStatus` gates live send (G14) — statutory windows (日数) drift and a wrong 日数 is harmful, so seeds enable diagnosis-design only. Never fabricate (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` mandatory.

statutoryWindowDays.description: Statutory window in days (cooling-off/return); 0 if N/A. A WRONG value is harmful — G14 verify.

windowStart.description: 起算日 description (when the clock starts)

formRef.description: chigiri template id used to compose this remedy

deliveryChannel.description: How the notice is sent (内容証明 / 電子 / portal / 電話)

escalationForum.description: Where to escalate if self-help stalls

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 — MANDATORY (G8), e.g. '特定商取引法 §9'

verificationStatus.description: G14 send gate. unverified-seed => diagnosis-design only, NO live send.

description: Tracks a dispatched consumer remedy's outcome (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_status_track): merchant response / refund / window-expiry clock; on stall, flags for escalation. CONSTITUTIONAL: track only, no coercion / no harassment follow-up (G10/G11); any member-identifying outcome detail lands ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* DID-bound envelope (G6) — this record holds status metadata + pointers, never inline content.

dispatchRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the dispatchRecord being tracked

outcomeRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding outcome detail (G6); never inline

main.description: An Outlook/Google calendar event classified and routed to a kyber department. Subject is encrypted; attendee graph is indexable.
An Office document (Excel/Word/PowerPoint/PDF) from OneDrive/SharePoint, classified and routed to a kyber department. Filename/content encrypted; path/size/author are routing metadata.

An Outlook/Gmail email classified and routed to a kyber department (accounting/hr/procurement/inventory/sales/it/strategy). Body/subject are encrypted via wproto signal:v1 envelope. Repo record stores only hash + routing metadata (PII Tier 3).

APQC coverage summary: registered L1 actors (/13), bound BPMN tasks, observed OCEL events per L1 in the period.
Compatibility query for one APQC/BPMN process by processId/taskId.
Compatibility query for a single APQC process group. Resolves one APQC L1 group and its BPMN-bound processes.

period.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD period for activity counts

List registered APQC L1 actor DIDs with coverage summary.
List BPMN 2.0 task bindings to APQC codes. Each task carries {taskId, apqcCode, taskType, ocelEventType, kyberCollection}.

Compatibility query for APQC process groups. In kyber-projector, a process group maps to one APQC L1 actor/DID.

period.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD period for activity counts

scope.description: all | l1-only | { apqcCode: '9.0' } for single L1

apqcCode.description: Single L1 code (e.g. 9.0) when scope != all

main.description: Execute a BPMN task bound to an APQC code. Creates a processInstance record (Design E Tier 2), emits an OCEL event (apqcEvent collection), and performs the task effect (e.g. post to dept DID, notify subscriber).

description: Records a jurisdictional or property-rights challenge against a parcel held in the etzhayyim Land Trust. The land donation is constitutionally inalienable per ADR-2605192245 — the challenge does NOT unwind the donation, regardless of outcome. This record exists for transparent documentation per ADR-2605192315 (Transparent Religious Force). Resolution requires Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) + Seat 3 (Legal/Ethics) deliberation; Council attestation ≥3-of-5 multisig post-bootstrap.

challengerCategory.description: Who is challenging. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

challengerJurisdiction.description: State / national / international jurisdiction identifier (e.g., 'JP', 'US-CA', 'EU', 'ICC'). Free-form to accommodate multi-jurisdictional reality.

claimSummary.description: Markdown summary of the claim against the parcel. Public — no encryption (transparent per ADR-2605192315).

resolutionStatus.description: Current resolution state. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

resolutionNarrative.description: Markdown narrative of the resolution. Required when resolutionStatus is non-filed/deliberating. Note: 'resolved-stewardship-amended' indicates the challenge prompted a stewardship-roster change via `com.etzhayyim.give.land.stewardSuccession` — the on-chain NFT remains in the Trust.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the challenge was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent resolutionStatus / resolutionNarrative update.

description: An outbound artifact that constitutes a LEGAL ACT (court filing / postulation, pleading / 準備書面, formal notice / 内容証明, demand or representation letter) transmitted through the etzhayyim counsel-operated comms gateway (fax / email / e-filing). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605302345 §D2. CONSTITUTIONAL (G18): every legal-act artifact MUST be actuated and signed by a HUMAN lawyer licensed in the destination jurisdiction, using their own credential — etzhayyim holds NO signing key, seal or credential for any legal act (extends no-server-key ADR-2605231525). `counselActuation` is required and carries the actuating lawyer's DID + license jurisdiction + their signature reference; `actuatedByLicensedCounsel` MUST be true; the record carries NO corp-held signing-key property (those are unrepresentable at the schema layer). Non-legal-act material (scheduling, adherent-authored document delivery) does NOT use this record. The corp orchestrates; counsel acts. UPL (G14) and the lawyer monopoly on reserved activities are preserved.

destinationJurisdiction.description: ISO jurisdiction of the receiving court/party, e.g. jpn

artifactClass.description: Class of legal act. Each value is a RESERVED activity that only licensed counsel may perform (ADR-2605302200).

transport.description: Gateway transport used. Transport is a PIPE; lawfulness comes from counselActuation, not the pipe.

actuatedByLicensedCounsel.description: G18 anchor — MUST be true. A legal act with no licensed-counsel actuation is unrepresentable.

counselActuation.description: DID-bound attestation that a human licensed lawyer actuated and signed this artifact with their own credential.

counselDid.description: DID of the human lawyer licensed in destinationJurisdiction who actuated the act.

licenseJurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of the actuating lawyer's license; MUST match destinationJurisdiction (or DE: Befähigung zum Richteramt; US: bar admission).

counselSignatureRef.description: Reference to the lawyer's OWN signature/credential on the artifact. The platform holds no signing key (no-server-key ADR-2605231525).

description: Quarterly Liberation Metric aggregate report (no PII). Mission KPI for ADR-2605261000 §4. Published by ChartersComplianceRegistry.reportLiberationMetric(). Aggregation enforced structurally (cf. ADR-2605260215 yakushi cross-actor AE aggregation pattern). All quantities are integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float types in Lexicons).

aggregateLaborHoursReduction.description: All labor-hours figures are centihours per week (1 hr/wk = 100). e.g. 38.2 hr/wk = 3820.

totalReductionMedianCentihrsWk.description: Median total labor-hours reduction vs join baseline, centihours/week (×100)

achievementRatioPermille.description: totalReduction / targetReduction, per-mille (×1000); stage advances only at ≥800 (=0.8) × 2 consecutive quarters

wellbecomingFailureRateBps.description: Fraction of adherents currently on stage-hold for Wellbecoming attestation failure, basis points (×10000; 0.012 = 120)

exitRateBps.description: Voluntary stage-exit rate for the quarter, basis points (×10000)

basicHighIncome.description: Non-cash income/asset accounting per ADR-2605301020 (Basic High Income doctrine — clarifying extension of this ADR's §5 N1). Aggregate-only; no per-adherent figures (no leaderboard → no class formation, §7 + N6). Computed by toritate (ADR-2605262900) imputed_income_compute + commons_asset_value cells over encrypted per-adherent figures (ADR-2605181100). cashStipendUsdMicros is a structural invariant fixed at 0 = on-chain proof that N1 (no fiat-replacement UBI) holds. All USD quantities are micros (1 USD = 1000000) per ADR-2605190900.

imputedIncomeMedianUsdMicrosYr.description: FLOW. Market-equivalent value of in-kind services consumed per adherent at this stage (trailing 12-month median), USD micros/year (×1e6). NOT cash paid — provisioning is in-kind. Valued via the versioned table named in imputedIncomeValuationMethod.

imputedIncomeValuationMethod.description: Versioned valuation-method id resolving to an open, Council-attested table under orgs/etzhayyim/com-etzhayyim-toritate/valuation/ (e.g. v1-retail-equiv). Method-versioning makes the imputed figure auditable.

commonsAssetAccessMedianUsdMicros.description: STOCK. Market-equivalent value of the SBT-bound NON-ALIENABLE commons-asset ACCESS per adherent (Land Trust residency / actor-mesh productive output / kotoba data substrate / hikari energy infra), USD micros (×1e6). An access right, never title — never sellable, transferable, collateralizable, or inheritable as title (ADR-2605301020 §2; generalizes ADR-2605192245 land waqf inalienability).

highIncomeBenchmarkRatioPermille.description: (imputedIncome + commonsAssetAccess) measured against the OECD upper-income-decile household consumption basket, per-mille (×1000). Target ≥1000 (=1.0) at L6 (a target, not a promise — N8 asymptotic); rises across the ladder.

cashStipendUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT ≡ 0. Its presence-and-zero in EVERY report is the structural on-chain proof that §5 N1 holds (no cash stipend replaces a wage; the wage's NEED is removed by in-kind provisioning). Any nonzero value is a constitutional violation.

publicFundReserveUsdcMicros.description: Current Public Fund USDC reserve vs §3 sizing target, USDC micros (×1e6)

description: Per-stage advancement attestation (L_n → L_{n+1}). Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig + per-stage activation gate checks per ADR-2605261000 §6. Each transition is its own ADR.

transitionAdrCid.description: The ADR authorizing this specific stage transition

previousStageMetricRatio.description: Achievement ratio of previous stage ≥0.8 × 2 quarters

Carries the facet/embed source fields consumed by the derive rule `page-published-social` in kotodama.jsonld to auto-emit a thread-reply app.bsky.feed.post. The page image is carried as app.bsky.embed.recordWithMedia (record = strongRef to self; media = embed.images with compositedImageCid); charactersAppearing[] becomes facet#mention entries; the chapterRef is resolved via the derive engine's {{derived(record.chapterRef).strongRef}} expression to set reply.root / reply.parent for thread continuity.

chapterRef.description: strongRef to com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.chapter. Resolved by derive engine to set reply.root/parent on the derived post (threaded after the chapter-published post).

compositedImageCid.description: Blob CID of the composited full-page image (layers flattened, uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob). Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image. Target dimensions: portrait PNG, W=1080 H≈1920 for mobile-comfortable reading.

altText.description: Alt text for the page image (a11y). Recommended to include speaker-attributed dialogue + panel-order summary.

width.description: Pixel width of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.width.

height.description: Pixel height of compositedImageCid. Used for embed.images[].aspectRatio.height.

panels.description: Per-panel geometry + dialogue. Not exposed in the derived post directly; used by the full-screen reader (mangaka.etzhayyim.com/at/...) for panel-level navigation, and by yabai-style LLM downstream workers for per-panel analysis.

charactersAppearing.description: Characters appearing on this page (subset of chapter.charactersAppearing). Derive rule expands each into app.bsky.richtext.facet#mention with did = did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug}. Keep the list tight (page-scope) to avoid mention spam in the thread reply.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI Engine native layered document (ink / tone / color / sketch). Consumed by the full-screen reader for editable load; not used by the derived social post.

panel.description: Inline panel geometry within a page. Mirrors com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.panel record fields for embedded read models; panel records may still be created separately if per-panel federated addressing is needed.

x.description: Top-left x in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.

y.description: Top-left y in normalized [0,1] page coordinates.
