description: AT Protocol counterpart of an Adherent SBT mint event on Base L2. The SBT is a non-transferable ERC-721 minted to a member's Smart Account when one of three trigger conditions is met (per ADR-2605192100 §1.16 + ADR-2605192300): a first donation, an explicit Charter Affirmation, or a Council-granted bootstrap mint. This record carries the trigger reference, the on-chain mint transaction hash, and the hash of the Charter Affirmation message the member signed. Constitutional: 1 SBT = 1 vote (no tiers), non-transferable, voluntary withdrawal permitted via `com.etzhayyim.member.withdrawal` (not yet authored — surfaced gap).

memberDid.description: DID of the member receiving the Adherent SBT. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, member must operate a religious DID.

tokenId.description: Base L2 Adherent SBT ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, unitless serial integer; minimum 1 — token 0 is reserved per OpenZeppelin convention).

mintTxHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the AdherentSBT.mint() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

trigger.description: What caused the SBT to be minted. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

triggerRef.description: Optional AT URI of the triggering record: if `first-donation`, the AT URI of the `com.etzhayyim.give.usdc.donation` or `com.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record; if `council-grant`, the AT URI of the Council proposal authorizing the grant.

affirmationHashOnchain.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext Charter Affirmation message the member signed with their DID key. The plaintext is stored separately as `com.etzhayyim.member.charter-affirmation` (not yet authored — surfaced gap). Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of SBT mint observation.

description: SBT↔SBT internal purchase record. Per ADR-2605192115 §3 (SBT internal carve-out), purchases between two Adherent SBT holders within the religious-corp boundary are permitted — distinct from external commerce, which is prohibited. This Lexicon records the AT Protocol counterpart of the on-chain internal transfer. Both parties must hold an Adherent SBT at the moment of the transaction (verified by the InternalCommerce contract on Base L2). Allowed scope: religious goods, services rendered between adherents (e.g., translation work, hospitality), consensual support arrangements. NOT for: external SaaS sales, subscriptions to non-adherents, advertising-supported commerce. Tithe DOES NOT apply (the carveout's purpose is intra-organism commerce; the 10% tithe is for external donations only).

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

sellerDid.description: DID of the seller. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

amountMicros.description: Purchase amount in currency micros (6 decimal places for USDC). Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900. Minimum 1 to prevent dust-spam.

currency.description: Settlement currency. Currently only USDC is supported (per ADR-2605172100 — no fiat processors). Future expansion via Council ratification.

itemDescription.description: Free-form markdown description of what was purchased. Both parties' SBT identity is on-chain; the description records the substantive content of the exchange.

itemCategory.description: Optional category for analytics. Religious-corp-appropriate categories only.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the InternalCommerce contract call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record` wrapping a private note (receipt, terms, agreement details) between buyer and seller.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of internal purchase.

description: 信者 Level 0 entry record (ADR-2605302357 §1.16.3a + ADR-2605302358 Stage 1). The triple-permanent commitment vow: 悔い改め・バプテスマ・得度 = social death and rebirth, recorded to kotoba EAVT + IPFS + soulbound token. PII-FREE: name/email/contact live ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope (ADR-2605181100); this record carries only the commitment fact + refs.

vowTextCid.description: IPFS CID of the canonical vow liturgy text the member consented to (悔い改め・バプテスマ・得度); Council-attested per §1.16.3a / 2358 Open Q2

threefold.description: the three conversion elements, each explicitly affirmed

kotobaDatomRef.description: content-addressed ref to the EAVT datom persisting this vow (ADR-2605262130)

ipfsCid.description: IPFS pin CID of the vow record (permanence layer; ADR-2605171800)

sbtRef.description: Adherent SBT (ERC-5192 soulbound, single-per-person) id binding this CID (ADR-2605172600)

signature.description: member WebAuthn passkey / wallet signature over the vow payload

didBound.description: the member DID this vow is soulbound to (did:web / did:plc)

memberSigned.description: INVARIANT G3: vow is member-signed; no platform-held key (ADR-2605231525) ever signs a vow

cashConsiderationUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT N1: no cash is paid to OR by the adherent for entry; entry is a vow, not a purchase

stage.description: entry stage is always L0 (Liberation Ladder; ADR-2605261000)

encryptedPiiRef.description: OPTIONAL ref to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding member PII (ADR-2605181100); never PII inline (G6)

repentance.description: 悔い改め (metanoia) — turn from the prior orientation; affirmed

baptism.description: バプテスマ — death of the prior self, raised to new life; affirmed

tokudo.description: 得度 — end of the householder self, new birth into the community; affirmed

description: kotoba-datomic §4 membrane verdict — a content-addressed witness that an L3 deterministic cell evaluated a record under the (L1 schema, L2 Rego, L3 cell) triple defined for its collection. Emitted by Pregel cells (e.g. FeedPostCell for app.bsky.feed.post) into the cell's own MST as a sidecar. Per ADR-2605231400 SPEC §4 + ADR-2605192200 §2 + ADR-2605192400. Approve/reject/escalate verdicts let downstream consumers (kotoba-datomic-projection, mst-projector, ipfs-pinner) decide whether to propagate the original record into the projection cache, anchor it, or quarantine it pending Council review.

subject.description: AT URI + CID of the record being adjudicated.

verdict.description: Deterministic verdict. `escalate` means the cell could not decide alone and routes to CouncilDeliberationCell (Lv6+ ≥3) per ADR-2605192300.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code. Examples: `ok`, `schema-violation`, `charter-or-semantic-violation`, `council-required`.

evidence.description: Per-finding evidence. Sorted by (category, evidence) for determinism — same input MUST produce byte-identical evidence array.

verdictCid.description: Content-addressed verdict hash. `sha256-<hex>` of canonical JSON of (record_cid, kind, reason, sorted_evidence). Re-running the cell on the same input MUST yield the same verdictCid.

regoModule.description: OPA package name of the L2 policy module consulted, e.g. `app.bsky.feed.post`. Optional; emitted when the verdict consumed an external Rego decision rather than the in-cell mirror.

cellId.description: Pregel cell name that produced the verdict, e.g. `FeedPostCell`. Matches a key in `50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml [cells.*]`.

createdAt.description: Verdict timestamp. Sourced from the dispatcher's ctx.now, never the cell's local clock — required for determinism (cell can be re-run from MST history).

category.description: One of: `2a`..`2h` (Charter Rider category codes), `advertising`, `eschatology`, `gore`, `gore-educational`, `ja-prohibited`, `schema`, `length`, `missing-required`, `external` (delegated OPA decision).

evidence.description: Short evidence string. For Charter Rider hits: the matched lexical term. For schema: the field/constraint name. Truncated to 512 chars.

main.description: The kept party's CONSENT making a bond active (G3) — kept-signed, never keeper-signed. State transitions are append-only; exit is unilateral, unconditional, penalty-free. decline and exit are enum members; erase is NOT (永久記憶 Tier-0 — though no private content exists in datoms to erase, G6).

state.description: → :mishmeret.bond/state. G2/G5 INVARIANT — score / risk / watchlist states are NOT enum members; erase is NOT an enum member (append-only).

main.description: A covenant-keeping OFFER (縁の申し出) from a keeper to a kept candidate. Refusable, expirable, cooldown-bound (G3 anti-pestering). NEVER creates an active bond by itself — consent (bondCovenant) is a separate, kept-signed record.

keeperDid.description: → :mishmeret.bond/keeper. The one who offers to keep.

keptDid.description: → :mishmeret.bond/kept. The one offered the covenant. G4 INVARIANT — the offer is addressed to and visible to this party; there is no keeper-only hidden state.

synthetic.description: G7 INVARIANT — true at R0 (fictional DIDs only). Real-roster offers are Council + operator gated.

ceremonyRef.description: → :mishmeret.bond/ceremony. Optional musubi 結 ceremony record (shomer vow, ADR-2606112300 §D5).

main.description: A CONSENTED routing of a concern to a care actor (G1). The kept consents to THIS routing, each time (G3) — routing is an offer of care, never a report about a person. The target enum is the whole representable surface: there is no denunciation rail.

to.description: → :mishmeret.route/to. G1 INVARIANT — care actors ONLY. police / authority / council / employer / family are NOT enum members (五人組→Stasi degeneration structurally blocked).

keptConsents.description: → :mishmeret.route/consent. G3 INVARIANT — must be true; per-act, never standing.

main.description: AGGREGATE-ONLY coverage of 誰の保持者でもない人間を作らない (G5 NEVER-a-throne): counts only, no per-person field exists in this schema. The unkept are reached by the offer-matching cell directly (one covenant offer at a time, G7-gated) — never via a list.

offersPending.description: Members with a standing, unanswered offer (aggregate).

unkeptCount.description: THE GAP — members with no keeper and no pending offer. G5 INVARIANT: a count, never a list; no DID field exists in this record.

main.description: A CONTENT-FREE keeping heartbeat (G6): attests the ACT of reaching out, never its content. There is no message, observation, note, or assessment field — by construction, not by policy. Private content lives only in com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelopes (member-held keys, ADR-2605181100). Feeds the keeper-side social-capital mint (moyai-family, ADR-2606082100 Part A) — never any record about the kept.

act.description: → :mishmeret.keep/act. G6 INVARIANT — the single representable act. observed / reported / assessed / flagged are NOT enum members.

cycle.description: → :mishmeret.keep/cycle. No frequency mandate, no streak, no badge (G8/N5).

main.description: A keeper RELAY (継ぎ, G5): finite keepers in succession — no sleepless center, no permanent universal keeper (ADR-2606112200 D3 NEVER-a-throne; 詩篇121:4 realized as relay). The kept's standing covenant carries over only via a fresh offer + consent by the incoming keeper.

bondRef.description: → :mishmeret.relay/bond. The bond being handed off (state → handed-off).

toKeeperDid.description: → :mishmeret.relay/to. The keeper who watches next. G4 — visible to the kept like every bond party.

main.description: An entity-as-actor MIRROR record (ADR-2606042330). One public/power entity datafied by a knowledge-graph actor (ooyake / kabuto / tsumugi / kanjo / watatsuna / watari) → one keyless did:web mirror-actor. This is etzhayyim's public-fact record of the entity, NOT the entity itself and NOT an official channel (no impersonation, G1). Natural persons are NOT representable here (G3): there is no person-subject field, and performerType cannot be 'person'.

handle.description: single-label actor handle, e.g. 'corp-tw-tsmc' / 'gov-afg-adm1-af-bal'. Resolves did:web:etzhayyim.com:actor:<handle>.

namespace.description: entity namespace; selects the owning KG actor + ontology

entityId.description: source kotoba entity id, e.g. ':company/id org.corp.tw.tsmc' — the dotted id the handle is derived from

displayName.description: the entity's public name (organization/system label — never a person)

isMirror.description: G1 — ALWAYS a mirror; an entity-actor never speaks AS the entity

serverHeldKey.description: G5 — the server holds NO key for this actor; verificationMethod is empty (mirror of on-chain ERC725, never server-minted, ADR-2605231525)

performerType.description: G3 — organization or system ONLY. 'person' is deliberately excluded (a public organ / legal person / craft, never a natural person)

ownerActors.description: KG actor handle(s) that maintain this mirror (e.g. ['kabuto','tsumugi','kanjo'])

sourcing.description: G7 sourcing honesty — most seed entities are :representative

disclaimer.description: G1 observation-only disclaimer; MUST open the profile description

main.description: A social-timeline post for an entity mirror-actor (ADR-2606042330 D4). Projects ONE material change in the entity's kotoba Datom as-of history (a new 決算 filing, a cable fault bulletin, a gov-unit procedure/address change, a craft chokepoint transit, a supply-edge rewiring) into an app.bsky.feed.post authored by the mirror-actor's DID. The timeline IS the entity's append-only as-of trajectory — there is no 'final state' post (非終末論, ADR-2605312345). Body is Murakumo-narrated (ADR-2605215000). LIVE publication to the atproto firehose is Council + operator gated (G8); R0 = dry-run projection only.

actorHandle.description: the mirror-actor authoring this post, e.g. 'corp-tw-tsmc'

datomTxCid.description: kotoba transaction CID of the as-of delta this post projects (content-addressed; the post is auditable back to the Datom log)

asOf.description: the Datom as-of instant; becomes the post createdAt (history, not now)

narrator.description: G6 — narration is Murakumo-only; no off-Murakumo inference

isMirror.description: G1 — the post is etzhayyim's record of a public fact, never the entity speaking

published.description: G8 — false at R0 (dry-run); true only after Council + operator gate for live firehose publication

description: Per-order immutable consent receipt for 要配慮個人情報 (APPI 第2条第3項 / 個人情報保護法 / GDPR Art. 9 special category / HIPAA PHI equivalent) transfer to an external clinical laboratory or to iyashi internal phlebotomy. Binds 1:1 to a `mitate.diagnosticOrder` via `orderRefCid`. Per ADR-2605281950 GC (mandatory, non-back-datable, revocable until 30d after result delivery) + ADR-2605181100 (encrypted envelope substrate) + ADR-2605260100 G7 (sealed-recipient set structurally excludes insurance / employer / advertiser / state-aligned entities). Template version is annually reviewed by chigiri (ADR-2605262700) per ADR-2605281950 §D2.

patientPseudonymDid.description: 30-day-rotating mitate patient pseudonym DID. Distinct from `consentingAdherentDid` (the underlying Adherent SBT signer). Reinforces ADR-2605260100 G2 (mitate sealed-recipient set).

orderRefCid.description: Binds 1:1 to a `mitate.diagnosticOrder` record. Validators MUST verify the bound order's `consentReceiptCid` resolves back to this receipt.

templateVersion.description: Semver of the chigiri-stewarded consent template (`major.minor.patch`). Template changes require chigiri annual review (ADR-2605281950 GC).

jurisdictions.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3. Permitted patient jurisdiction(s) + receiving lab jurisdiction. Cross-border consent surfaces (multiple values) trigger chigiri multi-juris review path.

senderRecipientDids.description: Sealed-recipient registry. Permitted DID prefixes: patient passkey DID, licensed MD attestor DID (`did:web:etzhayyim.com:mitate:physician:*`), receiving external lab DID (must be in EXTERNAL_LAB_DID_REGISTRY), Council medical advisory DIDs. EXCLUDED by structural enforcement (ADR-2605260100 G7 + ADR-2605281950 GD): insurance / employer / advertiser / state-aligned entities.

dataCategoriesShared.description: Per ADR-2605281950 §D2. At R2 the categories `family-history` / `genetic-marker` are NOT permitted (out of scope per N1, N3). Extension requires Council Lv7+ unanimity per non-goal status.

revocableUntilUtc.description: Hard revocation deadline. Default: result delivery + 30 days. Revocation triggers downstream deletion request to external lab DID; per ADR-2605281950 GC.

consentingAdherentDid.description: Patient's underlying Adherent SBT DID. Distinct from `patientPseudonymDid`; signature surface for the consent receipt.

description: Diagnostic test ordering — allergy serology, blood / clinical-chemistry panels, cytology, imaging, in-clinic instrument acquisitions — to external clinical lab (with iyashi.phlebotomyAttestation when religious-corp clinic performs venipuncture) or community center equipment. Inherits G1 (consent receipt CID mandatory) + G2 (resultDeliveryChannel must be encrypted-mst-envelope) + G4 (R2+ licensed MD physicianAttestorDid mandatory) from ADR-2605260100. R2+ phase only. Rhinitis-domain enums per ADR-2605260115 §Decision 2 (IgE) + ADR-2605260145 §Decision 3 (CT) + ADR-2605260160 §Decision 2 (rhinomanometry). General blood / chemistry enums + iyashi-internal routing target + diagnosticConsentReceipt binding added per ADR-2605281950.

orderType.description: Per ADR-2605281950: 16 general blood / clinical-chemistry / urinalysis orderType values appended (R2+ activate). Rhinitis-scoped orderType set unchanged. Excluded by N1..N11 of ADR-2605281950: genetic / DTC / NIPT / oncology markers / fertility hormones / STI / heavy-metal / forensic / employer-screen / in-vivo skin prick.

conditionContext.description: Per ADR-2605281950: 18 general (non-rhinitis) conditionContext values appended (R2+ activate). Each context is community-primary-care-scoped. Out of scope (constitutional non-goals): genetic markers, NIPT, oncology screening, fertility hormones, STI testing, forensic / employer screen — see ADR-2605281950 §D6.

consentReceiptCid.description: Mandatory (G1 + ADR-2605281950 GC). MUST resolve to an `com.etzhayyim.mitate.diagnosticConsentReceipt` record (or, for rhinitis-domain orders predating ADR-2605281950, the legacy generic encrypted consent record). Procedure-level consent, distinct from intake-level consent.

orderRoutingTarget.description: R2+ (ADR-2605281950). 'iyashi-internal' = phlebotomy by religious-corp iyashi clinic (requires linked `com.etzhayyim.iyashi.phlebotomyAttestation`); 'external-lab' = specimen drawn elsewhere or assay-only at external facility. Optional at R0/R1; required at R2+.

physicianAttestorDid.description: Mandatory (G4). Licensed MD DID attesting clinical indication. Must be in LICENSED_MD_REGISTRY (Council-attested).

scopedAntigens.description: Only for orderType = 'ige-panel-*'. WHO IUIS allergen nomenclature (e.g. 'Der-f-1', 'Fel-d-1', 'Cry-j-1').

externalLabDid.description: For orderType requiring external facility (ige-panel, ct, mri, culture). Must be in EXTERNAL_LAB_DID_REGISTRY.

internalEquipmentDid.description: For orderType using mitate community center equipment (smear / endoscopy / rhinomanometry). Must be in equipment registry (Hanami / Mimi / rhinomanometer).

resultDeliveryChannel.description: G2 mandatory. Plaintext delivery channel is prohibited.

description: Diagnostic test result (IgE panel / nasal smear / endoscopy / rhinomanometry / paranasal CT) returned by external lab or community center equipment. Full result data (lab values, DICOM, images, classification confidence) is XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted (encryptedResultEnvelope) — public fields contain only metadata + verdict summary (positive/negative, severity score, key value). G2 + G4 + G9 (witness N ≥ 2 = operator DID + licensed MD attestor DID). Per ADR-2605260100 + per-condition sub-ADRs.

operatorDid.description: G9 witness #1 — external lab DID, or internal equipment operator DID (Hanami / Mimi / rhinomanometer operator).

physicianAttestorDid.description: G4 + G9 witness #2 — licensed MD attestor DID. For imaging (endoscopy / CT) must be specialist (ENT / radiologist).

encryptedResultEnvelope.description: G2 mandatory. CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope. Contains: full lab values, DICOM, images, classification confidence, classifier model variant CID (G13). Sealed-recipient = patient + Council medical advisory + this physicianAttestorDid + (for ESS planning) surgeon DID set.

keyValue.description: Public summary value (e.g. 'eosinophil 28%', 'Lund-Mackay 14/24', 'rhinomanometry 0.42 Pa/cm³/s @ 150Pa', 'IgE-Df1 class-3'). MUST NOT contain patient-identifying detail.

classifierModelCid.description: G13 — open-weights model variant CID used for image/microscopy classification. Reproducibility for bias audit.

description: G5 fail-safe red-flag escalation record. Emitted by mitate_emergency_screen cell when red-flag pattern detected (anaphylaxis / orbital cellulitis / septal abscess / 髄膜炎 / 視力低下 / 意識障害 / 突然の重度頭痛). Triggers immediate ER routing instruction to patient PWA + on-call DID urgency-only push notification (G11 carve-out: emergency ack is one of the 3 permitted notification types). Public ack only — no patient identity in record. Per ADR-2605260100 §Decision 3 G5 (architectural invariant: bypass 不可).

intakeUri.description: Back-reference to rhinitisIntake record. Patient pseudonym DID is NOT included here (G10) — only the intake reference. To resolve to patient, decryption of intake envelope is required (G2 access).

erRoutingInstruction.description: Jurisdiction-aware patient-facing instruction (Japan: 119 救急車 / nearest ER list / hospital network search instruction).

onCallNotifiedDids.description: DIDs of on-call physicians / Council medical advisory members notified via G11 urgency-only push channel.

patientAckReceivedAt.description: Optional — patient acknowledgment that ER routing instruction was received (best-effort, do not block on patient response).

downstreamPipelineSuppressed.description: Architectural invariant — must be true. If false, indicates a bypass violation (G5 fail-safe inviolability breach).

description: Longitudinal QOL + adherence + adverse event tracker. Cross-actor leg to yakushi pharma.adverseEventReport (individual + aggregated) per master charter §Decision 8. description: moyai 舫い — a VERIFIED proof-of-contribution that MINTS non-monetary reciprocity credit (ADR-2606062100). A donated node (ameno browser / e7m CLI / kotoba pod, ADR-2606012100) contributed inference/compute to the Murakumo commons; a fraction of the batch was honeypot/spot-checked against frozen-edge-model answers on pinned core nodes, and ONLY verified, non-duplicate work mints credit (proof_of_contribution.py). This credit is the 'reward for participating in inference' — but it is structurally NOT money, NOT income, NOT a benefit, and does NOT touch Basic High Income: it is a give-to-get use-right on the commons itself (情報を得るには情報を生成する; the 入会権 / iriai-ken commons-use-right model, ADR-2605192345). It is the charter-clean carve-out to ADR-2606012100 G4 (compute donation grants no benefit): a draw-right on the same scarce resource you helped produce is reciprocity, not welfare, so anti-class / cash≡0 / 1-SBT-1-vote all stand. The five const fields below are the on-chain proof of those invariants. Aggregate-friendly, no donor PII beyond the contributing DID; never published as a per-donor leaderboard (anti-class).

contributorDid.description: DID of the contributing node (donor DID or ephemeral node DID). The credit is bound to THIS identity and is non-transferable (transferable=false), so sybil identities cannot pool credit. No-server-key: the node co-signs this attestation; the server cannot mint unilaterally (ADR-2605231525).

nodeClass.description: Which donated-node form did the work (ADR-2606012100 §3).

period.description: Accounting period (e.g. ISO date / epoch range) over which the contribution was verified and credit minted. Drives the per-identity earn-rate cap.

verifiedInferenceUnits.description: Reference inference-token-equivalent units that PASSED verification (honeypot + spot-check, non-duplicate). Integer-with-implied-units (ADR-2605190900). Only verified work counts — a fabricated batch verifies to 0.

honeypotPassRatePermille.description: Pass rate on honeypot + spot-check jobs, per-mille. A mint requires 1000 (all checked jobs correct) — all-or-nothing batch slashing. Below 1000 ⇒ batch slashed, mintedCredits=0, node cooled down.

mintedCredits.description: moyai credit units actually minted = min(verified units × mint-ratio, earn-rate-cap headroom). Burned later (drawReceipt) to draw discretionary surplus inference. Decays with a half-life (anti-hoarding) — a flow, never a hoardable store of wealth/power.

redeemableUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. moyai credit is non-monetary: it can NEVER be sold, cashed out, or counted as income. Its presence as a const-0 field is the on-chain proof that cash≡0 (N1) holds and that this reward does NOT affect Basic High Income (the explicit design constraint).

transferable.description: INVARIANT, always false. Credit is bound to contributorDid and cannot be transferred, gifted, merged, or pooled (the ledger exposes no such operation). This is the structural anti-sybil property: splitting work across identities yields un-recombinable, individually-capped balances.

affectsBasicHighIncome.description: INVARIANT, always false. The user-mandated firewall: moyai NEVER affects Basic High Income. Every member gets an unconditional subsistence inference floor (information-as-BHI) regardless of credit; credit only governs discretionary surplus under mesh contention.

grantsGovernanceWeight.description: INVARIANT, always false. moyai credit buys no governance power; 1 SBT = 1 vote is untouched (anti-class).

grantsBenefitOrStage.description: INVARIANT, always false. moyai credit is NEVER a path to Liberation-Ladder advancement, welfare benefits, or priority over others for benefits (ADR-2605261000 N2/N3; the ADR-2606012100 G4 carve-out is scoped strictly to commons-draw-rights). Drawing surplus inference is using the commons, not receiving a benefit.

verificationEvidenceRef.description: Optional AT URI of the verification record (honeypot set + spot-check results) for audit. The mint is replayable from the immutable kotoba Datom log.

createdAt.description: When the contribution was attested + minted.

description: moyai 舫い — a receipt for DRAWING inference from the commons, recording whether it was free (subsistence floor / idle mesh) or BURNED reciprocity credit (discretionary surplus under contention) per ADR-2606062100. This is the spend side of give-to-get. The firewall is explicit on every receipt: `withinSubsistenceFloor` draws are ALWAYS free and ALWAYS served (information-as-Basic-High-Income, delivered by need not by contribution); `creditBurned` is non-zero ONLY for discretionary surplus above the floor while the mesh is congested. A member with zero credit is never denied essential information — only non-essential surplus waits behind contributors. No monetary field exists: drawing inference costs credit-or-nothing, never money (cash≡0).

drawerDid.description: DID of the member/agent drawing inference. No-server-key: the draw is authorized by the member's signature (ADR-2605231525).

requestedUnits.description: Reference inference units requested in this draw.

decision.description: How the draw was served (fair_share.py). 'free-subsistence' = within the unconditional floor (information-as-BHI); 'free-idle' = surplus served free because the mesh had spare capacity; 'charge-surplus' = discretionary surplus under contention, credit burned; 'deferred' = surplus wanted under contention with no credit, essential floor still served, surplus waits behind contributors.

creditBurned.description: moyai credit units burned for this draw. Non-zero ONLY when decision='charge-surplus' (discretionary surplus above the floor under contention). 0 for every free/deferred draw. A burn can never exceed live balance (no overdraw).

withinSubsistenceFloor.description: True if (the floor portion of) this draw fell within the member's unconditional subsistence allowance — information-as-Basic-High-Income, never gated by credit.

essentialGuaranteed.description: INVARIANT, always true. Essential information access is guaranteed on every draw regardless of credit: the subsistence floor is served first, unconditionally. moyai only ever defers non-essential surplus. This is the on-chain proof that the reward does NOT affect Basic High Income.

meshLoadPermille.description: Mesh load at draw time, per-mille. Credit is charged only at/above the contention threshold; below it surplus is free for all (moyai is a congestion fair-share scheduler, not a paywall).

redeemableUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. Drawing inference costs credit or nothing — never money. cash≡0 (N1).

jobRef.description: Optional AT URI of the inference job this draw served.

createdAt.description: When the draw was served.

description: Update actor profile. Input fields are compatible with app.bsky.actor.profile record schema.

Adverse event report — supports 3 aggregation levels via `aggregationLevel` enum (per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1 cross-actor extension): (1) 'individual-patient' = patient-reported AE intake with XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted patient identity + sealed-recipient to Council Lv6+ DIDs per ADR-2605181100; (2) 'aggregated-lot-window' = daily roll-up by pharma_post_market_surveillance for yakushi-side ingestion of mitate cross-actor signal; (3) 'aggregated-quarter-summary' = quarterly input to pharma_packaging label-warning data-driven update mechanism. When aggregationLevel != 'individual-patient', encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope + deviceFingerprintHash MUST be absent (G10 structural). Public aggregated narrative (no PII) is emitted by pharma_post_market_surveillance daily. G5 (public reporting) + G10 (patient identity non-traceable) + Charter Rider §2(c) (no resale to advertisers / insurers / employers). Per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G5/G10 + ADR-2605250545 §Decision 6 + ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1 (mitate cross-actor extension).

lotAttestationUri.description: Back-reference to the lot the patient received. Allows full safety-signal investigation.

encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope.description: CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope. Plaintext contains patient_did, contact preference, and any patient-supplied context. Sealed-recipient = Council Lv6+ DIDs only. NEVER decryptable by ad / insurance / employer entities. Optional only when submission is via anonymous form.

deviceFingerprintHash.description: Optional for anonymous form submissions; SHA-256 of (device user-agent + locale + tz), used only for dedupe — never for re-identification.

severity.description: CIOMS Form III standardized severity scale.

onsetTimingMinutesAfterDose.description: Onset timing in minutes after dosing (integer; use 60 for 1 hour, 1440 for 24 hours).

narrative.description: Patient-authored description of the event. SHOULD NOT contain personally identifying information; intake validator scrubs obvious PII patterns before commit.

symptomCodes.description: MedDRA SOC / PT codes (LLT optional). Used for histogram aggregation.

reChallengePositive.description: If patient resumed the product after symptoms resolved, did symptoms recur?

aggregationLevel.description: Per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1. When != 'individual-patient', encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope + deviceFingerprintHash MUST be absent (G10 structural enforcement). aggregatedPayload then carries the lot-window or quarterly summary stats.

aggregatedPayload.description: Required when aggregationLevel != 'individual-patient'. Mutually exclusive with encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope.

yakushiProductDid.description: did:web:etzhayyim.com:yakushi:product:* — the yakushi-distributed product the aggregation pertains to.

lotIdHashRangeStart.description: SHA-256(lot_id) lower bound of the lot range covered. Cross-actor dedupe primary key per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 2.

patientCountDistinct.description: Distinct patient count over the window. Patient identity is NOT stored — only count. G10 structural.

medianOveruseDurationDays.description: Median days of overuse observed in the window. Threshold trigger for label-warning re-issue (>21 → label update per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 3).

medianDosesPerDayDecidoses.description: Median doses per day × 10 (decidoses; e.g. 35 = 3.5 doses/day). Per ADR-2605190900 no-float convention.

withdrawal8weekSuccessRatePpm.description: Withdrawal success rate at 8 weeks in parts-per-million (0..1_000_000 maps to 0.0..1.0). Threshold trigger for label-warning re-issue (<500000 = <0.50 → label update per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 3).

symptomMedDraSocCodes.description: MedDRA SOC codes observed in the window. Used for histogram aggregation only — no per-patient correlation.

description: Append-only per-step attestation for one API synthesis super-step. Each step records the recipe, the upstream raw-material attestations consumed, the equipment / operator DIDs, in-process check results, and downstream intermediate produced. Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 2 (3-compound routes) + ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G9 (witness N≥2).

apiInn.description: Wave 1 + Wave 1b + Wave 1c API catalog per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 2 + ADR-2605250600 §Decision 1 + ADR-2605250615 §Decision 1. Wave 1 triplet (sodium-cromoglicate, naphazoline-hydrochloride, chlorpheniramine-maleate) for sterile eye drop; Wave 1b 9 additions for oral tablet + topical; Wave 1c 7 additions (omeprazole chiral + laxatives + cough-expectorant). Future apis require G3 silen-pharma-review with 'wave-1c-*' or higher scope value.

stepIndex.description: Monotonic step within this synthesis (DSCG=1..5, naphazoline=1..3, chlorpheniramine=1..4).

recipeUri.description: AT URI of versioned recipe record.

rawMaterialAttestationUris.description: Upstream rawMaterialAttestation AT URIs consumed in this step.

priorStepUri.description: If stepIndex > 1, the previous step's apiSynthesisAttestation AT URI.

inProcessCheckResults.description: TLC Rf, UV scan, temperature profile compliance, mass balance, etc.

intermediateYieldBp.description: Step yield in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%; 10000 = 100%). Example: 7530 = 75.30% yield.

safetyIncident.description: If any safety incident during step (NaNH₂ flare, exotherm, etc.) record here; triggers Council Lv6+ if non-empty.

description: Per-batch fill-finish attestation. Wave 1 (sterile eye drop BFS, ADR-2605250530) + Wave 1b (non-sterile tablet + topical, ADR-2605250600). Captures formulation lot, upstream API source CIDs, excipient lots, dosage-form-specific parameters (BFS for eye drop sterile / compression for tablet / emulsification for topical). G9 N≥2 signatures (operator + QP). dosageForm field discriminates sterile vs non-sterile QC requirements (sterileFilter / CCIT / sterility / endotoxin required only for sterile dosage forms; dissolution / disintegration / friability / viscosity required for tablet / topical).

dosageForm.description: Wave 1 = 'eye-drop-sterile-*'. Wave 1b adds tablet + topical. Wave 1c adds sachets + oral liquid (cough syrups, laxative solutions). Wave 1c+ adds remaining unit-dose, liquid injectable as separate ADRs.

apiConcentrationMicrogPerMl.description: Eye drop / topical liquid concentrations in micrograms per mL (integer). DSCG = 20000 (20.0 mg/mL), naphazoline = 500 (0.5 mg/mL), chlorpheniramine eye drop = 300 (0.3 mg/mL).

apiStrengthMicrogPerUnit.description: Wave 1b tablet/capsule strength per dosage unit in micrograms (integer). Acetaminophen 500 mg = 500000; ibuprofen 200 mg = 200000; cetirizine 10 mg = 10000; famotidine 10 mg = 10000.

apiConcentrationBp.description: Wave 1b topical concentration as %w/w in parts per million (integer; 10000 = 1.00%). Clotrimazole 1% = 10000, diclofenac sodium gel 1% = 10000.

excipientAttestationUris.description: rawMaterialAttestation URIs for NaCl, citric acid, sodium citrate, etc.

wfiBatchId.description: Required for sterile dosage forms (eye-drop-sterile-*). NA for tablet / topical Wave 1b.

sterileFilterLotId.description: Required for sterile dosage forms only.

sterileFilterPoreSizeNm.description: Sterile filter pore size in nanometers (integer). 220 = standard 0.22 µm sterile-grade default.

sterileFilterIntegrityPassed.description: Bubble point or diffusion flow integrity test result.

bfsRunParamsCid.description: Temperature, pressure, cycle time, blow / fill / seal parameters.

envMonitoringCid.description: Class A air particle count + viable count time-series during fill.

endotoxinMilliEuPerMl.description: Bacterial endotoxin in milli-EU per mL (integer; 1000 = 1.0 EU/mL ophthalmic upper limit). LAL gel-clot result × 1000.

bottlesProduced.description: Eye drop sterile only. For tablet / topical use unitsProduced.

unitsProduced.description: Generic unit count for all dosage forms: bottles (eye drop), tablets (oral), tubes (topical).

tabletPressEquipmentDid.description: Wave 1b tablet only. Tablet press DID for compression step traceability.

tabletCompressionForceN.description: Wave 1b tablet only. Compression force in Newtons (integer; kN × 1000). Typical 5000-25000 N for OTC tablets.

topicalMixerEquipmentDid.description: Wave 1b topical only. High-shear homogenizer / mixer DID.

topicalEmulsificationTempDeciC.description: Wave 1b topical only. Emulsification temperature in deci-degrees Celsius (integer; °C × 10). 700-750 = typical 70.0-75.0°C range.

operatorDid.description: Generic operator DID for any dosage form (replaces bfsOperatorDid as required field; bfsOperatorDid kept for sterile BFS legacy).

bfsOperatorDid.description: Sterile BFS-specific operator DID. Aliased to operatorDid for sterile dosage forms.

description: Final per-lot release attestation with full upstream attestation chain CIDs. Per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G4 (QP co-sign per lot) + G9 (witness N≥2) + ADR-2605250545 §Decision 3 (attestation chain). Once released, a lot may be distributed under TitheRouter (donation / kisha / internal-promo / grant) per G12.

dosageForm.description: Wave 1 = sterile eye drop. Wave 1b adds tablet + topical. Determines storage condition + expiry rules + label warnings.

labelContentCid.description: G11 wellbecoming-compliant label content. naphazoline ≥ 0.05% MUST include 連用警告.

expiryDate.description: DSCG cold-chain: 24 mo at 2-8°C / 1 mo at 25°C; naphazoline & chlorpheniramine: 24 mo at 15-25°C.

qpEquivalentDid.description: QP-equivalent (薬機法 製造管理者 / EU GMP Qualified Person 相当) DID. Required for release.

councilAttestationUri.description: Required when releaseVerdict = 'hold-for-investigation' OR if any upstream attestation has a non-'ok' outcome. Points to silenPharmaReview.

storageConditionLabel.description: Wave 1: 2-8°C (DSCG eye drop default) / 15-25°C (naphazoline + chlorpheniramine eye drop). Wave 1b: <25°C dry (tablet) / <25°C protect-from-light (topical diclofenac photosensitive).

description: Attestation for API purification scheme execution per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 4. Records recrystallization solvent / yield, activated charcoal decolorization, filtration, and (chlorpheniramine only) prep-HPLC ICH M7 PGI removal step.

scheme.description: Wave 1: 'recryst-charcoal-filter' (DSCG / naphazoline); 'recryst-charcoal-filter-prephplc' (chlorpheniramine, ICH M7 4-chlorobenzyl chloride removal). Wave 1b extensions: 'recryst-only' (clotrimazole / diclofenac), 'recryst-double' (acetaminophen / aspirin), 'recryst-charcoal-only' (ibuprofen / famotidine), 'trituration-wash' (diphenhydramine HCl salt), 'vacuum-distillation' (loratadine / cetirizine). Wave 1c chiral: 'crystalline-resolution-mandelate' (omeprazole S-enantiomer via L-mandelic acid salt), 'prep-hplc-chiral' (Chiralcel OD-H or equiv), 'SFC-supercritical' (deferred Wave 1c+).

recoveryYieldBp.description: Purification recovery yield in basis points (10000 = 100%).

charcoalLoadingBp.description: Activated charcoal loading in basis points of crude mass (10000 = 100%).

filtrationPoreSizeNm.description: Filtration pore size in nanometers (integer). 450 = standard 0.45 µm clarification; 220 = 0.22 µm sterile-grade.

prepHplcFractionPurityBp.description: Required when scheme = '*-prephplc'. Purity in basis points (10000 = 100%).

residualSolventEstimatePpm.description: Residual solvent estimate in parts per million (integer).

pgiEstimatePpb.description: Required for chlorpheniramine (4-chlorobenzyl chloride). Estimate in parts per billion (integer; ppm × 1000 for trace-level precision). Auto-reject if computed daily exposure > ICH M7 Class 1B 1.5 µg/day.

description: Per-lot QC suite results attestation. Required: HPLC purity + IR identity + Karl Fischer water + ICP-MS heavy metal + GC headspace residual solvent + endotoxin LAL. Conditional: NMR identity, PGI LC-MS/MS (chlorpheniramine), microbial limit, sterility (post fill-finish only). Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 5 + ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G2 (ICH Q3/M7 auto-reject) + G9 (witness N≥2: QC analyst + QP-equivalent).

hplcPurityBp.description: HPLC purity in basis points (10000 = 100%). Per USP/JP monograph; DSCG ≥ 9850 (98.5%), naphazoline ≥ 9900 (99.0%), chlorpheniramine ≥ 9950 (99.5%).

kfWaterBp.description: Karl Fischer water content in basis points (10000 = 100%). DSCG: 500-900 (5.0-9.0%); naphazoline / chlorpheniramine: ≤ 100 (1.0%).

gcResidualSolventCompliant.description: ICH Q3C class limits. Class 1 = ND, Class 2 per-solvent limits, Class 3 ≤ 5000 ppm.

pgiLcmsmsNanogPerDay.description: Required for chlorpheniramine (4-chlorobenzyl chloride). PGI exposure in nanograms/day (integer; µg × 1000). Auto-reject if > 1500 (1.5 µg/day, ICH M7 Class 1B).

endotoxinMilliEuPerMl.description: Ophthalmic limit ≤ 1000 (1.0 EU/mL). Milli-EU per mL (integer; EU × 1000).

sterilityCompliant.description: Optional at API stage; required at fill-finish stage for sterile dosage forms only. NA for tablet / topical Wave 1b per ADR-2605250600 §Decision 5.

dissolutionBp30min.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <711>). Dissolution % at 30 min in basis points (8000 = 80%). Immediate-release target ≥ 8000 (80%) for most APIs.

dissolutionBp60min.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <711>). Dissolution % at 60 min in basis points.

contentUniformityRsdBp.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <905>). RSD across 10 units in basis points. Target ≤ 600 (6.0%).

friabilityBpMassLoss.description: Wave 1b uncoated tablet only (USP <1216>). Mass loss after 100 rotations in basis points. Target ≤ 100 (1.0%).

disintegrationTimeSeconds.description: Wave 1b tablet only (USP <701>). Disintegration time in seconds (integer). Uncoated ≤ 1800 (30 min); film-coated ≤ 3600 (60 min).

viscosityMilliCp.description: Wave 1b topical only (cone-plate rheometer at defined shear). Viscosity in milli-centipoise (integer; cP × 1000) for sub-cP precision.

pHValueDeciUnits.description: Wave 1b topical / eye drop only. pH × 10 (integer). pH 5.5 = 55; pH 7.4 = 74. Eye drop typical 45-75 (4.5-7.5); topical gel typical 50-70 (5.0-7.0).

qpEquivalentDid.description: QP-equivalent (薬機法 製造管理者 / EU GMP Qualified Person 相当) DID. Witness invariant N≥2 (G9).

description: Append-only attestation for one raw-material intake event into a yakushi facility. Captures supplier identity, CoA URI, CWC Schedule / Australia Group / 国内毒劇法 / 消防法 危険物 classification, safety class, kg-quantity, receiver DID + (HIGH-risk) Council Lv6+ co-sign per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G7 and ADR-2605250545 §Decision 1 + 7. Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 3 (per-compound raw material table). G2-safety + G7 enforcement.

materialInn.description: INN / chemical name (lower-case-hyphenated for API precursors; common name for excipients).

quantityGrams.description: Intake quantity in grams (integer; kg × 1000). 1000 = 1 kg threshold for CWC Schedule 3 declaration verify (G7).

cwcSchedule.description: OPCW Chemical Weapons Convention schedule. 'schedule-3' triggers Council Lv6+ co-sign + OPCW declaration verify per G7 (acetic anhydride for DSCG Step 1).

australiaGroupListed.description: Australia Group precursor list. true triggers Council Lv6+ co-sign per G7.

safetyClass.description: 国内 (日本) 毒劇法 / 消防法 / 高圧ガス保安法 / 放射性同位元素規制法 classification. 'high-*' triggers 危険物取扱主任者 / 高圧ガス施設保安主任者 DID co-sign per G2-safety.

councilAttestationUri.description: Required when cwcSchedule = 'schedule-1'/'schedule-2'/'schedule-3' OR australiaGroupListed=true OR safetyClass starts with 'high-'. Points to silenPharmaReview record.

safetyOfficerDid.description: Required when safetyClass starts with 'high-'. 危険物取扱主任者 / 高圧ガス施設保安主任者 / 放射線取扱主任者 DID.

opcwDeclarationVerifiedAt.description: Required when cwcSchedule != 'none' (kg-scale). Verification that the intake is integrated into the operator's OPCW declaration in the host jurisdiction.

intendedApiInn.description: Required when intendedUse = 'api-synthesis-*'. The downstream API's INN.

witnessDid.description: Independent witness DID per G9 (witness invariant N≥2).

description: Council Lv6+ ≥ 3 multisig attestation that a yakushi commit / lot / new API / new dosage form / new jurisdictional launch / safety-class-HIGH raw material intake / aggregation algorithm change / etc. has been reviewed. Mirrors silen-force-review (com.etzhayyim.silicon.silenForceReview) for pharmaceutical scope. Per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G3 + ADR-2605250515 §Decision 6 (per-trigger list) + ADR-2605250530 §Decision 7 + ADR-2605250545 §Decision 7.

scopeUri.description: Git commit SHA URL, lot-id, AT URI, IPFS CID, or registry CID being reviewed.

designIntentNarrative.description: Human-authored narrative explaining the intended use, expected misuse vectors, and mitigations. Required for all HIGH risk classes.

councilAttestors.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members who attested. Must be ≥ 3 per master charter §Decision 3 G3.

main.description: Proxy for plc.etzhayyim.com GET /{did}/log — returns the full operation log for a DID. Each op is signature-verifiable offline. Used for audit, forensics, and federation sync.

includeNullified.description: include ops marked as nullified due to chain fork resolution

integrityVerified.description: true if signature chain was verified end-to-end server-side

errors.name: ChainIntegrityBroken
errors.description: signature chain verification failed (report to PLC operators)

main.description: ADR-0014 Phase 5: migrate a did:web actor to did:plc. PDS builds genesis op with rotation key from D1 (ADR-0010 custody), signs with ES256K, computes DID, and registers with plc.etzhayyim.com. Client never touches key material.

actor.description: actor name from deps.toml [[mitama_actors]] (e.g. adr, legal-aid)

handle.description: atproto handle to embed in DID document alsoKnownAs (e.g. adr.etzhayyim.com)

dryRun.description: if true: build + sign genesis op, compute DID, but do NOT register with plc.etzhayyim.com and do NOT persist rotation mapping

existingRotationKeys.description: optional: pre-existing did:key rotation keys (default: load from D1 signing_keys by actor name)

genesisCid.description: dag-cbor CID of the genesis operation

plcUrl.description: plc.etzhayyim.com resolve URL for the new DID

legacyDid.description: previous did:web that the actor used (grandfathered 6 months)

registered.description: true if DID was successfully POSTed to plc.etzhayyim.com (false in dryRun or if already exists)

errors.name: ActorNotFound
errors.description: actor name not found in deps.toml [[mitama_actors]]

errors.name: AlreadyMigrated
errors.description: actor already has did:plc identity

errors.name: RotationKeyUnavailable

description: kotoba-datomic-projection snapshot — top-N most recent `app.bsky.feed.post` records across all DIDs observed by the projection daemon, sorted by indexedAt desc. Per ADR-2605231500. This is a *derived* read path: the canonical record is each DID's own MST entry; this projection only exists to make Discover-feed reads O(1) instead of O(DIDs × listRecords). The projector daemon (see `50-infra/mst-projector/`) consumes `com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos`, maintains the index in memory, and emits one snapshot per flush boundary. Rebuild: replay the firehose from cursor 0 — see `50-infra/mst-projector/projection/REBUILD.md`. Conformance: L0-projection (line-comment + manifest, manual rebuild). L1 upgrade pending CI replay smoke.

snapshotAt.description: Wall-clock time the projector emitted this snapshot. NOT used for ordering — sorting is by `items[*].indexedAt`.

cursor.description: Last firehose `seq` consumed before emission. A replay consumer can resume from this point + this snapshot for monotonic-progress rebuild.

firstSeq.description: First firehose `seq` represented in `items`. With `cursor` this delimits the seq range covered.

items.description: Top-N most recent posts, sorted by indexedAt desc. Bounded so one snapshot fits in a single AT record (~64 KiB budget). For longer history, replay older snapshots via TID order.

totalSeen.description: Lifetime count of distinct (did, rkey) entries the projector has observed for `app.bsky.feed.post`. Used by L1-projection conformance smoke to detect index drift.

projectionLevel.description: Conformance level of the emitting projector. L0 = manifest+runbook only; L1 = CI-exercised rebuild; L2 = byte-identical 1% replay smoke.

indexedAt.description: Sort key. Primary source: `record.createdAt`. Fallback: firehose commit `time` (when createdAt missing or in the future).

textPreview.description: First chars of `record.text` (post-Charter-Rider scrubbing). Truncated to 600 chars so 500 items fit in ~300 KiB. Renderer should call `com.atproto.repo.getRecord` for full content + facets + embeds.

verdict.description: If a FeedPostCell (`40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/feed_post/`) verdict has been observed for this record, propagate the kind. `reject` records are NOT promoted into the projection. Default `unverdicted` (no verdict observed yet — common for fresh writes pre-membrane).

path.description: Path within the tree at startRef/startCommit.

main.description: Insert a content-addressed blob (sha256 keyed). Idempotent — re-insert of same content returns existing hash. Large bytes tiered to B2; small bytes stored inline in vertex_repository_blob.

ownerDid.description: Owning Actor DID. Used for authorization scope; blobs themselves are globally deduplicated.

content.description: Blob bytes. Base64url-encoded on the wire. No size cap here — runtime tiers >16KB to B2.

mimeType.description: Optional hint used only for editor preview. Not part of the hash input.

tier.description: inline = stored in vertex_repository_blob.inline_text; r2 = vertex_repository_blob.bytes_ref

deduplicated.description: true if identical hash already existed (INSERT was no-op).

errors.name: UnauthorizedWriter
errors.description: Caller lacks write permission for ownerDid.

errors.name: SizeLimit
errors.description: Blob exceeds max configured byte size.

main.description: Insert a commit object. commitHash = sha256 over canonical-encoded {treeHash, parentHashes, authorDid, committerDid, message, timestamp}. Signature field is NOT included in the hash input so the same commit can be re-signed by key rotation without hash drift. Immutable once written.

parentHashes.description: 0 parents = root commit; 1 = normal; 2+ = merge. Order significant.

committerDid.description: Defaults to authorDid. Differs only for CI / bot commits pushed on behalf of a human author.

timestamp.description: Author timestamp. Server stamps committer timestamp independently.

signatureEs256.description: Base64url ES256 signature over commitHash by authorDid signing key (ADR-0010). Required; bootstrap literal 'bootstrap' accepted only for the very first commit of a freshly created DID.

errors.name: MissingParent
errors.description: A parentHash does not resolve.

errors.name: MissingTree
errors.description: treeHash does not resolve.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: ES256 signature does not verify against authorDid's signing key.

main.description: Create a ref (branch / tag / HEAD) pointing to an initial commit. Ref names are unique per (ownerDid, kind).

ownerDid.description: Actor DID that owns this ref (= Repository identity per ADR-0039).

refName.description: Branch/tag name. Slashes allowed (e.g. 'feat/new-block'). 'HEAD' reserved for kind=head.

kind.description: branch = mutable via updateRef; tag = immutable (updateRef rejects); head = symbolic pointer to another branch.

initialCommit.description: commitHash this ref starts pointing at. Required for branch/tag; symbolic target for head.

errors.name: ReservedName
errors.description: Ref name collides with a reserved symbol (e.g. 'HEAD' with kind != head).

main.description: Insert a tree (directory snapshot). Hash is sha256 over canonical-sorted (path ASC) entry list. Idempotent.

entries.description: Directory entries. MUST NOT contain duplicate paths.

treeHash.description: sha256 hex of canonical entry list

errors.name: DuplicatePath
errors.description: Two entries share the same path.

errors.name: MissingObject
errors.description: Referenced blob/tree hash does not exist.

path.description: Path segment relative to this tree (no leading slash, no '..').

mode.description: blob = regular file, exec = executable file, tree = nested directory

main.description: Compute tree diff between two commits. Supports path-scoped and binary-aware output.

pathPrefix.description: Scope diff to entries under this path prefix.

unified.description: Context lines per hunk. 0 = no context. -1 = full file.

includeContent.description: If false, returns only file-level add/delete/modify summary (fast).

binary.description: True if either side is detected as binary; hunks omitted.

hunks.description: Unified diff hunks. Omitted when includeContent=false or binary=true.

main.description: Fetch blob bytes by sha256 hash. Global dedup — no owner scope in read path.

content.description: Full blob bytes. Transparent R2 pull when tier = r2.

main.description: Fetch a commit object by hash.

signatureValid.description: Server verifies on read. True if signature verifies against authorDid's signing key at authorTimestamp.

main.description: Fetch a tree by hash, returning canonical-sorted entry list.

recursive.description: If true, inline nested trees up to maxDepth.

truncated.description: True if recursive expansion hit maxDepth.

main.description: List refs owned by a single DID, or by all DIDs in a path-DID subtree (ADR-0019). Subtree mode gives Project/App-level 'repo view' without a Repository container.

ownerDid.description: Exact DID scope. Mutually exclusive with subtreeRootDid.

subtreeRootDid.description: Traverse edge_path_child* from this DID. Returns refs for the root and all descendants. Mutually exclusive with ownerDid.

main.description: Walk commit ancestry from a ref or commit. Returns linearized history (first-parent by default) or full DAG.

ownerDid.description: Required when startRef is set.

startRef.description: Ref name to start from. Mutually exclusive with startCommit.

startCommit.description: Commit hash to start from. Mutually exclusive with startRef.

mode.description: firstParent = linearize via parent[0]; fullDag = topological order including merges.

pathFilter.description: Only include commits whose tree diff touches this path prefix.

authorDid.description: Only include commits authored by this DID.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (commitHash of last returned entry).

errors.name: InvalidParameters
errors.description: Neither startRef nor startCommit given, or both.

description: AT Record written to the owning DID's AT Repo every time updateRef succeeds. Travels the com.atproto.sync firehose so peer PDS instances can mirror the ref graph without polling. Immutable per rkey; ref history reconstructed by concatenating all refUpdate records for a given (ownerDid, refName).

reason.description: Required when updateKind in {rolledBack, forcePushed}. Free text logged to audit trail.

committerDid.description: DID that invoked updateRef. May differ from the commit's authorDid.

main.description: The only mutable write in ADR-0039. Move a ref's points-to from expectedCurrent to newCommit. CAS-safe by default; force=true skips ancestry check. Emits OCEL event ref:updated / ref:rolledBack / ref:forcePushed and a firehose com.etzhayyim.repository.refUpdate record.

expectedCurrent.description: Current head commit hash the caller expects. Server rejects with RefOutOfDate if mismatch. Omit only with force=true.

force.description: If true, skip fast-forward/ancestry check. Generates OCEL event ref:forcePushed.

reason.description: Human-readable reason. Required when force=true or when newCommit is an ancestor of current (= rollback). Logged to OCEL event payload.

updateKind.description: fastForward = new is descendant of previous; rolledBack = new is ancestor; forcePushed = neither (requires force=true).

firehoseCid.description: CID of the com.etzhayyim.repository.refUpdate record written to the owner DID's AT Repo.

errors.name: RefOutOfDate
errors.description: expectedCurrent does not match server state.

errors.name: ImmutableRef
errors.description: Ref kind=tag cannot be updated.

errors.name: ForceRequired
errors.description: newCommit is not a descendant of previousCommit; caller must set force=true with a reason.

errors.name: ReasonRequired
errors.description: force=true or rollback without reason.

main.description: Register a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifact with sbom.etzhayyim.com. componentCount.description: Number of CDX components ingested into the SbomComponent graph.

vulnMatchCount.description: Number of vulnerability matches detected synchronously against the existing CveEntry graph.

description: Controller heartbeat comparing the hash of the loaded PLC program against its attested programCid, re-verified on every controller restart and daily heartbeat. A mismatch freezes L3 recipe dispatch to that controller until resolved. Per ADR-2606111000 §4.

Attestation-layer mirror of a setpoint envelope compiled into an attested PLC program: per-setpoint min/max + max rate-of-change. Murakumo optimization proposals land ONLY through these envelopes; out-of-envelope requests are clamped at L1 regardless of upstream layer. Per ADR-2606111000 §3.4.

clampCounterTag.description: PLC tag accumulating envelope-clamp events for silenSeigyoReview

maxMilli.description: envelope maximum in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

maxRateOfChangeMilli.description: max rate of change in 1/1000 of rateUnit (implied milli-units)

rationale.description: why these bounds; note the operational-vs-safety distinction (safety bound is hardwired L1S, not this envelope)

description: Council Lv6+ baseline review for seigyo R-phase activation gates and the annual control-layer review (envelope-clamp log + interlock records + vendor-prohibition audit). Parallel to silenIgataReview / silenPharmaReview. Per ADR-2606111000 §7 + §8, ADR-2606111100 §2.

leasedToDid.description: DID of the religious-corp adherent (SBT holder) this chip is leased to. Donated silicon is inalienable (ADR-2605242500 §Decision 6) — lease, never sale.

councilAttestationTxHash.description: Optional. On-chain Council 5-of-7 Safe transaction hash that ratified this lot's manufacturing.

equipmentDid.description: DID of the equipment unit, e.g., did:web:tsukuru.etzhayyim.com:equipment:litho:asml-na33-clone-001 (vendor-neutral).

description: Council Lv6+ ≥ 3 multisig attestation that a silicon design / lot / equipment commit has been reviewed against Charter Rider §2(a) (weapons) + §2(c) (mass surveillance). Per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 + ADR-2605242545 §Decision 4. REQUIRED for every commit under 50-infra/silicon/equipment/ion-implant/ and equipment/lithography/ (HIGH risk), plus any chipManufacturingAttestation issuance.

scopeUri.description: Git commit SHA URL, lot-id, or AT URI being reviewed.

riskClass.description: Charter Rider §2(a) (weapons) and/or §2(c) (mass surveillance) risk classification.

designIntentNarrative.description: Human-authored narrative explaining the intended use, expected misuse vectors, and mitigations. Required per ADR-2605242500 §Decision 4 §1 (set-time review).

verdictConditions.description: If verdict = approve-with-conditions, the conditions list. Otherwise empty.

supersedesUri.description: If this review revises a prior one, point to it.

description: Append-only per-process-step attestation for a wafer lot moving through the fab. Each silicon_* Pregel cell super-step writes one record after completing its step. stepIndex.description: Monotonic step number within this lot's process_history.

equipmentDid.description: DID of the equipment unit that ran the recipe.

recipeUri.description: AT URI of the recipe record (versioned).

telemetryUri.description: Optional. AT URI of the fabEquipmentTelemetry down-sample for this step.

metrologyUri.description: Optional. If this step is metrology, AT URI of the defect classification result. If non-metrology, may reference the most recent prior metrology.

relayedToCommunitySiteIds.description: Opt-in community sites the relay was pushed to (community-scale; G3)

supersededByRelayUri.description: If a later official update supersedes this relay

falseAuthorityIncidents.description: G8 audit: count of any relay that drifted toward originating/altering an official warning (target 0)

description: Pin receipt for a large reference / training / baien dataset pinned to IPFS by the religious-corp dataset-pinner. Per ADR-2605241500. Parallels com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin (which is reserved for MST CAR shards from mst-projector). Readers can resolve `cid` from any IPFS gateway to obtain the original UnixFS tree; the optional `sha256` is an archive-level hash (deterministic tar of staging tree) that lets a consumer verify content independent of the IPFS chunker. Charter Rider §2(a)..(h) scan result (ADR-2605192200) MUST be recorded — pins where `charterRiderScan.passed = false` are NOT allowed and the pinner refuses to emit them.

name.description: Stable dataset name in canonical form, e.g. `HF:HuggingFaceTB/smollm-corpus` or `local:baien-graft-3d-260524`. Together with `revision` uniquely identifies a pin.

revision.description: Upstream revision pin. For HF datasets: the git revision SHA or tag. For HTTP sources: a content etag or capture timestamp. Free-form for `local-import`.

kind.description: Taxonomic bucket for sharding + storage policy.

cid.description: IPFS UnixFS root CID (v1, base32) returned by Kubo `/api/v0/add` (or equivalent provider call).

sizeBytes.description: Total byte size of the pinned tree (sum of leaf sizes, not including IPFS framing overhead).

sha256.description: Archive-level sha256 of a deterministic tar of the staging tree. Optional but recommended for chunker-independent verification.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Production target ≥ 2 distinct providers (replication-factor invariant inherited from ADR-2605171800 Stage 4). Single-provider pins are allowed during bootstrap, marked by `replicationMin: 1` in the manifest row.

assignedNodes.description: DIDs of nodes that MUST hold this CID per the sharding plan. Empty array means unassigned (any node may pin opportunistically).

source.description: How the dataset was obtained upstream.

license.description: SPDX identifier or free-text license string. MUST be compatible with the Charter Compliance Rider (ADR-2605192200); first-party redistribution implies Apache-2.0 + Rider on derivative artifacts.

charterRiderScan.description: Result of kotodama.organism.sensors.charter_rider.scan() against a deterministic sample of the dataset. Required: pins with `passed = false` MUST NOT be emitted.

manifestRowRef.description: Reference back to the row in `90-docs/baien/datasets.jsonl` that this pin record corresponds to. Either a 1-based line number (string-encoded) or a git blob CID anchor — implementation-defined for Phase 1.

description: Pin receipt emitted by ipfs-pinner after one of mst-projector's shard CAR files has been pinned to ≥1 IPFS providers (Kubo / Pinata / Web3.Storage / Filecoin via Storacha). Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 4. Readers can resolve the pinned CAR by `carCid` from any IPFS gateway and reconstruct the projected MST shard. The original snapshot record (`com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot`) carries the MST `rootCid` that this pin's CAR contains as its single root.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this pin covers, copied from the originating shardSnapshot. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor) of the shard at the time of CAR flush. Matches the `rootCid` field of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record.

carCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the CAR file itself, returned by the pin provider. Identical across providers for a given CAR (deterministic content addressing).

snapshotUri.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record, when known. Optional in Phase 1 emissions where the pinner subscribes to local CAR files directly rather than via firehose.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Constitutional minimum at production = 2 distinct providers (per README replication factor); single-provider emissions are allowed only when ETZ_PINNER_PROVIDERS = single name and the operator explicitly opted out of redundancy.

byteSize.description: Size of the CAR file in bytes.

blockCount.description: Number of dag-cbor blocks in the CAR (root + unstored MST blocks).

description: L2 anchor receipt emitted by anchor-cron after an MST root has been committed to EtzhayyimAnchor on Base L2. Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 5b. Closes the substrate pipeline: mst-projector (rootCid) → ipfs-pinner (carCid pinned) → anchor-cron (rootHash anchored on Base). The on-chain `Anchored` event carries the same rootHash + ipfsCid; this AT record cross-references that event back to the originating `ipfsPin` record so any third party can trace a shard's full custody chain without trusting a single operator.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this anchor covers, copied from the originating ipfsPin record. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Matches `com.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot.rootCid` + `com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin.rootCid`.

rootHash.description: 0x-prefixed bytes32 = sha256(rootCid as UTF-8 bytes). Primary key in EtzhayyimAnchor.anchors mapping.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed Base L2 transaction hash of the EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() call. May be the zero-hash if anchor-cron observed the root was already on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx (alreadyAnchored=true).

blockNumber.description: L2 block number at which the anchor landed (or the block of the prior anchor when alreadyAnchored=true).

logIndex.description: Index of the Anchored event in the receipt logs. Defaults to 0 when alreadyAnchored=true (no new event).

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id. Base mainnet = 8453, Base sepolia = 84532.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed EtzhayyimAnchor contract address on the target chain.

anchorer.description: 0x-prefixed EOA that signed the anchor tx (= msg.sender on-chain). Off-chain DID resolution is the reader's responsibility.

batchSize.description: Informational record count passed to EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() (block.batchSize on-chain). For substrate-mode anchors this is the originating shardSnapshot.recordCount when known, else 1.

alreadyAnchored.description: True when anchor-cron detected the rootHash was already anchored on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx. The receipt still gets recorded so readers see a complete trail.

ipfsPinUri.description: AT URI of the originating `com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin` record. Required when the anchor was driven by substrate mode; absent when an external integrator submitted the anchor without an ipfsPin record on PDS.

description: Periodic snapshot emitted by mst-projector for one shard (typically one collection NSID). Forward-compatible across Phase 1 (counter-derived snapshotHash + JSON manifest) and Phase 2 (AT-Protocol MST rootCid + CAR file). Readers MUST treat absent `phase` as 1 and prefer `rootCid` over `snapshotHash` when both are present. Per ADR-2605191358 step 5 and ADR-2605191655.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this snapshot covers. e.g. `com.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent`.

phase.description: Snapshot scheme version. 1 = JSON manifest + sha-256 hash. 2 = CAR + true MST root CID. Absent ↔ 1 (back-compat).

snapshotHash.description: Phase 1 root identifier: `sha256-<hex>` of canonical-JSON record list. Deprecated when phase=2 emits; dropped in a future cleanup ADR after ≥4 week grace (per ADR-2605191655).

rootCid.description: Phase 2 authoritative root identifier: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Absent in Phase 1 emissions. Readers SHOULD prefer this when present.

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the snapshot blob. Phase 1: JSON manifest. Phase 2: CAR v1 file (root + leaf blocks). Optional in Phase 1 emissions if the daemon could not reach the IPFS pin endpoint; required in Phase 2 (per ADR-2605191655).

description: Per-TLD Council Lv6+ attestation gating ICANN CZDS zone-file ingestion. Per ADR-2605262400 W4. Each enabled TLD requires (1) the operator's per-TLD acceptance flag at ~/.etzhayyim/source-acceptance/czds-<tld>.toml AND (2) a Council Lv6+ attestation record under this lexicon. The fetcher refuses to start until both gates pass. The attestation is on-chain visible (PDS-anchored) so the Council decision trail is auditable. Records are immutable; revocation is recorded as a new record with `status = 'revoked'`.

tld.description: TLD slug in lowercase ASCII, no leading dot (e.g. `com`, `org`, `nz`, `xn--p1ai`).

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only `approved` permits ingestion. `revoked` halts new fetches and (per ADR-2605262400 §6 + W4) requires the operator to issue a tombstone in `datasets.jsonl` for any already-pinned shards.

items.description: DID of a Council Seat that voted in favor. ADR-2605192300 §Council protocol: Lv6+ supermajority requires ≥4 of 7 seats.

decidedAt.description: RFC3339 instant of the Council vote.

tier.description: Per-TLD effective tier. The CZDS agreement varies per TLD; some are pure research-use (C), some carry redistribution restrictions that map to D. Tier D zones are admitted only to fleet-internal inference paths AND with stricter Charter Rider §2(c) review.

expectedLicense.description: Free-form slug of the upstream license / TOS clause the Council attested to (e.g. 'czds-research-use', 'czds-com-extended-restrictions'). Stored verbatim from the upstream registration text.

noteCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of a public note explaining the rationale + scope of the per-TLD approval. Recommended for any Tier-D approval and for any TLD where Council members declared a conflict of interest.

expiresAt.description: Optional RFC3339 expiry instant. After this time the fetcher MUST treat the approval as `revoked` and refuse new fetches until a new attestation lands.

description: Sleep-disorder condition profile anchored to international classifications (ICSD-3 + ICD-11) — classification reference ONLY, never a diagnostic instrument (N1/N5). Wave 1 = obstructive + central sleep apnea. Carries the stable slug, coded references, and a brand-neutral lay description with a mandatory disclaimer. Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 1/6.

displayNameJa.description: e.g., 閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸 (OSA).

icsd3Code.description: ICSD-3 classification reference (anchor only — sourceClass icsd-3, classification-only grade).

icd11Code.description: WHO ICD-11 code (anchor only). Per ICD-11 MMS: 7A41 = obstructive sleep apnoea, 7A40 = central sleep apnoeas.

layDescription.description: Brand-neutral lay description of the condition (what it is, why it matters). NOT a self-diagnosis checklist (N1). Diagnosis is by PSG/OCST + clinician only.

redFlagNote.description: G5 red-flag guidance text (e.g., 重度日中傾眠での運転 / 心不全合併 → 速やかに受診).

treatmentSlugs.description: Stable treatment-modality slugs associated with this condition (synthesis targets), e.g., cpap / oral-appliance-mad / positional-therapy / weight-loss-lifestyle / upper-airway-surgery / hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation / adaptive-servo-ventilation.

description: Canonical, tamper-resistant non-diagnostic disclaimer text registry (G3 invariant). suimin_disclaimer_gate stamps the active disclaimer reference onto every patient-facing output (treatmentSynthesis / conditionProfile / referralPathway). Changes require silenSuiminReview scope 'disclaimer-baseline' (Council Lv6+ >=3). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 3 G3 / §Decision 6.

text.description: Canonical disclaimer. Reference JA text: 「これは医師の診断・治療の代替ではありません。睡眠時無呼吸症候群かどうか、どの治療が適切かは、終夜睡眠検査と医師の診断によります。気になる症状があれば睡眠専門外来・地元の医療機関にご相談ください。」

description: A single graded evidence item drawn from a whitelisted source (G1). Carries verifiable provenance (PMID / DOI / Cochrane CD-ID / guideline-ID), study type, GRADE evidence grade (G2), the condition + treatment it pertains to, and a neutral summary. NOT patient-specific (corpus-level, no PHI). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_source_ingest / suimin_evidence_grade).

sourceClass.description: MUST be present in the active com.etzhayyim.suimin.sourceWhitelist (G1).

provenanceId.description: Verifiable identifier (e.g., PMID 23589584 / DOI 10.xxxx / Cochrane CD001106 / AASM-GL-OSA-2019). Required (G1).

canonicalUrl.description: Stable resolver URL (e.g., https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/<pmid>/). Display/audit only — not a vendored copy.

treatmentSlug.description: Stable treatment-modality slug, e.g., cpap / oral-appliance-mad / positional-therapy / weight-loss-lifestyle / upper-airway-surgery / hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation / adaptive-servo-ventilation.

evidenceGrade.description: GRADE assessment (G2). Bounded by the sourceClass maxDefaultGrade. preprint -> low (G12).

gradeRationale.description: Brief GRADE downgrade/upgrade reasoning (risk of bias / inconsistency / indirectness / imprecision).

summary.description: Neutral, brand-free summary of the finding (device class / INN only — G12). No individual recommendation (G4).

conflictOfInterestFlag.description: true if author/funding COI detected (e.g., device-manufacturer funded). Surfaced; vendor-marketing sources excluded entirely (G12).

description: Referral routing to LOCAL sleep-medicine care — surfaces what KIND of facility to consult and (from a Council-ratified directory) which nearby facilities exist. Presentation only: NO appointment booking, NO telehealth scheduling, NO device sales (N6/N7, G4 referral-only). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_referral_router).

recommendedFacilityKinds.description: Kind(s) of facility/specialist to consult — guidance, not a directive.

directoryEntries.description: Optional nearby facilities from the Council-ratified referral directory (REFERRAL_DIRECTORY_REGISTRY_CID). Presentation only.

urgency.description: G5: emergency for red-flag signals (routed via mitate emergency path).

area.description: Coarse area (e.g., 市区町村) — no precise patient geolocation stored.

publicContact.description: Publicly listed contact (phone/URL). No booking handled by suimin.

accreditation.description: e.g., 日本睡眠学会認定 検査施設, if applicable.

description: Council baseline attestation for suimin (mirror of com.etzhayyim.mitate.silenMitateReview). Witness invariant N>=3 Council Lv6+ DIDs (+ optional licensed sleep-medicine MD). Gates removal of the import-time RuntimeError on suimin_* cells per scope. Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 3 G9 / §Decision 5/6.

scope.description: Which baseline this review ratifies. Each cell checks the scope(s) it depends on before lifting its gate.

witnessDids.description: N>=3 Council Lv6+ DIDs (G9). A licensed sleep-medicine MD DID may be added (R1 evidence-review / R2 in-loop, G8).

licensedSleepMdDid.description: Optional licensed sleep-medicine MD attesting the clinical baseline (G8).

attestationTxHash.description: Council Lv6+ >=3 multisig tx hash (becomes COUNCIL_CHARTER_ATTESTATION_TX_HASH for the gated cells).

description: Council-ratified registry of source CLASSES that suimin may treat as evidence (G1 SSoT). Every evidenceRecord / treatmentSynthesis claim MUST reference a sourceClass present here AND carry a verifiable provenance id. Additions require silenSuiminReview scope 'source-whitelist-baseline' (Council Lv6+ ≥3). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 2.

maxDefaultGrade.description: Upper bound of evidenceGrade for this class. icsd-3/icd-11 = classification-only (condition anchor, never treatment evidence). pubmed-preprint = low.

provenanceIdKind.description: The verifiable provenance identifier kind required for claims of this class (G1).

peerReviewed.description: false for pubmed-preprint (must be labeled preprint, G12).

description: Population-level treatment-evidence landscape for one treatment modality of one sleep-disorder condition. Aggregates constituent evidenceRecords (G1 provenance preserved), carries an explicit overall GRADE (G2), a mandatory non-diagnostic disclaimer reference (G3, via suimin_disclaimer_gate), and a referral pointer (G4). NEVER individual-specific: no diagnosis, severity (AHI), device setting, surgical indication, or prescription (N1-N5). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_treatment_synthesize).

treatmentDisplayName.description: Brand-neutral name (device class / INN only — G12), e.g., 'CPAP (持続陽圧呼吸療法)'.

overallEvidenceGrade.description: GRADE summary across constituent evidence (G2). Mandatory.

populationSummary.description: Population-level synthesis: what the evidence shows for the general condition population (efficacy on AHI / daytime sleepiness / cardiovascular outcomes / adherence). NOT a recommendation for any individual (G4).

considerations.description: Brand-neutral considerations (e.g., adherence challenges, candidacy generally discussed in guidelines). Framed as 'discuss with a sleep-medicine clinician', not a directive.

evidenceRecordUris.description: Back-references to constituent com.etzhayyim.suimin.evidenceRecord items (G1 provenance chain). At least one required — no claim without evidence.

disclaimerTextUri.description: Reference to the active com.etzhayyim.suimin.disclaimerText (G3 invariant — set by suimin_disclaimer_gate, tamper-resistant).

referralPathwayUri.description: Optional pointer to com.etzhayyim.suimin.referralPathway (G4 — where to seek a clinician).

mdReviewWitnessDid.description: R2+ licensed sleep-medicine MD co-sign DID (G9 witness N>=2 for synthesis baseline).

phase.description: Phasing gate (ADR-2606072800 §Decision 7). R1 = corpus-level only (no PHI).

description: Cab body assembly with ROPS/FOPS rollover-protection certification + interior + G14 open serial. Per ADR-2605261500.

iso27307AppliedAttestation.description: ISO 27307 sustainable agriculture machinery safety applied

noSurveillanceHardwareVerified.description: N11: no always-on camera / no biometric monitoring

openSerialReserved.description: G14 open serial reserved (assigned by vehicle_attestation_binder terminal)

rawSteelLotIds.description: HSLA-590/780 + Cu-bearing structural per-lot DID chain (G1 + §2(g) conflict-mineral scan)

weldProfileCid.description: MIG/MAG multi-pass profile @ 1 Hz log CID
