ecuFirmwareCid.description: G2: open BSP firmware image CID; R1 = open RISC-V equiv; R2+ = iwakura SoC

unlockStateAtShipDefault.description: G2 invariant: MUST be true (tsutae G2 + N2 parallel; suki anti-John-Deere-Knox parallel)

canBusProtocol.description: G9 + N4: open ISOBUS only; no DRM signature; no proprietary message-ID encryption

noDealerLockoutAttest.description: G10 (a): no software lockout requiring dealer authorization

ecuReflashNotManufacturerGated.description: G10 (c): ECU re-flash on parts swap NOT manufacturer-gated

diagnosticCodesOpenInterpretable.description: G10 (d): diagnostic codes interpretable from open docs

rtrPassVerdict.description: G10 RTR PASS attestation overall verdict (all 4 sub-invariants must pass)

description: Emissions audit: Stage V / EPA Tier 4 Final / 日本特殊自動車排ガス. R0-R1 tailpipe-compliant; R2+ zero tailpipe per G7 fuel sunset. Per ADR-2605261500.

knownValues: JP-日本特殊自動車排ガス規制

certificationAuthorityDids.description: TÜV / VCA / etc. certifier DID chain

g7InvariantVerify.description: R-phase ↔ fuel type compatibility per G7

zeroTailpipeR2plus.description: G8 invariant: R2+ must be true

driverDid.description: G11: ag-mechanic license-bound + Norikata R2+ SAE Level 3 driver-in-seat

saeAutonomyLevel.description: G12 invariant: ≤3 (operator-in-seat); SAE Level 5 = N6 NEVER

implementDetectionProtocol.description: G9 + N5: open ISO 11783 (ISOBUS) only; no DRM signature gate; no seed-brand lock

noDrmDetectionVerified.description: G9 + N5 invariant: open detection, no DRM

torqueAsaeS203Verify.description: ASAE S203 PTO shaft torque assembly

ratedPowerHp.description: G12 cap Wave 1 ≤200 hp; mega-tractor ≥400 hp = N3 DEFERRED

g7PhaseGateVerify.description: G7 invariant: fuelType matches current R-phase requirement

norikataDriverDid.description: R2+: SAE Level 3 driver-in-seat + ag-machine operator license

description: Terminal delivery verification record emitted by the yoro-supply delivery_verify Pregel cell. Confirms goods arrived at the construction site + were inspected on receipt + match the PO. Carries weighbridge / count / QC results IPFS-pinned (G2) and both buyer+receiver witness signatures (G3 minLength 2, must differ from each other AND from any supplier-side witness in parent purchaseOrder). Feeds into tatekata's `materialAttestation` per construction phase. Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G2, G3, G5 (Charter Rider §2(g) re-verification on arrival), G6 (deterministic dispatch).

shipmentIds.description: All shipmentTracking.shipmentId values for the legs that comprise this delivery.

deliveredAt.description: Timestamp goods arrived at the receiving location.

receiptQcResultIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the receipt-time QC results (weighbridge / count / spec-compliance / damage assessment).

buyerReceiverWitnessSignatures.description: G3: at least 2 buyer-side witnesses. The two DIDs MUST differ from each other AND from any supplier-side witness in the parent purchaseOrder.witnessSignatures (independence).

charterRiderRescanAttested.description: Structural G5: at arrival, the receiver re-verifies Charter Rider §2(g) — physical inspection confirms no conflict-mineral / rare-earth deviation from supplierSelection.conflictMineralAuditCid.

deviationFromGanttHours.description: Signed delta from purchaseOrder.manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid Gantt (negative = early, positive = late). G6 determinism KPI.

deviationNotes.description: REQUIRED when qcStatus is any `accepted-with-deviation` or `rejected-*`. Free text; PII filter applies.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (deliveryId + deliveredAt + receiptQcResultIpfsCid).

description: Manufacturing progress checkpoint emitted by the yoro-supply manufacture_track Pregel cell. One record per checkpoint milestone (raw-material-receipt / fabrication-start / qc-pass / packaging / factory-gate-ready). Carries factory telemetry photos IPFS-pinned (G2) and the QC firmware open-source attestation (G1). Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G1, G2.

checkpointPhase.description: Manufacturing phase reached. Records MUST be emitted in this order; a later phase implies all earlier phases passed.

telemetryPhotosIpfsCids.description: G2: IPFS CIDs of factory telemetry photos (provenance evidence). At least one per checkpoint.

qcResultIpfsCid.description: REQUIRED when checkpointPhase is `qc-pass`; IPFS CID of the QC test results document.

qcFirmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the QC testing equipment firmware manifest at this checkpoint.

quantityCompleted.description: Cumulative quantity completed at this checkpoint (units = parent purchaseOrder line's unitOfMeasure).

deviationFromScheduleHours.description: Signed delta from purchaseOrder.manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid (negative = ahead of schedule, positive = behind). Used by Gantt determinism check (G6).

description: Purchase order record emitted by the yoro-supply order_placement Pregel cell. Captures the supplier-confirmed PO terms (price, quantity, delivery schedule) and the supplier's manufacturing schedule. Both buyer and supplier sign (G3 minLength 2 witnesses, buyer and supplier DIDs must differ). Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G3 (≥2 witnesses), G6 (deterministic Gantt scheduling).

buyerDid.description: DID of the etzhayyim member placing the order (project owner or designated agent).

totalPriceMicroCents.description: PO total in micro-cents per Lexicon convention.

agreedDeliveryEndsAt.description: Latest acceptable delivery; validator MAY enforce ≤ N days after agreedDeliveryStartsAt.

manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid.description: G6: IPFS CID of the deterministic manufacturing Gantt schedule (replayable from inputs).

witnessSignatures.description: G3: at least 2 distinct witnesses. Typical pattern: buyerDid + supplier-authorized DID. The two MUST differ.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (purchaseOrderId + totalPriceMicroCents + agreedDeliveryEndsAt + manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid).

description: Shipment tracking record emitted by the yoro-supply shipment Pregel cell. Captures the carrier reference, ETA, route waypoints, and any customs documents (G2 IPFS-pinned). One record per shipment leg (origin-to-port / port-to-destination-port / port-to-site). Multiple legs for international shipments. Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G2 (customs docs IPFS-pinned), G5 (Charter Rider §2(g) — no flag-of-convenience carriers without third-party audit).

legIndex.description: Zero-based shipment leg index within the parent PO.

carrierReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-recognized carrier ID (DID or registered company ID).

carrierTrackingNumber.description: Carrier-issued tracking number for the leg.

customsDocumentIpfsCids.description: G2: IPFS CIDs of customs documents for cross-border legs (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, bill of lading).

carrierAuditCid.description: G5: IPFS CID of a third-party carrier audit if the carrier is flag-of-convenience or otherwise requires Charter Rider §2(g) verification.

description: Supplier selection record emitted by the yoro-supply supplier_selection Pregel cell. Captures the chosen supplier for one BOM line item, the RFQ response CID (G2 IPFS-pinned), and the Charter Rider §2(g) conflict-minerals + rare-earth-free attestation (G5). One record per BOM line × selected supplier. Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G1 (QC firmware open-source), G2, G5 (Charter Rider §2(g)).

selectionId.description: Stable identifier for this (BOM-line × supplier) selection.

projectBomLineRef.description: Opaque reference to a line in the parent projectBOM. The BOM itself lives in tatekata's project scope; this lexicon just cites the line.

materialClass.description: Material class. R1 ships concrete/steel/lumber/drywall/paint; R2+ expands to 20+ suppliers across all classes.

supplierReference.description: Opaque jurisdiction-recognized supplier identifier (DID or registered company ID). Free-text company names disallowed.

supplierJurisdictionCode.description: Optional ISO-3166-2 + municipality suffix; R1 targets Japan (`JP-*`) + United States (`US-*`).

rfqResponseIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the RFQ response document (price quote + lead time + spec compliance).

quotedUnitPriceMicroCents.description: Quoted unit price in micro-cents (USD × 10^4 if cents, × 10^6 if dollars). Per ADR-2605190900 — no float types for money. Currency context held by `quotedCurrencyCode`.

conflictMineralAuditCid.description: G5: IPFS CID of the supplier's conflict-minerals audit (Charter Rider §2(g) — no tantalum/tin/tungsten/gold from DRC conflict zones; no Xinjiang-sourced minerals; no rare-earth from PRC monopoly chains without third-party audit).

rareEarthFreeAttested.description: G5: TRUE if the material contains zero rare-earth elements; FALSE if rare-earth content is present but third-party-audited (see conflictMineralAuditCid).

qcFirmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the supplier's QC testing equipment firmware manifest (open-source verification).

main.description: A preserved piece of evidence for a victim's case. The PII content lives ENCRYPTED (G6); only an envelope ref + a chain-of-custody hash sit in the clear, so the victim can prove the item is unchanged since capture.

envelopeRef.description: G6 INVARIANT — com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope CID. The plaintext PII is NEVER stored here; a plaintext-PII field is unrepresentable.

main.description: A platform/bank-side request GENERATED for the victim to send: account freeze / takedown / disclosure to a platform abuse desk, or a 不正送金 組戻し・口座凍結依頼 to a bank under 振り込め詐欺救済法. Member-authored (G3), member-sent (G2, no 代理), free (G1).

authoredBy.description: G3 — only 'member'. The victim is the requester; 助 drafts, never sends as an agent.

addressedTo.description: 宛先 (○○銀行 / プラットフォーム abuse desk)

legalBasis.description: 根拠 (e.g. 振り込め詐欺救済法 / 各社利用規約 abuse 条項) — :representative (G10)

published.description: G9 — draft-only at R0; live send is gated. Only false.

main.description: A police-side document GENERATED for the victim to submit: 被害届 / 被害状況報告書 / 証拠目録 / 被害額算定書. CRITICAL INVARIANT (G3): the document is authored BY THE MEMBER (本人作成の申告書類), never by the police — an official police-authored record is unrepresentable (公文書偽造を構造的に排除). It is 'ready to use' in that an officer can work from it at intake, but the victim signs and submits it.

kind.description: police-side document kinds. platform-request / bank-freeze-request / recovery-plan are emitted by their own lexicons.

authoredBy.description: G3 INVARIANT — only 'member'. 'police' / 'official' / 'server' are unrepresentable. The actor produces the VICTIM's own filing, not a police-authored 公文書.

addressedTo.description: 宛先 (e.g. ○○警察署長) — a recipient, NOT the author.

needsMemberSignature.description: G2/G7 — the member must review + sign before use; only true (no 代理提出).

published.description: G9 — R0 is draft-only; live filing is Council Lv6+ + operator gated. Only false.

main.description: An account-recovery procedure GENERATED for the victim to follow themselves: service-specific steps to reset credentials, restore email/2FA, and lock out an attacker after an account-takeover. Self-help (G2 :self-submit), member-driven (no-server-key), free (G1).

service.description: the affected service (Google / Apple / LINE / Yahoo / bank app / …)

supportRole.description: G2 INVARIANT — 案内/起草補助/本人実行 のみ。represent / proxy-submit / agent-file は enum 外 (本人がアカウント復旧を実行).

published.description: G9 — draft-only at R0. Only false.

main.description: The aggregate case folder: a victim intake + the documents generated + the FREE public windows pointed to. The end-to-end membrane view. Free by construction (G1), consent-gated (G7), and never routes to a paid counsel (G5).

subject.description: victim member DID

referrals.description: FREE public windows (#9110 / 188 / NCCC / フィッシング対策協議会 / JPCERT / 銀行 / プラットフォーム / 振り込め詐欺救済法)

supportCostJpy.description: G1 全て無料 INVARIANT — the whole case costs the victim 0; only 0.

paidReferral.description: G5 INVARIANT — 助 never routes to a PAID counsel (弁護士へつながない); only false. Free public windows only.

main.description: A consenting victim's cybercrime support case intake. FREE (G1), consent-gated (G7), member-signed (no-server-key). Classified into a scam KIND for routing — never a finding that a crime occurred (G4, 非裁定).

subject.description: G7 — SBT-bound victim member DID. The principal who signs + submits.

scamKind.description: G4 — a KIND for routing. A legal verdict (fraud-confirmed / criminal) is NOT an enum member (danjo/chigiri boundary).

consent.description: G7 — a case is opened only with the victim's explicit consent; only true.

supportCostJpy.description: G1 全て無料 INVARIANT — the cost of 助's support is always 0. A fee is unrepresentable (cash≡0).

main.description: Assert a logistics / shipping FLOW edge (plant → export gateway hub) into the kotoba Datom log (:flow/*). The `via` chokepoint keyword(s) reuse the SHARED vocabulary of watari :lane/chokepoint (live vessel transit) and watatsuna :station/chokepoint (static cable load) — the join key that composes the three maps into one maritime resilience picture, routed to redundancy + safer routing, NEVER to interdiction (G2).

via.description: chokepoint keyword(s) the flow traverses — SHARED with watari + watatsuna

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)

main.description: Assert a first-class maritime CHOKEPOINT into the kotoba Datom log (:chokepoint/*). The `keyword` is the SHARED join key carried by :flow/via, watari :lane/chokepoint, and watatsuna :station/chokepoint — promoting it from a bare keyword to a geographic node lets the three maps plot the same hotspot. Coordinates are coarse corridor centroids (a corridor, not a target point; G1/G2 — resilience map, never interdiction).

keyword.description: shared chokepoint keyword (= :flow/via member = watari :lane/chokepoint = watatsuna :station/chokepoint)

lat.description: coarse corridor centroid latitude (not a target point; G2)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)

main.description: Assert a logistics NODE (seaport / airport / rail hub / inland port / distribution center) into the kotoba Datom log (:hub/*). Disclosed public infrastructure only; coordinates rounded to ~0.01° (G1). Throughput is the disclosed aggregate annual figure.

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)

main.description: Assert a manufacturing FACILITY into the kotoba Datom log (:plant/*). Disclosed public facilities only; coordinates rounded to ~0.01° (city/campus, G1). The operator is a COMPANY (joins kabuto org.corp.*), never a person (G4). headcount is the DISCLOSED AGGREGATE facility-employment figure — a SIZE, like floor area or market-cap; there is NO per-worker field anywhere in this lexicon and an individual worker is structurally unrepresentable (G4 — Charter Rider §2(c) reciprocity axis; Wellbecoming §1.13).

operator.description: :plant/operator — a company org id (joins kabuto org.corp.*), never a person

region.description: sub-national region / city (coarse; never a precise street address)

products.description: disclosed product CLASSES only — never a confidential recipe (G9)

headcountEst.description: DISCLOSED AGGREGATE facility employment (a SIZE) — NOT per-worker data (G4)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed Datom log; ADR-2605312345)

main.description: Generic OCEL audit-row emitter. Writes one row to vertex_repo_commit. Replaces per-actor `emit_audit` py_primitive nodes (e.g. shosha_*, isbn_*, animeka_*) with a single data-resolved primitive — ADR-2605082000 §2.5 compliance for audit logging without per-actor code.

rkey.description: Record key. Empty string → auto-generated UUID.

action.description: Action verb (create / update / delete / ingest / synth / ...)

main.description: Generic constant-return / identity primitive for LangGraph topology nodes (ADR-2605082000 §2.6 PoC follow-up). Returns whatever is in `constant` verbatim. Lets identity / no-op nodes (e.g. ki.cycle.skip_bloom) live as data without requiring per-actor code. Inputs other than `constant` are ignored.

constant.description: Object returned verbatim under the result envelope. Required.

schema.description: Echoes the input `constant` field as the response object.

constant.description: The same object that was supplied in the input.

main.description: Generic HTTP fetch primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps httpx for outbound requests. Read-only by default (GET / HEAD); POST/PUT/DELETE require explicit `method` arg + `allowWrite=true` flag (no implicit writes). Replaces per-actor httpx py_primitive nodes (copyright_*, isbn_*, …). Body-bytes are returned as a base64 string when not text.

method.description: HTTP method (GET / HEAD / POST / PUT / DELETE). Default: GET.

body.description: Request body for POST/PUT (string, JSON, or base64-encoded bytes).

main.description: Generic JSON extract primitive — navigate a parsed-JSON object via a safe dotted path. Bridges `http.fetch` (which returns body string) and downstream nodes that need a sub-tree (e.g. `message.items` from a Crossref response). Path syntax: `a.b.c` walks objects; `a.b[2].c` walks list indices; `a.*` flattens an object's values into a list. No eval, no JSONPath/JMESPath language — defensive subset only.

json.description: Parsed-JSON source. Either a string (will be JSON.parse-d) or an already-decoded object/array.

default.description: Value to return when the path doesn't resolve. Default: null.

main.description: Generic free-form LLM chat primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps task_generic_llm_chat — replaces per-actor LLM-only py_primitive nodes (animeka_*.generate_storyboard / generate_background / generate_scene_text, etc.) with a single data-resolved tool. Config-only prompt + tier; node binders pass `system` / `user` / `maxTokens` / `temperature` / `tier` via config.args.

tier.description: Model tier (e.g. fast / deep / structured). Default: fast.

schema.description: Response from underlying task_generic_llm_chat (content + usage + raw envelope as available).

main.description: Generic write SQL primitive (INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT only). Strict guards: rejects SELECT (use sql.query) / DELETE / DROP / TRUNCATE / GRANT / DDL. Requires `confirmWrite=true` defense-in-depth flag. If `rows` is supplied, runs executemany() batch INSERT; otherwise single execute. Replaces per-actor sa_executemany / sa_rowcount py_primitive nodes (copyright_ingest insert_crossref, etc.).

sql.description: INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional.

params.description: Named bind params for single-row execute().

rows.description: Row dicts for batch executemany() — each dict's keys must match SQL named binds.

main.description: Generic read-only SQL SELECT primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps `kotodama.db_alchemy.sa_query` so LangGraph topology nodes can run a parameterised SELECT without per-actor py_primitive code. Strict guards: only statements starting with SELECT / WITH are accepted; INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DDL are rejected. For domain writes use the actor-specific MCP tool (or `tools.audit.emit` for OCEL rows).

sql.description: SELECT or WITH … SELECT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional. Parameter binds via `params` (psycopg2 named-style %(key)s).

params.description: Named bind params for the SQL statement.

limit.description: Optional safety cap — if set, only the first `limit` rows are returned (server-side, after fetch). Default: 1000.

main.description:
Generic per-row transform — applies a declarative mapping to each input row. Bridges fetched arrays (e.g. http.fetch + json.extract output) and downstream sql.exec INSERT rows that need restructured fields. Mapping grammar (Python-free, defensive subset):

  - `"$.path[0].key"` → copy from input row at the given dotted path (same grammar as json.extract)
  - `{"const": <any>}` → literal constant value
  - `{"fmt": "prefix-{a.b}-suffix"}` → format string with {paths} substituted from input row
  - `{"path": "$.x", "default": <any>}` → path with fallback when missing

`defaults` is a dict of constant fields applied to every output row (overridden by `mapping`).

input.description: Source rows. Each item must be an object.

description: A published access-log record per ADR-2605310100 §3/§6 (Covenant Transparency Doctrine). R0 skeleton. Promotes the kotoba `fingerprint_middleware` audit datom (kotoba/audit/requests/v1: method/path/node_id/ts/peer_ip) and inbound-email ingest from operator-only to PUBLISHABLE for any party (member or non-member) that accessed an etzhayyim / kotoba resource. CONSTITUTIONAL: the §4 non-waivable floor applies BEFORE publication — `secretsRedacted` MUST be true; access-control material (DID private key, CACAO-as-bearer, auth tokens, session secrets, KOTOBA_* secrets) is NEVER published, only redacted. Outbound third-party data NOT brought in by ingress is out of scope (stays under tadori/danjo/himotoki gates). `ratificationStatus` MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded; until then records are scaffolds and no live publication of real access occurs (§5).

accessKind.description: The ingress surface the access arrived on.

actorClass.description: Whether the accessing party is a covenant member. Both classes are subject to §3 ingress-consent.

attributedDid.description: DID of the accessing party when attributable (members are always attributable per §1; non-members usually absent).

peerIp.description: Client IP as captured by fingerprint_middleware (X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP). Present only when the proxy supplied it.

path.description: Request path (truncated as in the audit datom).

requestAuditCid.description: CID of the underlying kotoba/audit/requests/v1 datom this publication derives from.

contentDigest.description: blake3 digest of the published content (e.g. inbound-email body) for integrity, computed AFTER §4 redaction.

publishedContent.description: The publishable content of the access (e.g. inbound-email body), AFTER the §4 secret-redaction filter. Omitted if the access carried no content.

ingressConsentBasis.description: MUST be `ingress-act`: consent is constituted by the act of reaching into etzhayyim's domain (territorial / ingress consent, §3), not by membership.

secretsRedacted.description: MUST be true. Asserts the §4 floor was applied: access-control material was redacted, never published.

withheldUnderFloor.description: Categories withheld by §4 (e.g. 'credential', 'cacao-signature', 'private-key', 'outbound-third-party-pii'). Transparency about what transparency did NOT publish.

redactionMethodNoteCid.description: Open, versioned method note describing the §4 redaction filter (analogous to danjo.methodNote).

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` at R0 (ADR-2605310100 §5). Live publication of real access requires recorded Council Lv7+ unanimity.

description: A member's attestation accepting the Covenant Transparency Doctrine terms per ADR-2605310100 §1/§2. R0 skeleton. The doctrine rests on the VOLUNTARY-COVENANT model: a member opts in to (a) anonymity abolished — every act bound to an accountable DID+SBT; (b) full member-to-member visibility — every believer can see every member action; (c) no member-to-member secrecy. Those who require individuated protection are, per founder direction, free to not accept and to seek another community; this record is the on-chain expression of acceptance. CONSTITUTIONAL: acceptance does NOT waive the §4 floor (secrets/keys), and the doctrine itself is `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) — `ratificationStatus` reflects this. Intersection with §1.13 Eros / pastoral content visibility is an OPEN QUESTION reserved to Council (§5); this attestation does NOT pre-decide it.

memberDid.description: DID of the member accepting the covenant transparency terms.

acceptsAnonymityAbolished.description: MUST be true. Accepts that every action is bound to an accountable DID+SBT (§1).

acceptsFullMemberVisibility.description: MUST be true. Accepts that every believer can see every member action (§2).

acknowledgesNoMemberSecrecy.description: MUST be true. Acknowledges there is no member-to-member secrecy tier (§1).

doctrineAdrCid.description: CID of ADR-2605310100 (the Covenant Transparency Doctrine) the member is attesting to.

charterRiderVersion.description: Charter Compliance Rider version in force at attestation (e.g. v2.0).

floorAcknowledgementCid.description: Optional reference to the §4 floor statement the member acknowledges is NOT waived (secrets/keys never published).

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity ratifies the doctrine (ADR-2605310100 §5).

councilRatificationCid.description: Set only after Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded on-chain; absent at R0.

description: The standing notice served on EVERY etzhayyim / kotoba ingress surface per ADR-2605310100 §3/§6 (Covenant Transparency Doctrine). R0 skeleton. Declares the ingress-consent rule: anyone — member or NON-member — who accesses an etzhayyim / kotoba resource (HTTP / XRPC / MCP request, wallet transaction, inbound email) thereby enters etzhayyim's domain ('こちらの領分') and consents to full logging AND public publication of that access, including its content. Standing terms: if you do not consent, do not access. CONSTITUTIONAL GATE: this doctrine MATERIALLY AMENDS the confidentiality invariant (ADR-2605181100) and therefore `ratificationStatus` MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) is recorded on-chain; until then the notice is published as DESIGN INTENT only and no live logging/publication change is executed (§5). The §4 non-waivable floor (secrets/keys never published; outbound third-party data not brought in by ingress stays under tadori/danjo/himotoki gates) is NOT overridden by this notice.

version.description: Semantic version of the standing notice, e.g. v0.1.0

languageTag.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. ja or en

noticeText.description: Full standing notice text. MUST state the ingress-consent rule and the standing 'do not consent → do not access' term, and MUST reference the §4 floor (secrets never published).

floorReferenceCids.description: CIDs documenting the §4 non-waivable floor (secret-redaction method note; outbound-actor-gate references). Transparency does NOT publish access-control material.

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` at R0. Flipping to a ratified state requires recording Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) amending ADR-2605181100. Until then no live logging/publication change executes (ADR-2605310100 §5).

councilRatificationCid.description: Set ONLY after Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded on-chain; absent at R0.

description: Open, versioned definition of the §4 non-waivable-floor redaction filter applied to every accessLogPublication BEFORE publication, per ADR-2605310100 §4/§6 (Covenant Transparency Doctrine). R0 skeleton, analogous to danjo.methodNote. The Covenant Transparency Doctrine publishes identities, actions and their content; it MUST NEVER publish access-control material, because publishing the key to the door would hand the substrate to the very threat actors the doctrine targets. This record is the PUBLIC, AUDITABLE specification of exactly what the filter strips — so the membership can audit the redactor itself, not only its output. No closed / secret redaction logic is permitted. `ratificationStatus` MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) is recorded (§5); the filter's live application is gated with the rest of the doctrine.

definition.description: Full open description of the redaction filter: what is detected, how, and why each category is access-control material rather than speech/action. Precise enough to reproduce. MUST make clear the filter is fail-closed (when in doubt, redact).

redactedCategories.description: The categories the filter strips. These are NEVER published under any ingress-consent (§4 floor).

detectionPatterns.description: JSON-encoded open pattern set (header names, key prefixes, entropy heuristics, schema fields) used to detect each redacted category. Open and versioned; no closed scoring.

failClosed.description: MUST be true. On ANY detection uncertainty the filter redacts rather than publishes — the floor is non-waivable.

knownFalseNegativeModes.description: Documented modes where a secret could slip through (transparency requirement; drives hardening). A false NEGATIVE here is a security incident, not a privacy one.

appliesToAccessKinds.description: accessLogPublication.accessKind values this filter version covers.

outboundGateReferenceCids.description: For the `outbound-third-party-pii` category: CIDs of the tadori/danjo/himotoki gate ADRs that retain jurisdiction over data NOT brought in by ingress (§4(2)). This doctrine does not widen those gates.

description: Attests that a proposed remediation is closed. G11: remediated MAY be true only when BOTH ownerMerged (a human owner merged the PR/patch) AND akumaReprobePass (akuma re-probed the same finding via its closeFinding path and the exposure is gone). No self-attested closure. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement + akuma re-probe CID verification.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of closure attestation.

findingCid.description: CID of the upstream akuma finding being closed.

ownerMerged.description: G11: a human owner merged the PR / applied the patch. Required true for remediated=true.

ownerMergeUri.description: URI/commit of the owner's merge (evidence for ownerMerged).

akumaReprobePass.description: G11: akuma re-probed the same finding (closeFinding re-probe path, ADR-2605151400) and the exposure is gone. Required true for remediated=true.

akumaReprobeFindingCid.description: CID of the akuma re-probe finding record verifying closure.

remediated.description: True iff ownerMerged AND akumaReprobePass. Structural conjunction enforced at the cell layer (G11).

description: A candidate DEFENSIVE fix patch tsukuroi proposes against an authorized target under an active RemediationMandate. defensiveOnly + autonomousMerge are structural consts enforcing the DEFENSIVE-ONLY (Charter Rider §2(a)) and PROPOSE-ONLY ceilings. pathsTouched MUST be ⊆ the mandate's allowedPaths (G6). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement + Charter Rider scan gate.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of proposal emit.

findingCid.description: CID of the upstream akuma finding this patch remediates (must match the mandate).

patchDiffCid.description: CID of the unified-diff patch payload (ciphertext in vault; metadata here). Defensive fix only.

pathsTouched.description: Files/dirs the patch modifies. G6: MUST be ⊆ mandate.allowedPaths; out-of-scope ⇒ outOfScopeWriteCount increment + reject.

autonomousMerge.description: G4: structurally false. tsukuroi never merges/self-approves/force-pushes/deploys; a human owner merges.

inferenceProvenance.description: G10: must record Murakumo judah LiteLLM provenance for any LLM-assisted synthesis (no vendor API).

description: Result of building + testing a candidate patch inside the egress-restricted tsukuroi-validate namespace. ranAgainstLiveTarget is a structural const false (G9): validation NEVER executes against the live target — only a sandboxed checkout. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

sandboxNamespace.description: Egress-restricted namespace the validation ran in.

testLogCid.description: CID of the build/test log (ciphertext in vault).

description: Owner+authority dual-signed authorization for tsukuroi to PROPOSE a defensive fix patch against an authorized target, scoped to an upstream akuma finding. Parallels akuma's scope contract (ADR-2605151400). PROPOSE-ONLY ceiling is structural: mergeAuthorityHeld const false. tsukuroi holds NO platform master key — submission uses an owner-issued least-privilege expiring fork-PR-only credential referenced (not stored) by delegationCredentialRef (ADR-2605231525). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement + dual-signature verification.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of mandate emit.

findingCid.description: CID of the upstream akuma finding (or owner-signed finding report) being remediated. G3: the ONLY permitted vulnerability input; tsukuroi performs no probing.

targetRepo.description: Git remote URL (or config target identifier) the patch is proposed to.

allowedPaths.description: Explicit file/dir prefixes tsukuroi MAY touch. G6: pathsTouched ⊆ allowedPaths; writes outside are denied at policy and schema.

submissionMode.description: How the fix is proposed. fork-pr from R2; patch-file from R1; config-diff requires Council Lv7+ at R3.

ownerDid.description: Target owner DID (did:web / did:plc / ERC725).

authoritySignature.description: Detached signature over the same payload, verifies against authorityDid. G7.

legalBasis.description: SOW id / bug-bounty program URL / written-authorization document CID.

mergeAuthorityHeld.description: G4 PROPOSE-ONLY: structurally false. tsukuroi never holds merge/deploy authority; a human owner merges.

maxPrPerWindow.description: G12 rate limit: max PRs/patches tsukuroi may open per mandate window.

description: Quarterly Council audit of tsukuroi. Four structural zero-counters encode the actor's constitutional ceiling: autonomousMergeCount (G4), exploitArtifactCount (G5), outOfScopeWriteCount (G6), platformHeldKeyCount (G8). Any nonzero value is a critical violation ⇒ cell halt + chigiri.disputeMediation (ADR-2605262700) + Bonsai seed-tier prune (ADR-2605091800, G13). R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of review emit.

attestingCouncilDids.description: Council Lv6+ seat DIDs attesting the review (≥3).

outOfScopeWriteCount.description: G6: count of writes outside mandate.allowedPaths. MUST be 0. Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

platformHeldKeyCount.description: G8: count of platform-held master/merge credentials tsukuroi held. MUST be 0 (ADR-2605231525). Nonzero ⇒ critical violation.

mandatesActive.description: Number of active RemediationMandates in the period.

proposalsSubmitted.description: Number of patch proposals submitted in the period.

violationDisputeCids.description: If any zero-counter was nonzero, the chigiri.disputeMediation record CIDs opened.

Per ADR-2605242000 (wadachi R0 charter) + constitutional gates G1 (open-source firmware), G5 (Charter Rider §2(a) no armed vehicles), G6 (deterministic planning @10Hz).

description: Terminal record for a completed wadachi autonomous-mobility mission. Aggregates the planned route + all trajectory segments + actual execution telemetry, with IPFS-pinned GPS track and sensor logs (G2) and at least one safety witness signature (G3). Records all 5 constitutional gates' attestations in one place so a post-incident audit can verify compliance without joining multiple records. Per ADR-2605242000 + gates G1-G6.

missionId.description: Stable mission identifier across the full lifecycle (plan → execute → complete).

vehicleDid.description: DID of the vehicle that executed the mission.

trajectoryPlanIds.description: Trajectory plan IDs (one per segment) the vehicle executed against.

missionEndedAt.description: End-of-execution timestamp regardless of status (success / aborted / failed).

actualDurationSeconds.description: Actual wall-clock duration; compared against deliveryRoute.plannedDurationSeconds for KPI.

gpsTrackIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the GPS track NDJSON for the full mission (≥1 Hz position samples).

sensorLogIpfsCids.description: G2: IPFS CIDs of sensor log chunks (LIDAR / camera / IMU / wheel-encoder). Multiple chunks allowed for large missions; concatenation order MUST be preserved by the cid array order.

safetyWitnessSignatures.description: G3: at least one safety witness signature required for record acceptance. Multi-witness encouraged for high-risk vehicle classes.

charterRiderComplianceAttested.description: Structural G5: this mission did NOT violate Charter Rider §2(a)-(h). Schema rejects false.

firmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the firmware source manifest the vehicle was running.

telemetryLogCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the telemetry_log cell's compute attestation that produced this record.

deviationSummary.description: Free-text summary if missionStatus is `completed-with-deviations` or any `aborted-*` / `failed-*` value. PII filter applies.

witnessDid.description: DID of the safety witness. MUST be distinct from the vehicleDid.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the missionId + missionEndedAt + gpsTrackIpfsCid + sensorLogIpfsCids.

description: Per-segment trajectory plan emitted by the wadachi motion_control Pregel cell. References a parent deliveryRoute and provides the 10 Hz control points the vehicle will follow (G6 trajectory determinism — same inputs MUST reproduce the same trajectory). The plan is the artifact that motion_control commits BEFORE executing motion, so a post-incident replay can verify the executed trajectory matched the plan. Per ADR-2605242000 + gates G6 (determinism @10Hz), G3 (safety witness pre-attestation can be required before high-speed segments), G4 (obstacle map version locked at planning time).

trajectoryPlanId.description: Stable identifier for this trajectory plan. Cited by missionCompleteRecord.trajectoryPlanIds.

deliveryRouteId.description: Parent route this plan implements a segment of.

vehicleDid.description: DID of the vehicle that will execute this trajectory.

segmentIndex.description: Zero-based index of this segment within the parent route's waypoint list.

controlPointCadenceHz.description: G6 constitutional invariant: trajectory determinism MUST be at 10 Hz.

controlPoints.description: Ordered control points at 10 Hz cadence.

maxSpeedMmps.description: Maximum commanded speed in mm/s (m/s × 1000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

obstacleMapVersionCid.description: G4: IPFS CID of the obstacle map version frozen at planning time. Avoidance decisions during execution reference THIS version, not any later one.

determinismHash.description: G6 reproducibility key — sha256 over (route inputs + obstacle map + planner config). Replay with same inputs MUST produce same hash.

motionControlCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the motion_control cell's compute attestation that produced this trajectory.

preExecutionSafetyWitnessSignature.description: Optional G3 pre-attestation for high-speed (>30 km/h) or restricted-area segments. Required for some vehicle classes.

tOffsetMs.description: Milliseconds offset from segment start; at 10 Hz cadence MUST be a multiple of 100.

xMm.description: Local-frame X position in millimeters (meters × 1000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

headingMrad.description: Heading in milliradians (rad × 1000) from local-frame X axis. Range [-π, π] × 1000 ≈ [-3142, 3142].

speedMmps.description: Commanded speed at this point in mm/s (m/s × 1000).

Declaration of a yobel debt-release rite. Yobel (ヨベル) implements collective one-way debt forgiveness per ADR-2605201800. The declared rite is a Council-ratified scoped forgiveness window; subsequent enrollments + release MST events bind to this declaration. Per AGENTS.md `Schema invariant (Charter Rider §2(b) one-way enforcement)`: the schema STRUCTURALLY excludes any release method that re-asserts debt (liquidation / seizure / margin call). Rite declaration requires Council Lv6+ × 3 ratification + Lv9 chair per the dmn/council-ratification-threshold DMN.

riteType.description: Rite type. Adding new values requires ADR amending this actor + Council Lv9 vote per AGENTS.md `riteType extension` boundary.

doctrinalBasis.description: Scriptural / doctrinal grounding for the rite (e.g. Leviticus 25 yobel cycle, Deuteronomy 15 shemittah, etzhayyim ADR-2605201800 §religious-basis). PII filter applies.

scope.description: Geographic + jurisdictional + member-class scope of the rite.

councilRatification.description: Council Lv6+ × 3 ratification + Lv9 chair signatures.

intendedUse.description: G5: structurally rejects military / state-mandated / corporate-coercive use (Charter Rider §2(a) + ADR-2605201800 §intended-use).

windowEndsAt.description: End of the rite window. Enrollments + releases cited against this riteId after this timestamp are rejected.

jurisdictionCodes.description: ISO-3166-2 codes (or 'global' for cross-jurisdiction). Per-jurisdiction Council ratification may apply.

maxAggregateReleasedMicroUsdc.description: Hard cap on the total USDC (micro-USDC, USDC × 10^6) that may be released under this rite. Per ADR-2605201800.

lv6PlusSignatures.description: ≥3 Council Lv6+ signatures (per AGENTS.md `Rite declaration` boundary).

lv9ChairSignature.description: Lv9 chair signature. councilLevel MUST be exactly 9.

dmnGateAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the dmn/council-ratification-threshold.md DMN evaluation trace.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (riteId + riteType + windowStartsAt + windowEndsAt).

description: Creditor enrollment in a yobel rite. The creditor voluntarily attests to a portfolio of `debts[]` they are willing to forgive under the declared rite. Per AGENTS.md `Schema invariant`: `debts[]` is a HISTORICAL RECORD ONLY — this lexicon provides NO method to mutate or augment debts after enrollment (append-only MST + schema constraint together enforce one-way forgiveness). ERC725 EIP-712 signedConsent verifies the creditor's voluntary intent. Per ADR-2605201800.

riteId.description: Parent declareRite.riteId this enrollment belongs to.

debts.description: Historical-record debt portfolio. APPEND-ONLY — no schema method to mutate; subsequent enrollments by the same creditor under the same riteId are explicitly REJECTED (the audit_witness cell halts on enrollmentId duplicate-creditor-per-rite).

totalPledgedReleaseMicroUsdc.description: Sum of debts[].principalMicroUsdc + accruedMicroUsdc this creditor pledges to release. Validator enforces ≤ Σ debts[].

erc725SignedConsent.description: EIP-712 signed consent verifying the creditor's voluntary intent. Per AGENTS.md `Eligibility` row + ADR-2605201800.

voluntaryAttestation.description: Structural: creditor MUST attest voluntary participation. The schema rejects involuntary enrollment (Charter Rider §2(a) anti-coercion).

couldRedeemAt.description: Optional creditor-self-declared cooling-off / redemption deadline. Per ADR-2605201800 §voluntary-redemption (if any).

principalMicroUsdc.description: Principal debt in micro-USDC (USDC × 10^6, integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900).

accruedMicroUsdc.description: Pre-existing accrued interest / fees in micro-USDC. Historical record; no method to grow this value via yobel substrate.

debtorHandleHash.description: Optional sha256 hash of the debtor's identifier (privacy-preserving — actual DID resolution happens at enrollDebtor).

smartWalletAddress.description: ERC725 Smart Wallet address of the creditor.

eip712TypedDataHash.description: EIP-712 typed-data hash signed (over enrollmentId + riteId + totalPledgedReleaseMicroUsdc).

signature.description: EIP-712 signature.

description: Debtor enrollment in a yobel rite. The debtor's eligibility is gated by Council SBT Lv1+ membership AND the DMN eligibility-by-rite-type rule for the parent rite. Enrollment is per-creditor-per-debt: a debtor can enroll one row per active debt across multiple creditors who have themselves enrolled. Per AGENTS.md `Eligibility` row + ADR-2605201800.

creditorEnrollmentId.description: Parent enrollCreditor.enrollmentId. The (creditorEnrollmentId, debtId) pair MUST resolve to a row inside enrollCreditor.debts[].

debtId.description: References enrollCreditor.debts[].debtId. The debt MUST exist in the creditor's enrollment portfolio.

councilSbtAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the on-chain Council SBT attestation proving debtor's Lv1+ membership at enrollment time.

dmnEligibilityAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the DMN eligibility-by-rite-type evaluation trace. dmn/eligibility-by-rite-type.md per ADR-2605201800.

voluntaryAttestation.description: Structural anti-coercion — the debtor MUST attest voluntary participation. Schema rejects involuntary enrollment (Charter Rider §2(a)).

debtorHandleHashMatchesCreditor.description: Cross-validation flag: TRUE if enrollCreditor.debts[].debtorHandleHash matches sha256(debtorDid). The audit_witness cell halts on FALSE values (creditor-debtor identity mismatch indicates a coordination bug or attempted false-enrollment).

description: Terminal record of a yobel debt release. Aggregates the (creditor, debtor) enrollment pair with the on-chain USDC release transaction via ERC725 Paymaster. Per AGENTS.md `Schema invariant`: releasedMicroUsdc MUST NOT exceed debt.principalMicroUsdc + debt.accruedMicroUsdc (boundary check enforced by schema constraint + audit_witness double-gate). `releaseMethod` STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDES liquidation / seizure / margin_call (the schema-level utility-decreasing direction is closed). Per ADR-2605201800.

debtId.description: References enrollCreditor.debts[].debtId. MUST be one of the historical debts in the parent creditor enrollment.

principalMicroUsdc.description: Mirror of enrollCreditor.debts[].principalMicroUsdc. Repeated here so this terminal record is self-contained for audit.

releasedMicroUsdc.description: Amount actually released. MUST be ≤ principalMicroUsdc + accruedMicroUsdc per AGENTS.md `Schema invariant`. Validator enforces this; audit_witness cell double-gates.

releaseMethod.description: Release method. The schema STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDES `liquidation`, `seizure`, `margin_call`, and any utility-decreasing direction (Charter Rider §2(b) one-way enforcement).

baseL2TxHash.description: On-chain Base L2 USDC release transaction hash via ERC725 Paymaster.

erc725PaymasterAddress.description: ERC725 Paymaster contract that funded the release tx.

titheRouterAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the TitheRouter.route() attestation (10% reverse-neutral for releases per AGENTS.md `Settlement` row + ADR-2605192130).

auditWitnessAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the audit_witness cell's encrypted append-only log entry for this release event.

supersededByReleaseId.description: If this release was later marked superseded by audit_witness tampering detection (per AGENTS.md `Witness invariant`), the replacement releaseId. Audit-only field; rare path.

main.description: Begin provisioning an etzhayyim ERC725 root identity. Returns a digest the caller must sign with their intended activeKey (EOA or smart-wallet-recovered P256 via WebAuthn) and submit to completeRootProvision. Per ADR-2605212030 §D4. Phase α: provisioning is Council-gated; the digest binds to a Council proposal nonce that only Council can finalize.

digest.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte digest the caller must sign with `activeKey` (EIP-191 personal_sign).

nonce.description: Single-use server nonce, valid for this provisioning attempt only.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch seconds; the nonce is rejected after this time.

chainId.description: Target chain id (Base mainnet 8453 or Base Sepolia 84532).

contractAddress.description: 0x-prefixed address of the deployed EtzhayyimAuthz contract on the target chain.

main.description: Complete a root-identity provisioning flow started by beginRootProvision. Caller submits the signed digest plus the nonce. Backend verifies signature, gates on Council approval, then submits an EtzhayyimAuthz.provisionRoot transaction on the target chain. Returns the chain tx hash + the assigned rootId. Per ADR-2605212030.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed EIP-191 personal_sign signature (65 bytes r||s||v) of the digest issued by beginRootProvision, signed by the requested activeKey.

txHash.description: Base L2 transaction hash for the provisionRoot call.

main.description: Return the full provenance chain of an etzhayyim root identity — the active key + all historical key rotations, plus the vendor predecessor link if any. Read directly from EtzhayyimAuthz events on Base L2; clients SHOULD NOT trust off-chain caches without on-chain receipt cross-check. Per ADR-2605212030 §D4.

rotations.description: All RootKeyRotated events in chronological order (earliest first).

vendorPredecessor.description: Present iff this root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

main.description: Phase P2 of ADR-2605212030 — mirror a vendor-issued ERC725 root (`did:erc725:etzhayyim:260425:*`) into an etzhayyim root on Base L2. Caller proves control of the existing vendor root by signing a continuity digest with their original vendor signing key. Council verifies the proof off-chain and submits EtzhayyimAuthz.mirrorVendorRoot. Returns the new etzhayyim DID + tx hash. This procedure is opt-in per actor; vendor roots stay valid for historical queries until vendor deprecation.

dwebHandle.description: Public handle to bind to the new etzhayyim root.

newActiveKey.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte address that will own the new etzhayyim root. MAY be the same as the vendor key or different.

vendorRootDid.description: Full vendor DID being mirrored, e.g. `did:erc725:etzhayyim:260425:0xabc...`.

vendorAddr.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum address of the vendor signer (EOA or smart-wallet).

vendorContinuityProof.description: 0x-prefixed signature by vendorAddr over `keccak256("etzhayyim-vendor-continuity" || vendorRootDid || dwebHandleHash || newActiveKey)`.

vendorRootHash.description: 0x-prefixed keccak256 of `vendorRootDid` — recorded on-chain in predecessorVendorRootHash.

errors.name: VendorContinuityProofInvalid
errors.description: vendorContinuityProof does not recover to vendorAddr.
